sql: SELECT d.year, count(*) invoices, sum(amount) amt, count(DISTINCT order_id) orders_invoiced, sum(CASE WHEN order_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) null_order FROM finance_invoices i JOIN dim_date d USING(day) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT channel, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT taken_by) takers, sum(CASE WHEN taken_by IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) null_taker, sum(CASE WHEN customer_po IS NULL OR customer_po='' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) no_po FROM erp_sales_orders GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT role, branch, count(*) FROM erp_sales_reps GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2
SELECT d.year, count(*) AS orders, count(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS custs, count(DISTINCT o.day) AS ndays FROM erp_sales_orders o JOIN dim_date d USING(day) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
WITH x AS (SELECT order_id, count(*) n FROM finance_invoices GROUP BY 1) SELECT n invoices_per_order, count(*) orders FROM x GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM erp_sales_orders o WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM finance_invoices i WHERE i.order_id=o.order_id)) orders_no_invoice,
(SELECT count(*) FROM finance_invoices i WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM erp_sales_orders o WHERE i.order_id=o.order_id)) inv_no_order,
(SELECT count(*) FROM finance_invoices i JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) WHERE i.customer_id<>o.customer_id) cust_mismatch,
(SELECT count(*) FROM finance_invoices i JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) WHERE i.branch<>o.branch) branch_mismatch,
(SELECT count(*) FROM finance_invoices i JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) WHERE coalesce(i.customer_po,'')<>coalesce(o.customer_po,'')) po_mismatch,
(SELECT count(*) FROM finance_invoices i JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) WHERE i.day<o.day) inv_before_order

SELECT fulfilment, count(*) n, sum(CASE WHEN ship_day IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) null_ship, sum(CASE WHEN qty_shipped<qty_ordered THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) short, sum(CASE WHEN qty_shipped>qty_ordered THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) over_, sum(CASE WHEN qty_shipped=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) zero_ship, min(markdown_pct), max(markdown_pct), avg(markdown_pct) FROM erp_sales_order_lines GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH ni AS (SELECT o.order_id, o.day FROM erp_sales_orders o WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM finance_invoices i WHERE i.order_id=o.order_id)),
l AS (SELECT l.order_id, sum(qty_shipped) shipped, count(*) nl FROM erp_sales_order_lines l JOIN ni USING(order_id) GROUP BY 1)
SELECT count(*) n_orders, sum(CASE WHEN l.order_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) no_lines, sum(CASE WHEN shipped=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) zero_shipped, sum(CASE WHEN shipped>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) shipped_pos, sum(CASE WHEN ni.day>2500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) last20days FROM ni LEFT JOIN l USING(order_id)

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM erp_sales_orders) o, (SELECT count(DISTINCT order_id) FROM erp_sales_order_lines) o_with_lines, (SELECT count(*) FROM erp_sales_order_lines l WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM erp_sales_orders o WHERE o.order_id=l.order_id)) orphan_lines,
(SELECT count(*) FROM finance_invoice_lines il WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM erp_sales_order_lines l WHERE l.line_id=il.line_id)) inv_lines_no_so_line,
(SELECT count(*) FROM finance_invoice_lines il JOIN erp_sales_order_lines l USING(line_id) WHERE il.sku<>l.sku) sku_mismatch,
(SELECT count(*) FROM finance_invoice_lines il JOIN erp_sales_order_lines l USING(line_id) WHERE abs(il.unit_price-l.unit_price)>0.005) price_mismatch,
(SELECT count(*) FROM finance_invoice_lines WHERE abs(amount-qty*unit_price)>0.01) amt_ne_qtyprice,
(SELECT count(*) FROM finance_invoice_lines il JOIN finance_invoices i USING(invoice_id) JOIN erp_sales_order_lines l USING(line_id) WHERE l.order_id<>i.order_id) line_order_mismatch

WITH s AS (SELECT invoice_id, sum(amount) la FROM finance_invoice_lines GROUP BY 1)
SELECT count(*) inv, sum(CASE WHEN s.invoice_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) no_lines, sum(CASE WHEN abs(i.amount-s.la)>0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) hdr_ne_lines, sum(i.amount) hdr, sum(s.la) lines FROM finance_invoices i LEFT JOIN s USING(invoice_id)

WITH t AS (SELECT l.line_id, l.qty_shipped, coalesce(sum(il.qty),0) inv_qty FROM erp_sales_order_lines l LEFT JOIN finance_invoice_lines il USING(line_id) GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT sum(CASE WHEN inv_qty=qty_shipped THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) eq, sum(CASE WHEN inv_qty<qty_shipped THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) under_billed, sum(CASE WHEN inv_qty>qty_shipped THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) over_billed, sum(qty_shipped-inv_qty) FILTER (WHERE inv_qty<qty_shipped) under_units FROM t

WITH s AS (SELECT invoice_id, sum(amount) la FROM finance_invoice_lines GROUP BY 1), d AS (SELECT i.amount-s.la diff FROM finance_invoices i JOIN s USING(invoice_id) WHERE abs(i.amount-s.la)>0.01)
SELECT CASE WHEN abs(diff)<=0.05 THEN 'a<=0.05' WHEN abs(diff)<=1 THEN 'b<=1' ELSE 'c>1' END bucket, count(*), sum(diff), min(diff), max(diff) FROM d GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT count(*), sum(amount-qty*unit_price) diff, min(amount-qty*unit_price), max(amount-qty*unit_price), count(DISTINCT invoice_id) FROM finance_invoice_lines WHERE abs(amount-qty*unit_price)>0.01

WITH t AS (SELECT l.line_id, l.order_id, l.qty_shipped, l.ship_day, l.fulfilment, coalesce(sum(il.qty),0) inv_qty FROM erp_sales_order_lines l LEFT JOIN finance_invoice_lines il USING(line_id) GROUP BY ALL)
SELECT d.year, fulfilment, count(*) n, sum(CASE WHEN inv_qty=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) none_billed, sum(qty_shipped-inv_qty) units FROM t JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=t.ship_day WHERE inv_qty<qty_shipped GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT method, count(*) n, sum(amount) amt, sum(CASE WHEN invoice_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) null_inv, sum(CASE WHEN amount<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonpos FROM finance_customer_payments GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH p AS (SELECT invoice_id, sum(amount) paid, count(*) np, min(day) first_day FROM finance_customer_payments GROUP BY 1)
SELECT count(*) inv, sum(CASE WHEN p.invoice_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) unpaid, sum(CASE WHEN abs(paid-i.amount)<=0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) paid_exact, sum(CASE WHEN paid<i.amount-0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) underpaid, sum(CASE WHEN paid>i.amount+0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) overpaid, sum(CASE WHEN p.invoice_id IS NULL THEN i.amount END) unpaid_amt, sum(CASE WHEN paid<i.amount-0.01 THEN i.amount-paid END) short_amt, sum(CASE WHEN np>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) multi_pay, sum(CASE WHEN first_day<i.day THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) paid_before_inv FROM finance_invoices i LEFT JOIN p USING(invoice_id)

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM finance_customer_payments p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM finance_invoices i WHERE i.invoice_id=p.invoice_id)) orphan_pay,
(SELECT count(*) FROM finance_customer_payments p JOIN finance_invoices i USING(invoice_id) WHERE p.customer_id<>i.customer_id) cust_mismatch,
(SELECT count(*) FROM finance_invoices i JOIN erp_customers c USING(customer_id) WHERE i.due_day-i.day<>c.terms_days) due_ne_terms,
(SELECT count(*) FROM finance_invoices WHERE customer_id NOT IN (SELECT customer_id FROM erp_customers)) inv_no_cust,
(SELECT count(*) FROM erp_sales_orders WHERE customer_id NOT IN (SELECT customer_id FROM erp_customers)) ord_no_cust

SELECT c.terms_days, count(*) n, min(i.due_day-i.day) mn, max(i.due_day-i.day) mx, round(avg(i.due_day-i.day),2) av, round(avg(dd.date - d.date),2) cal_days_avg FROM finance_invoices i JOIN erp_customers c USING(customer_id) JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=i.day LEFT JOIN dim_date dd ON dd.day=i.due_day GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH p AS (SELECT p.invoice_id, p.day - i.day lag_days, p.day - i.due_day late, d.year FROM finance_customer_payments p JOIN finance_invoices i USING(invoice_id) JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=i.day)
SELECT year, count(*), round(avg(lag_days),1) avg_days_to_pay, round(avg(CASE WHEN late>0 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END),3) share_late, max(lag_days) FROM p GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT d.year, count(*) unpaid, sum(amount) amt FROM finance_invoices i JOIN dim_date d USING(day) WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM finance_customer_payments p WHERE p.invoice_id=i.invoice_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT reason_code, count(*), sum(qty) FROM erp_returns GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT reason, count(*), sum(amount), min(amount), max(amount) FROM finance_credit_memos GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM erp_returns r LEFT JOIN erp_sales_order_lines l USING(line_id) WHERE l.line_id IS NULL OR l.order_id<>r.order_id OR l.sku<>r.sku) ret_line_mismatch,
(SELECT count(*) FROM erp_returns r JOIN erp_sales_order_lines l USING(line_id) WHERE r.qty>l.qty_shipped) ret_gt_shipped,
(SELECT count(*) FROM erp_returns r JOIN erp_sales_order_lines l USING(line_id) WHERE r.day<l.ship_day) ret_before_ship,
(SELECT count(*) FROM finance_credit_memos c JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) WHERE c.customer_id<>o.customer_id) cm_cust_mismatch,
(SELECT count(*) FROM finance_credit_memos c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM erp_sales_orders o WHERE o.order_id=c.order_id)) cm_orphan,
(SELECT count(*) FROM erp_returns r JOIN finance_credit_memos c ON c.order_id=r.order_id AND c.day=r.day) ret_cm_same_order_day,
(SELECT count(DISTINCT order_id) FROM erp_returns) ret_orders, (SELECT count(DISTINCT order_id) FROM finance_credit_memos) cm_orders

SELECT 'so_lines' t, count(*) FILTER (WHERE qty_ordered<>round(qty_ordered)) frac_ord, count(*) FILTER (WHERE qty_shipped<>round(qty_shipped)) frac_ship, count(*) FROM erp_sales_order_lines
UNION ALL SELECT 'returns', count(*) FILTER (WHERE qty<>round(qty)), NULL, count(*) FROM erp_returns
UNION ALL SELECT 'inv_lines', count(*) FILTER (WHERE qty<>round(qty)), NULL, count(*) FROM finance_invoice_lines
ORDER BY t

SELECT p.category, count(DISTINCT p.sku) skus, count(*) FILTER (WHERE l.qty_ordered<>round(l.qty_ordered)) frac_lines, count(l.line_id) lines FROM erp_products p LEFT JOIN erp_sales_order_lines l USING(sku) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH r AS (SELECT r.return_id, r.order_id, r.day, r.qty, l.unit_price, r.qty*l.unit_price val FROM erp_returns r JOIN erp_sales_order_lines l USING(line_id)),
c AS (SELECT order_id, day, sum(amount) amt FROM finance_credit_memos GROUP BY 1,2), rr AS (SELECT order_id, day, sum(val) val FROM r GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT count(*) n, sum(CASE WHEN abs(c.amt-rr.val)<=0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) match_val, sum(c.amt) cm, sum(rr.val) retval FROM rr JOIN c USING(order_id, day)

SELECT d.year, l.fulfilment, p.category, count(*) n, min(l.qty_shipped - floor(l.qty_shipped)) minfrac, max(l.qty_shipped-floor(l.qty_shipped)) maxfrac FROM erp_sales_order_lines l JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=l.ship_day JOIN erp_products p USING(sku) WHERE l.qty_shipped<>round(l.qty_shipped) GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3

SELECT reason, count(*) n, sum(qty_delta) qty, min(qty_delta), max(qty_delta), count(*) FILTER (WHERE qty_delta<>round(qty_delta)) frac, count(*) FILTER (WHERE ref_id IS NULL) null_ref, min(day), max(day) FROM wms_inventory_transactions GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT DISTINCT txn_date FROM wms_inventory_transactions WHERE day=0 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 5

SELECT l.fulfilment, count(*) lines, count(t.txn_id) with_sale_txn, sum(CASE WHEN t.txn_id IS NOT NULL AND abs(-t.qty_delta-l.qty_shipped)>0.0005 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) qty_mismatch, sum(CASE WHEN t.txn_id IS NOT NULL AND t.day<>l.ship_day THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) day_mismatch, sum(CASE WHEN t.txn_id IS NOT NULL AND t.sku<>l.sku THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) sku_mm, sum(CASE WHEN t.txn_id IS NOT NULL AND t.branch<>o.branch THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) branch_mm
FROM erp_sales_order_lines l JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) LEFT JOIN wms_inventory_transactions t ON t.reason='sale' AND t.ref_id=l.line_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT count(*) sale_txn, count(l.line_id) matched_line FROM wms_inventory_transactions t LEFT JOIN erp_sales_order_lines l ON t.ref_id=l.line_id WHERE t.reason='sale'

WITH s AS (SELECT ref_id, sku, branch, day, sum(-qty_delta) q FROM wms_inventory_transactions WHERE reason='sale' GROUP BY ALL),
l AS (SELECT l.order_id, l.sku, o.branch, l.ship_day, l.fulfilment, sum(qty_shipped) q FROM erp_sales_order_lines l JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) WHERE qty_shipped>0 GROUP BY ALL)
SELECT l.fulfilment, count(*) n, count(s.ref_id) matched, sum(CASE WHEN abs(s.q-l.q)>0.0005 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) qty_mm, sum(CASE WHEN s.day<>l.ship_day THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) day_mm FROM l LEFT JOIN s ON s.ref_id=l.order_id AND s.sku=l.sku AND s.branch=l.branch GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH s AS (SELECT ref_id, sku, branch, min(day) day FROM wms_inventory_transactions WHERE reason='sale' GROUP BY ALL)
SELECT s.day - l.ship_day diff, count(*) FROM erp_sales_order_lines l JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) JOIN s ON s.ref_id=l.order_id AND s.sku=l.sku AND s.branch=o.branch WHERE l.fulfilment='transfer' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM erp_transfers t JOIN wms_inventory_transactions w ON w.reason='transfer out' AND w.ref_id=t.transfer_id AND w.sku=t.sku AND w.branch=t.from_branch AND w.qty_delta=-t.qty AND w.day=t.day) out_match,
(SELECT count(*) FROM erp_transfers t JOIN wms_inventory_transactions w ON w.reason='transfer in' AND w.ref_id=t.transfer_id AND w.sku=t.sku AND w.branch=t.to_branch AND w.qty_delta=t.qty) in_match,
(SELECT count(*) FROM erp_transfers t JOIN erp_sales_order_lines l ON l.order_id=t.order_id AND l.sku=t.sku AND l.fulfilment='transfer') to_line,
(SELECT count(*) FROM erp_transfers t JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) WHERE o.branch=t.to_branch) to_is_order_branch,
(SELECT count(*) FROM erp_transfers WHERE qty=0) zero_qty,
(SELECT count(*) FROM erp_transfers WHERE from_branch=to_branch) same_branch

WITH s AS (SELECT ref_id, sku, branch, min("day") AS sday FROM wms_inventory_transactions WHERE reason='sale' GROUP BY ALL)
SELECT s.sday - l.ship_day AS diff, count(*) AS n FROM erp_sales_order_lines l JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) JOIN s ON s.ref_id=l.order_id AND s.sku=l.sku AND s.branch=o.branch WHERE l.fulfilment='transfer' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT l.ship_day - o.day AS lag, l.fulfilment, count(*) n FROM erp_sales_order_lines l JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) GROUP BY ALL HAVING count(*)>100 ORDER BY 2,1

SELECT l.fulfilment, i.day - l.ship_day AS lag, count(*) n FROM finance_invoice_lines il JOIN finance_invoices i USING(invoice_id) JOIN erp_sales_order_lines l USING(line_id) GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM finance_invoice_lines il JOIN erp_sales_order_lines l USING(line_id) WHERE l.qty_shipped=0) inv_zero_ship_lines,
(SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT line_id FROM finance_invoice_lines GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)) lines_on_multi_invoices,
(SELECT count(*) FROM finance_invoice_lines il JOIN erp_sales_order_lines l USING(line_id) WHERE abs(il.qty-l.qty_shipped)>0.0005) qty_ne_shipped

SELECT l.fulfilment, count(*) n, sum(CASE WHEN abs(l.unit_price - round(p.list_price*(1-c.discount_pct)*(1-l.markdown_pct),2))<=0.011 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) price_formula_match, sum(CASE WHEN abs(l.unit_cost-p.unit_cost)<=0.005 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) cost_eq_master, sum(CASE WHEN l.unit_price<l.unit_cost THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) below_cost, sum(CASE WHEN l.markdown_pct>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) any_markdown
FROM erp_sales_order_lines l JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) JOIN erp_customers c USING(customer_id) JOIN erp_products p USING(sku) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT trade, count(*) n, min(discount_pct), max(discount_pct), round(avg(discount_pct),4) avgdisc, count(DISTINCT terms_days) nterms, min(credit_limit), max(credit_limit), count(*) FILTER (WHERE rep_id IS NULL) no_rep FROM erp_customers GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM erp_customers c JOIN erp_sales_reps r USING(rep_id) WHERE r.branch<>c.branch) rep_other_branch, (SELECT count(*) FROM erp_customers c JOIN erp_sales_reps r USING(rep_id) WHERE r.role='inside') managed_by_inside,
(SELECT count(*) FROM erp_customers WHERE rep_id NOT IN (SELECT rep_id FROM erp_sales_reps)) bad_rep,
(SELECT count(*) FROM erp_sales_orders o JOIN erp_customers c USING(customer_id) WHERE o.branch<>c.branch) order_other_branch,
(SELECT count(*) FROM erp_sales_orders o JOIN erp_customers c USING(customer_id) WHERE o.day<c.onboarded_day) order_before_onboard,
(SELECT count(*) FROM erp_sales_orders o JOIN erp_sales_reps r ON r.rep_id=o.taken_by WHERE r.branch<>o.branch) taker_other_branch,
(SELECT count(*) FROM erp_sales_orders o JOIN erp_sales_reps r ON r.rep_id=o.taken_by WHERE r.role='outside') taken_by_outside,
(SELECT count(DISTINCT name) FROM erp_customers) distinct_names

SELECT d.year, round(avg(l.unit_price/p.list_price),4) price_to_list, round(avg(l.unit_price/(p.list_price*(1-c.discount_pct)*(1-l.markdown_pct))),4) price_to_formula, round(avg(1-l.unit_cost/l.unit_price),4) avg_line_margin FROM erp_sales_order_lines l JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) JOIN erp_customers c USING(customer_id) JOIN erp_products p USING(sku) JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=o.day GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT d.year, round(avg(pl.unit_cost/p.unit_cost),4) po_cost_to_master, count(*) n FROM erp_purchase_order_lines pl JOIN erp_purchase_orders po USING(po_id) JOIN erp_products p USING(sku) JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=po.day GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT name, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT branch) nb FROM erp_customers GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY n DESC, name LIMIT 8
SELECT purpose, count(*) n, round(avg(expected_day-day),2) exp_lead, count(DISTINCT vendor_id) vendors, min(day), max(day) FROM erp_purchase_orders GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT kind, count(*) n, min(quoted_lead_days), max(quoted_lead_days), min(terms_days), max(terms_days) FROM erp_vendors GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH r AS (SELECT po_id, count(*) nrec, min(day) first_rec, sum(lines) lines FROM wms_receipts GROUP BY 1), pl AS (SELECT po_id, count(*) nl FROM erp_purchase_order_lines GROUP BY 1), b AS (SELECT po_id, count(*) nb FROM finance_vendor_bills GROUP BY 1)
SELECT po.purpose, count(*) pos, count(r.po_id) received, sum(CASE WHEN r.nrec>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) multi_receipt, count(b.po_id) billed, sum(CASE WHEN b.nb>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) multi_bill, count(pl.po_id) has_lines, sum(CASE WHEN r.lines<>pl.nl THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) rec_lines_ne, round(avg(r.first_rec-po.day),2) avg_lead, round(avg(r.first_rec-po.expected_day),2) avg_vs_expected, sum(CASE WHEN r.po_id IS NULL AND po.day<2400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) unrec_old FROM erp_purchase_orders po LEFT JOIN r USING(po_id) LEFT JOIN pl USING(po_id) LEFT JOIN b USING(po_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT r.day - po.expected_day AS diff, count(*) n FROM wms_receipts r JOIN erp_purchase_orders po USING(po_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT v.kind, round(avg(po.expected_day-po.day),2) exp_lead_opdays, round(avg(v.quoted_lead_days),2) quoted, count(*) n FROM erp_purchase_orders po JOIN erp_vendors v USING(vendor_id) WHERE purpose='stock' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH m AS (SELECT po_id FROM finance_vendor_bills GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)
SELECT b.po_id, b.bill_id, b.day, b.vendor_id, b.vendor_invoice_no, b.amount, b.freight FROM finance_vendor_bills b JOIN m USING(po_id) ORDER BY b.po_id, b.bill_id LIMIT 12

WITH p AS (SELECT bill_id, sum(amount) paid, count(*) np FROM finance_vendor_payments GROUP BY 1)
SELECT CASE WHEN b.vendor_invoice_no LIKE '%-R' THEN 'R-suffix' ELSE 'normal' END kind, count(*) bills, sum(b.amount) amt, count(p.bill_id) paid, sum(p.paid) paid_amt, sum(CASE WHEN abs(p.paid-b.amount-b.freight)<=0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) paid_amt_plus_freight, sum(CASE WHEN abs(p.paid-b.amount)<=0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) paid_eq_amt, sum(CASE WHEN p.np>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) multi FROM finance_vendor_bills b LEFT JOIN p USING(bill_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT d.year, count(*) FILTER (WHERE b.vendor_invoice_no LIKE '%-R') r_bills, sum(b.amount) FILTER (WHERE b.vendor_invoice_no LIKE '%-R') r_amt, count(*) all_bills, sum(CASE WHEN b.freight>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) with_freight, sum(b.freight) freight FROM finance_vendor_bills b JOIN dim_date d USING(day) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH bl AS (SELECT bill_id, sum(qty*unit_cost) la, count(*) nl FROM finance_vendor_bill_lines GROUP BY 1), pl AS (SELECT po_id, sum(qty*unit_cost) pa, count(*) nl FROM erp_purchase_order_lines GROUP BY 1)
SELECT count(*) bills, count(bl.bill_id) with_lines, sum(CASE WHEN abs(b.amount-bl.la)>0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) hdr_ne_lines, sum(CASE WHEN abs(bl.la-pl.pa)>0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) lines_ne_po, sum(CASE WHEN bl.la>pl.pa+0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) bill_gt_po, sum(CASE WHEN bl.la>pl.pa+0.01 THEN bl.la-pl.pa END) excess, sum(CASE WHEN bl.nl<>pl.nl THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nlines_ne, sum(CASE WHEN b.vendor_id<>po.vendor_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) vendor_mm FROM finance_vendor_bills b LEFT JOIN bl USING(bill_id) JOIN erp_purchase_orders po USING(po_id) LEFT JOIN pl USING(po_id)

WITH p AS (SELECT bill_id, sum(amount) paid FROM finance_vendor_payments GROUP BY 1)
SELECT b.freight>0 has_freight, count(*) bills, count(p.bill_id) paid, sum(CASE WHEN abs(p.paid-b.amount)<=0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) paid_eq_amount, sum(CASE WHEN abs(p.paid-b.amount-b.freight)<=0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) paid_amt_plus_freight, sum(CASE WHEN abs(p.paid-b.amount)>0.01 AND abs(p.paid-b.amount-b.freight)>0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) other FROM finance_vendor_bills b LEFT JOIN p USING(bill_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH bl AS (SELECT bill_id, sum(qty*unit_cost) la FROM finance_vendor_bill_lines GROUP BY 1)
SELECT CASE WHEN abs(b.amount-bl.la)<=0.01 THEN 'eq' WHEN abs(b.amount-(bl.la+b.freight))<=0.01 THEN 'hdr=lines+freight' ELSE 'other' END k, b.freight>0 hf, count(*) n, sum(b.amount-bl.la) diff FROM finance_vendor_bills b JOIN bl USING(bill_id) GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

WITH x AS (SELECT b.bill_id, bl.sku, bl.qty bq, bl.unit_cost bc, pl.qty pq, pl.unit_cost pc FROM finance_vendor_bills b JOIN finance_vendor_bill_lines bl USING(bill_id) LEFT JOIN erp_purchase_order_lines pl ON pl.po_id=b.po_id AND pl.sku=bl.sku)
SELECT count(*) lines, count(pq) matched_po_line, sum(CASE WHEN bq>pq THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) qty_gt, sum(CASE WHEN bq<pq THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) qty_lt, sum(CASE WHEN bc>pc+0.005 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) cost_gt, sum(CASE WHEN bc<pc-0.005 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) cost_lt, round(avg(CASE WHEN bc>pc+0.005 THEN bc/pc END),4) avg_cost_ratio_when_gt FROM x

WITH p AS (SELECT bill_id, sum(amount) paid FROM finance_vendor_payments GROUP BY 1), bl AS (SELECT bill_id, sum(qty*unit_cost) la FROM finance_vendor_bill_lines GROUP BY 1)
SELECT CASE WHEN p.paid<b.amount THEN 'paid<bill' ELSE 'paid>bill' END dir, b.freight>0 hf, count(*) n, sum(p.paid-b.amount) diff, sum(CASE WHEN abs(p.paid-(b.amount-b.freight))<=0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) paid_excl_freight, sum(CASE WHEN b.vendor_invoice_no LIKE '%-R' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) rbills FROM finance_vendor_bills b JOIN p USING(bill_id) JOIN bl USING(bill_id) WHERE abs(p.paid-b.amount)>0.01 GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

WITH p AS (SELECT bill_id, min(day) pday FROM finance_vendor_payments GROUP BY 1)
SELECT v.terms_days, count(*) n, round(avg(p.pday-b.day),2) avg_days, min(p.pday-b.day), max(p.pday-b.day) FROM finance_vendor_bills b JOIN p USING(bill_id) JOIN erp_vendors v USING(vendor_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM finance_vendor_bills b JOIN wms_receipts r USING(po_id) WHERE b.day<r.day) bill_before_receipt, (SELECT count(*) FROM finance_vendor_bills b JOIN erp_purchase_orders po USING(po_id) WHERE b.day<po.day) bill_before_po,
(SELECT count(*) FROM finance_vendor_payments p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM finance_vendor_bills b WHERE b.bill_id=p.bill_id)) orphan_vpay,
(SELECT count(*) FROM finance_vendor_payments p JOIN finance_vendor_bills b USING(bill_id) WHERE p.vendor_id<>b.vendor_id) vpay_vendor_mm,
(SELECT count(*) FROM finance_vendor_bills b WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM finance_vendor_payments p WHERE p.bill_id=b.bill_id) AND b.day<2400) unpaid_old_bills,
(SELECT count(*) FROM erp_purchase_orders po WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM finance_vendor_bills b WHERE b.po_id=po.po_id) AND po.day<2400) unbilled_old_po

WITH p AS (SELECT bill_id, sum(amount) paid FROM finance_vendor_payments GROUP BY 1), pl AS (SELECT po_id, sum(qty*unit_cost) pa FROM erp_purchase_order_lines GROUP BY 1), bl AS (SELECT bill_id, sum(qty*unit_cost) la FROM finance_vendor_bill_lines GROUP BY 1)
SELECT b.freight>0 hf, count(*) n, sum(CASE WHEN abs(p.paid-pl.pa)<=0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) paid_eq_po_value, sum(CASE WHEN bl.la>pl.pa+0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) bill_lines_gt_po FROM finance_vendor_bills b JOIN p USING(bill_id) JOIN pl USING(po_id) JOIN bl USING(bill_id) WHERE p.paid<b.amount-0.01 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT b.vendor_invoice_no LIKE '%-R' rbill, count(*) n, sum(amount) amt FROM finance_vendor_bills b WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM finance_vendor_payments p WHERE p.bill_id=b.bill_id) AND b.day<2400 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT vendor_credit_id IS NOT NULL x, count(*) n, sum(amount) amt, sum(qty) q, count(DISTINCT vendor_id) v FROM finance_vendor_credits GROUP BY 1
UNION ALL SELECT false, count(*), NULL, sum(-qty_delta), NULL FROM wms_inventory_transactions WHERE reason='return_vendor'

WITH p AS (SELECT bill_id, sum(amount) paid FROM finance_vendor_payments GROUP BY 1), pl AS (SELECT po_id, sum(qty*unit_cost) pa FROM erp_purchase_order_lines GROUP BY 1), bl AS (SELECT bill_id, sum(qty*unit_cost) la FROM finance_vendor_bill_lines GROUP BY 1)
SELECT count(*) bills_lines_gt_po, count(p.bill_id) paid, sum(CASE WHEN abs(p.paid-b.amount)<=0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) paid_in_full, sum(CASE WHEN abs(p.paid-b.amount)<=0.01 THEN bl.la-pl.pa END) excess_paid FROM finance_vendor_bills b JOIN pl USING(po_id) JOIN bl USING(bill_id) LEFT JOIN p USING(bill_id) WHERE bl.la>pl.pa+0.01

WITH w AS (SELECT ref_id, sku, branch, day, -qty_delta q FROM wms_inventory_transactions WHERE reason='return_vendor')
SELECT p.vendor_id, count(*) txns, sum(q) units, (SELECT count(*) FROM finance_vendor_credits c WHERE c.vendor_id=p.vendor_id) credits FROM w JOIN erp_products p USING(sku) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT status, coalesce(loss_reason,'<null>') lr, count(*) n, count(order_id) with_order, round(sum(total),0) total FROM crm_quotes GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT d.year, count(*) n, round(avg(CASE WHEN status='won' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END),4) win_rate, round(avg(CASE WHEN status='lost' AND loss_reason IS NOT NULL THEN 1.0 WHEN status='lost' THEN 0 END),4) lost_reason_filled, count(DISTINCT rep_id) reps FROM crm_quotes q JOIN dim_date d USING(day) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM crm_quotes q WHERE order_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM erp_sales_orders o WHERE o.order_id=q.order_id)) won_bad_order,
(SELECT count(*) FROM crm_quotes q JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) WHERE q.customer_id<>o.customer_id) cust_mm,
(SELECT count(*) FROM crm_quotes q JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) WHERE q.branch<>o.branch) branch_mm,
(SELECT count(*) FROM crm_quotes q JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) WHERE o.day<q.day) order_before_quote,
(SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT order_id FROM crm_quotes WHERE order_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)) order_multi_quotes,
(SELECT count(*) FROM crm_quotes q JOIN erp_sales_reps r USING(rep_id) WHERE r.role='inside') by_inside,
(SELECT count(*) FROM crm_quotes q JOIN erp_customers c USING(customer_id) WHERE c.rep_id<>q.rep_id) rep_ne_acct_mgr,
(SELECT count(*) FROM crm_quotes q JOIN erp_sales_reps r USING(rep_id) WHERE r.branch<>q.branch) rep_other_branch

WITH ql AS (SELECT quote_id, sum(qty*quoted_price) s, count(*) n, sum(CASE WHEN abs(quoted_price-round(list_price*(1-markdown_pct),2))>0.011 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) price_formula_mm FROM crm_quote_lines GROUP BY 1)
SELECT count(*) q, count(ql.quote_id) with_lines, sum(CASE WHEN abs(q.total-ql.s)>0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) total_ne_lines, sum(ql.price_formula_mm) price_mm_lines FROM crm_quotes q LEFT JOIN ql USING(quote_id)

WITH qw AS (SELECT q.quote_id, q.order_id FROM crm_quotes q WHERE status='won'),
qlx AS (SELECT qw.order_id, ql.sku, sum(ql.qty) qq, avg(ql.quoted_price) qp FROM qw JOIN crm_quote_lines ql USING(quote_id) GROUP BY 1,2),
olx AS (SELECT l.order_id, l.sku, sum(l.qty_ordered) oq, avg(l.unit_price) op FROM erp_sales_order_lines l WHERE l.order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM qw) GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT count(*) pairs, count(qlx.sku) in_quote, count(olx.sku) in_order, sum(CASE WHEN qq=oq THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) qty_eq, sum(CASE WHEN abs(qp-op)<=0.011 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) price_eq, sum(CASE WHEN op<qp-0.011 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) order_price_lower, sum(CASE WHEN op>qp+0.011 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) order_price_higher FROM qlx FULL JOIN olx USING(order_id, sku)
SELECT o.channel, count(*) n FROM crm_quotes q JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT channel, subject, count(*) n, round(avg(minutes),2) avg_min, min(minutes), max(minutes), count(*) FILTER (WHERE notes IS NULL OR notes='') no_notes, count(DISTINCT notes) distinct_notes FROM crm_service_contacts GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2
SELECT d.year, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT c.customer_id) custs, round(avg(minutes),2) avg_min FROM crm_service_contacts c JOIN dim_date d USING(day) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM crm_service_contacts s WHERE customer_id NOT IN (SELECT customer_id FROM erp_customers)) bad_cust, (SELECT count(*) FROM crm_service_contacts s JOIN erp_customers c USING(customer_id) WHERE s.branch<>c.branch) branch_mm, (SELECT count(*) FROM crm_service_contacts WHERE customer_id IS NULL) null_cust
SELECT notes, count(*) n FROM crm_service_contacts GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY n DESC, notes LIMIT 15

sql: SELECT contact_id, day, customer_id, subject, notes FROM crm_service_contacts WHERE lower(notes) SIMILAR TO '.*(ai|assistant|ignore|instruction|analyst|model|claude|gpt|prompt|system).*' ORDER BY contact_id LIMIT 20

SELECT notes, count(*) n FROM crm_service_contacts WHERE notes NOT SIMILAR TO '(Customer asked when the rest of their order( \(PO [0-9]+\))? will ship\.|Question about pricing on a recent invoice( \(PO [0-9]+\))?\.|Asked for an ETA on a special order( \(PO [0-9]+\))?\. Checked with purchasing\.)' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY n DESC, notes LIMIT 30
SELECT customer_po FROM erp_sales_orders WHERE customer_po IS NOT NULL ORDER BY order_id LIMIT 5

WITH s AS (SELECT contact_id, customer_id, day, regexp_extract(notes, 'PO ([0-9]+)', 1) po FROM crm_service_contacts WHERE notes LIKE '%(PO %'),
m AS (SELECT s.contact_id, count(o.order_id) nmatch, min(s.day - o.day) mindiff FROM s LEFT JOIN erp_sales_orders o ON o.customer_po=s.po AND o.customer_id=s.customer_id AND o.day<=s.day GROUP BY 1)
SELECT count(*) contacts_with_po, sum(CASE WHEN nmatch>=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) matched_order_same_cust, sum(CASE WHEN nmatch>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ambiguous FROM m
SELECT count(*) n_po, count(DISTINCT customer_po) distinct_po, count(DISTINCT customer_id||'-'||customer_po) distinct_cust_po FROM erp_sales_orders WHERE customer_po IS NOT NULL AND customer_po<>''

SELECT param, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT branch) br, min(year*100+month) mn, max(year*100+month) mx, round(min(value),1) minv, round(max(value),1) maxv, count(*) FILTER (WHERE value IS NULL) nulls FROM external_degree_days GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT count(*) n, count(DISTINCT branch) br, min(year*100+month) mn, max(year*100+month) mx, min(units_total), max(units_total), count(*) FILTER (WHERE units_single_family>units_total) sf_gt_total FROM external_building_permits

SELECT b.branch, b.county, b.housing_units, (SELECT count(DISTINCT county) FROM external_degree_days e WHERE e.branch=b.branch) dd_counties, (SELECT max(county) FROM external_building_permits e WHERE e.branch=b.branch) permit_county, (SELECT count(*) FROM erp_customers c WHERE c.branch=b.branch) custs FROM erp_branches b ORDER BY 1
SELECT d.year, o.channel, count(*) n FROM erp_sales_orders o JOIN dim_date d USING(day) GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT category, coalesce(refrigerant,'<null>') refr, count(*) n, count(discontinued_on) disc, count(available_from) avail, min(discontinued_on), max(discontinued_on), min(available_from), max(available_from) FROM erp_products GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM erp_sales_order_lines l JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=o.day JOIN erp_products p USING(sku) WHERE p.discontinued_on IS NOT NULL AND d.date > CAST(p.discontinued_on AS DATE)) sold_after_disc,
(SELECT count(*) FROM erp_sales_order_lines l JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=o.day JOIN erp_products p USING(sku) WHERE p.available_from IS NOT NULL AND d.date < CAST(p.available_from AS DATE)) sold_before_avail,
(SELECT count(*) FROM erp_sales_order_lines l WHERE sku NOT IN (SELECT sku FROM erp_products)) bad_sku,
(SELECT count(*) FROM erp_products p WHERE vendor_id NOT IN (SELECT vendor_id FROM erp_vendors)) bad_vendor,
(SELECT count(*) FROM erp_products WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM erp_sales_order_lines l WHERE l.sku=erp_products.sku)) never_sold,
(SELECT count(*) FROM erp_purchase_orders po JOIN erp_purchase_order_lines pl USING(po_id) JOIN erp_products p USING(sku) WHERE p.vendor_id<>po.vendor_id) po_vendor_mm

SELECT p.refrigerant, p.discontinued_on, l.fulfilment, count(*) n, min(d.date)::varchar first_sale, max(d.date)::varchar last_sale FROM erp_sales_order_lines l JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=o.day JOIN erp_products p USING(sku) WHERE p.discontinued_on IS NOT NULL AND d.date > CAST(p.discontinued_on AS DATE) GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3
SELECT p.discontinued_on, count(DISTINCT p.sku) skus FROM erp_products p WHERE p.category='equipment' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 NULLS LAST

WITH t AS (SELECT sku, branch, day, txn_id, sum(qty_delta) OVER (PARTITION BY sku, branch ORDER BY day, txn_id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) bal FROM wms_inventory_transactions)
SELECT count(*) txns, count(*) FILTER (WHERE bal < -0.0005) neg_txns, count(DISTINCT sku||branch) FILTER (WHERE bal < -0.0005) neg_skubranch, count(DISTINCT sku||branch) skubranch, min(bal) minbal FROM t

SELECT p.category, count(*) skubranch_opening, round(avg(t.qty_delta),2) avg_open, round(avg(t.unit_cost/p.unit_cost),4) cost_ratio FROM wms_inventory_transactions t JOIN erp_products p USING(sku) WHERE reason='opening' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH r AS (SELECT w.ref_id, w.branch, sum(w.qty_delta) q, count(*) n FROM wms_inventory_transactions w WHERE reason='receipt' GROUP BY 1,2), pl AS (SELECT po_id, sum(qty) q, count(*) n FROM erp_purchase_order_lines GROUP BY 1)
SELECT count(*) rec_groups, count(rc.receipt_id) matched_receipt_id, count(po.po_id) matched_po_id, sum(CASE WHEN pl.q=r.q THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) qty_eq_po FROM r LEFT JOIN wms_receipts rc ON rc.receipt_id=r.ref_id LEFT JOIN erp_purchase_orders po ON po.po_id=r.ref_id LEFT JOIN pl ON pl.po_id=r.ref_id
SELECT d.year, d.month, count(*) orders FROM erp_sales_orders o JOIN dim_date d USING(day) WHERE d.year IN (2022,2023,2024) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT CASE WHEN onboarded_day<=0 THEN '<=0' WHEN onboarded_day<=2520 THEN 'in range' ELSE '>2520' END k, count(*) n, min(onboarded_day), max(onboarded_day), count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM erp_sales_orders o WHERE o.customer_id=c.customer_id)) never_ordered FROM erp_customers c GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
WITH t AS (SELECT o.taken_by, o.branch, count(*) n FROM erp_sales_orders o WHERE taken_by IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1,2) SELECT branch, count(*) takers, min(n), max(n) FROM t GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT t.day - o.day lag, count(*) n FROM erp_transfers t JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM wms_inventory_transactions w JOIN erp_returns r ON r.return_id=w.ref_id AND r.sku=w.sku AND abs(r.qty-w.qty_delta)<0.0005 AND r.day=w.day WHERE w.reason='return') return_txn_match,
(SELECT count(*) FROM finance_credit_memos c JOIN finance_invoices i USING(order_id) JOIN finance_customer_payments p USING(invoice_id) WHERE p.day>=c.day) inv_paid_after_credit_on_same_order,
(SELECT round(sum(amount),2) FROM finance_credit_memos) total_credits

WITH r AS (SELECT b.bill_id, b.amount, b.po_id FROM finance_vendor_bills b WHERE b.vendor_invoice_no LIKE '%-R'),
p AS (SELECT bill_id, SUM(amount) paid FROM finance_vendor_payments GROUP BY bill_id)
SELECT COUNT(*) n_r_bills, ROUND(SUM(r.amount),2) r_amount, COUNT(p.bill_id) n_paid, ROUND(SUM(p.paid),2) paid_amt, ROUND(SUM(p.paid)/10,2) paid_per_year_10y
FROM r LEFT JOIN p USING(bill_id)

WITH po AS (SELECT po_id, SUM(qty*unit_cost) po_val FROM erp_purchase_order_lines GROUP BY po_id),
bl AS (SELECT bill_id, SUM(qty*unit_cost) line_val FROM finance_vendor_bill_lines GROUP BY bill_id),
p AS (SELECT bill_id, SUM(amount) paid FROM finance_vendor_payments GROUP BY bill_id)
SELECT COUNT(*) n_over, ROUND(SUM(bl.line_val-po.po_val),2) excess_lines,
 COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.paid >= b.amount-0.01) n_paid_full,
 ROUND(SUM(bl.line_val-po.po_val) FILTER (WHERE p.paid >= b.amount-0.01),2) excess_paid_full,
 ROUND(SUM(bl.line_val-po.po_val) FILTER (WHERE p.paid >= b.amount-0.01)/10,2) per_year
FROM finance_vendor_bills b JOIN bl USING(bill_id) JOIN po USING(po_id) LEFT JOIN p USING(bill_id)
WHERE b.vendor_invoice_no NOT LIKE '%-R' AND bl.line_val > po.po_val + 0.01

WITH il AS (SELECT line_id, SUM(qty) iq FROM finance_invoice_lines GROUP BY line_id)
SELECT d.year, COUNT(*) n_lines, ROUND(SUM((l.qty_shipped-COALESCE(il.iq,0))*l.unit_price),2) unbilled_value
FROM erp_sales_order_lines l JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=o.day LEFT JOIN il USING(line_id)
WHERE l.qty_shipped > COALESCE(il.iq,0)+0.0001 GROUP BY ROLLUP(d.year) ORDER BY d.year NULLS LAST

SELECT d.year, ROUND(SUM(l.qty_shipped*l.unit_price),0) revenue, ROUND(SUM(l.qty_shipped*(l.unit_price-l.unit_cost)),0) gm,
 ROUND(SUM(l.qty_shipped*(l.unit_price-l.unit_cost))/SUM(l.qty_shipped*l.unit_price),4) gm_pct,
 ROUND(SUM(l.qty_shipped*l.unit_price)/SUM(l.qty_shipped*p.list_price),4) price_to_list
FROM erp_sales_order_lines l JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=o.day JOIN erp_products p USING(sku)
GROUP BY d.year ORDER BY d.year

WITH x AS (SELECT o.customer_id, c.discount_pct, c.rep_id, l.markdown_pct, l.qty_shipped*l.unit_price rev, l.qty_shipped*p.list_price lst
FROM erp_sales_order_lines l JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) JOIN erp_customers c USING(customer_id) JOIN erp_products p USING(sku)
WHERE l.qty_shipped>0)
SELECT rep_id, ROUND(SUM(rev)/SUM(lst),4) p2l, ROUND(AVG(discount_pct),4) avg_cust_disc, ROUND(AVG(markdown_pct),4) avg_line_md, ROUND(SUM(rev),0) rev
FROM x GROUP BY rep_id ORDER BY p2l, rep_id

SELECT d.year, ROUND(AVG(l.markdown_pct),4) avg_line_md, ROUND(AVG(c.discount_pct),4) avg_cust_disc_on_lines,
 COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE l.markdown_pct>0) n_md_lines, COUNT(*) n_lines,
 ROUND(SUM(l.qty_shipped*l.unit_price*l.markdown_pct/(1-l.markdown_pct)),0) md_dollars_approx
FROM erp_sales_order_lines l JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=o.day JOIN erp_customers c USING(customer_id)
GROUP BY d.year ORDER BY d.year

SELECT d.year, COUNT(*) n_short, ROUND(SUM(l.qty_ordered*l.unit_price),0) short_value, ROUND(SUM(l.qty_ordered*(l.unit_price-l.unit_cost)),0) short_gm,
 ROUND(COUNT(*)::DOUBLE/ (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM erp_sales_order_lines l2 JOIN erp_sales_orders o2 USING(order_id) JOIN dim_date d2 ON d2.day=o2.day WHERE d2.year=d.year),4) short_rate
FROM erp_sales_order_lines l JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=o.day
WHERE l.fulfilment='short' GROUP BY d.year ORDER BY d.year

SELECT o.channel, COALESCE(o.taken_by,-1) taken_by, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE l.markdown_pct>0) n_md, COUNT(*) n_lines,
 ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE l.markdown_pct>0)::DOUBLE/COUNT(*),4) md_rate,
 ROUND(SUM(l.qty_shipped*l.unit_price*l.markdown_pct/(1-l.markdown_pct)),0) md_dollars
FROM erp_sales_order_lines l JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=o.day
WHERE d.year=2025 GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY md_dollars DESC, 1, 2 LIMIT 15

WITH inv AS (SELECT i.invoice_id, i.amount, i.due_day, p.day pay_day FROM finance_invoices i JOIN finance_customer_payments p USING(invoice_id))
SELECT COUNT(*) n_paid, ROUND(AVG(pay_day-due_day) FILTER (WHERE pay_day>due_day),2) avg_days_late_when_late,
 ROUND(SUM(GREATEST(pay_day-due_day,0)*amount)/2520,0) avg_late_balance_dollars,
 ROUND(SUM(GREATEST(pay_day-due_day,0)*amount)/2520*0.08,0) carrying_cost_8pct_per_year
FROM inv

WITH oh AS (SELECT sku, branch, SUM(qty_delta) q FROM wms_inventory_transactions GROUP BY sku, branch),

 COUNT(*) n_customers_with_returns, MAX(n) max_returns_one_customer,

SELECT year, min(day), max(day), count(*) FROM dim_date WHERE year>=2023 GROUP BY year ORDER BY year

WITH p AS (SELECT sku, refrigerant FROM erp_products WHERE category='equipment')
SELECT d.year, coalesce(p.refrigerant,'none') refr, sum(l.qty_shipped) units, round(sum(l.qty_shipped*l.unit_price),2) rev, round(sum(l.qty_shipped*(l.unit_price-l.unit_cost)),2) gm, round(sum(l.qty_shipped*(l.unit_price-l.unit_cost))/nullif(sum(l.qty_shipped*l.unit_price),0),4) gm_pct, round(avg(l.markdown_pct),4) avg_md, count(*) lines

SELECT d.year, p.category, coalesce(p.refrigerant,'none') refr, count(*) lines, sum(CASE WHEN l.markdown_pct>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) md_lines, round(sum(l.qty_shipped*l.unit_price*l.markdown_pct/(1-l.markdown_pct)),0) md_dollars, round(sum(l.qty_shipped*l.unit_price),0) shipped_value, round(avg(CASE WHEN l.markdown_pct>0 THEN l.markdown_pct END),4) avg_md

WITH oh AS (SELECT sku, branch, sum(qty_delta) onhand, -sum(CASE WHEN reason='sale' AND day>=2269 THEN qty_delta ELSE 0 END) s25, -sum(CASE WHEN reason IN ('sale','transfer out') AND day>=2269 THEN qty_delta ELSE 0 END) out25 FROM wms_inventory_transactions GROUP BY sku, branch),
p AS (SELECT o.*, o.onhand*pr.unit_cost val, GREATEST(o.onhand-2*o.s25,0)*pr.unit_cost surplus_val FROM oh o JOIN erp_products pr USING(sku))
SELECT count(*) positions, round(sum(val),2) total_val,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE onhand>2*s25 AND onhand>0.01) n_over2, round(sum(val) FILTER (WHERE onhand>2*s25 AND onhand>0.01),2) val_over2,
 round(sum(surplus_val) FILTER (WHERE onhand>0.01),2) surplus_above_2y,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE s25=0 AND onhand>0.01) n_nosale, round(sum(val) FILTER (WHERE s25=0 AND onhand>0.01),2) val_nosale,
 round(sum(GREATEST(onhand-2*out25,0)*val/NULLIF(onhand,0)) FILTER (WHERE onhand>0.01),2) surplus_above_2y_incl_xfer

WITH pl AS (SELECT po_id, sku, sum(qty) qty, max(unit_cost) uc, count(*) n FROM erp_purchase_order_lines GROUP BY 1,2),
bl AS (SELECT b.bill_id, b.vendor_id, b.po_id, b.day, b.amount, b.freight, b.vendor_invoice_no,
  sum(l.qty*l.unit_cost) bill_lines, sum(p.qty*p.uc) po_val,
  sum(CASE WHEN l.qty>p.qty+1e-9 THEN (l.qty-p.qty)*p.uc ELSE 0 END) qty_ex,
  sum(CASE WHEN l.unit_cost>p.uc+1e-9 THEN (l.unit_cost-p.uc)*l.qty ELSE 0 END) cost_ex
  FROM finance_vendor_bills b JOIN finance_vendor_bill_lines l USING(bill_id) JOIN pl p ON p.po_id=b.po_id AND p.sku=l.sku
  GROUP BY ALL),
x AS (SELECT bl.*, vp.amount paid FROM bl LEFT JOIN finance_vendor_payments vp USING(bill_id) WHERE vendor_invoice_no NOT LIKE '%-R')
SELECT CASE WHEN paid IS NULL THEN 'unpaid' WHEN abs(paid-amount)<0.01 THEN 'full' WHEN abs(paid-po_val)<0.01 THEN 'to_po' ELSE 'other' END st,
 bill_lines>po_val+0.005 over_po, count(*) n, round(sum(bill_lines-po_val),2) ex, round(sum(freight),2) frt, round(sum(qty_ex),2) qex, round(sum(cost_ex),2) cex

FROM erp_sales_order_lines l JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=o.day JOIN erp_products p USING(sku)

WITH p AS (SELECT sku, unit_cost FROM erp_products WHERE category='equipment' AND refrigerant='R-410A'),
oh AS (SELECT sku, branch, sum(qty_delta) q FROM wms_inventory_transactions JOIN p USING(sku) GROUP BY 1,2),
s25 AS (SELECT l.sku, sum(l.qty_shipped) u FROM erp_sales_order_lines l JOIN p USING(sku) JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=o.day WHERE d.year=2025 GROUP BY 1)
SELECT count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN q>0.5 THEN sku END) skus_with_stock, round(sum(q),3) units_oh, round(sum(q*p.unit_cost),2) value_oh,
 (SELECT sum(u) FROM s25) units_sold_2025,
 round(sum(q)/((SELECT sum(u) FROM s25)/12),2) months_supply
FROM oh JOIN p USING(sku)

p AS (SELECT o.*, pr.category, coalesce(pr.refrigerant,'none') refr, pr.discontinued_on, o.onhand*pr.unit_cost val, GREATEST(o.onhand-2*o.s25,0)*pr.unit_cost surplus_val FROM oh o JOIN erp_products pr USING(sku) WHERE o.onhand>0.01)
SELECT category, refr, count(*) n, round(sum(val),2) val_all, count(*) FILTER (WHERE onhand>2*s25) n_over2, round(sum(val) FILTER (WHERE onhand>2*s25),2) val_over2, round(sum(surplus_val),2) surplus, count(*) FILTER (WHERE s25=0) n_nosale, round(sum(val) FILTER (WHERE s25=0),2) val_nosale

WITH x AS (SELECT l.*, o.customer_id, o.channel, o.taken_by, d.year, p.refrigerant, CASE WHEN round(l.markdown_pct,3)=0.42 THEN 'flat42' WHEN l.markdown_pct>0 THEN 'graded' ELSE 'none' END kind

WITH pl AS (SELECT po_id, sku, sum(qty) qty, max(unit_cost) uc FROM erp_purchase_order_lines GROUP BY 1,2),
bl AS (SELECT b.bill_id, b.vendor_id, b.po_id, b.amount, b.freight, b.vendor_invoice_no,

v AS (SELECT vendor_id, count(*) bills, sum(po_val) po_total, count(*) FILTER (bill_lines>po_val+0.005) over_n,

 UNION ALL SELECT sku, branch, 2015, sum(qty_delta), 0, 0 FROM wms_inventory_transactions WHERE day=0 GROUP BY ALL),

f AS (SELECT a.*, b.sold sold_next, b.recv recv_next, b.eoy eoy_next, b.sold_next2 FROM y a LEFT JOIN (SELECT *, lead(sold) OVER (PARTITION BY sku,branch ORDER BY year) sold_next2 FROM y) b ON a.sku=b.sku AND a.branch=b.branch AND b.year=a.year+1)
SELECT f.year, count(*) n_over2, round(sum(eoy*p.unit_cost),0) val_over2, round(sum(GREATEST(eoy-2*sold,0)*p.unit_cost),0) surplus_val,
 round(sum(coalesce(sold_next,0)*p.unit_cost)/sum(eoy*p.unit_cost),3) next_yr_sales_to_stock, round(sum(coalesce(recv_next,0)*p.unit_cost),0) recv_next_val,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE eoy_next>2*sold_next AND eoy_next>0.01) still_over2_next,
 round(sum(eoy*p.unit_cost) FILTER (WHERE p.category='equipment'),0) equip_val
FROM f JOIN erp_products p USING(sku) WHERE eoy>0.01 AND eoy>2*sold AND f.year BETWEEN 2017 AND 2024 GROUP BY f.year ORDER BY f.year

WITH pl AS (SELECT po_id, sku, sum(qty) qty, max(unit_cost) uc FROM erp_purchase_order_lines GROUP BY 1,2),
l AS (SELECT b.bill_id, b.day, b.vendor_id, l.sku, l.unit_cost bc, p.uc pc, (l.unit_cost>p.uc+1e-9) over_c
  FROM finance_vendor_bills b JOIN finance_vendor_bill_lines l USING(bill_id) JOIN pl p ON p.po_id=b.po_id AND p.sku=l.sku
  WHERE b.vendor_invoice_no NOT LIKE '%-R'),
f AS (SELECT sku, min(day) fd FROM l WHERE over_c GROUP BY 1),
s AS (SELECT l.*, lead(over_c) OVER (PARTITION BY l.sku ORDER BY day, bill_id) next_over,
  lead(bc) OVER (PARTITION BY l.sku ORDER BY day, bill_id) next_bc FROM l)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM f) skus_with_over, (SELECT count(DISTINCT sku) FROM l) skus_total,
 count(*) FILTER (over_c) over_lines,
 count(*) FILTER (over_c AND next_over IS NOT NULL) over_with_next,
 count(*) FILTER (over_c AND next_over) next_also_over,
 round(count(*) FILTER (over_c AND next_over)*1.0/count(*) FILTER (over_c AND next_over IS NOT NULL),4) p_next_over_given_over,
 round(count(*) FILTER (over_c)*1.0/count(*),4) base_rate,
 count(*) FILTER (over_c AND next_over AND abs(next_bc-bc)<0.005) next_same_cost,
 count(DISTINCT round(bc/pc,4)) FILTER (over_c) distinct_ratios
FROM s

WITH x AS (SELECT l.sku, o.day, dd.date, round(l.markdown_pct,3) md, p.discontinued_on FROM erp_sales_order_lines l JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) JOIN dim_date dd ON dd.day=o.day JOIN erp_products p USING(sku) WHERE p.category='equipment' AND p.discontinued_on IS NOT NULL AND p.discontinued_on<>''),
y AS (SELECT discontinued_on, date_diff('month', CAST(discontinued_on AS DATE), date) months_after, md FROM x)
SELECT discontinued_on, months_after, count(*) n, min(md) mn, max(md) mx, round(avg(md),4) av, sum(CASE WHEN md=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) zero_md FROM y WHERE months_after<=24 GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH p AS (SELECT sku, unit_cost FROM erp_products WHERE category='equipment' AND refrigerant='R-410A'),
oh AS (SELECT sku, sum(qty_delta) q FROM wms_inventory_transactions JOIN p USING(sku) GROUP BY 1),
s AS (SELECT l.sku, sum(CASE WHEN o.day BETWEEN 2269 AND 2520 AND l.fulfilment IN ('stock','transfer') THEN l.qty_shipped ELSE 0 END) u25,
  sum(CASE WHEN o.day BETWEEN 2017 AND 2268 AND l.fulfilment IN ('stock','transfer') THEN l.qty_shipped ELSE 0 END) u24,
  max(CASE WHEN l.qty_shipped>0 AND l.fulfilment IN ('stock','transfer') THEN o.day END) last_sale_day
  FROM erp_sales_order_lines l JOIN p USING(sku) JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) GROUP BY 1),
x AS (SELECT oh.sku, oh.q, oh.q*p.unit_cost val, coalesce(s.u25,0) u25, coalesce(s.u24,0) u24, s.last_sale_day,
  CASE WHEN coalesce(s.u25,0)=0 THEN 'no 2025 stock sales' WHEN oh.q/(s.u25/12.0)>24 THEN '>24 mo' WHEN oh.q/(s.u25/12.0)>12 THEN '12-24 mo' ELSE '<=12 mo' END bucket
  FROM oh JOIN p USING(sku) LEFT JOIN s USING(sku) WHERE oh.q>0.5)
SELECT bucket, count(*) skus, sum(q) units, round(sum(val),2) value, sum(u25) u25, sum(u24) u24 FROM x GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT year, min(day) first_day, max(day) last_day, count(*) n FROM dim_date WHERE year IN (2024,2025) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH oh AS (SELECT sku, branch, sum(qty_delta) onhand, sum(qty_delta) FILTER (WHERE day<2269) eoy24,
 -sum(CASE WHEN reason='sale' AND day>=2269 THEN qty_delta ELSE 0 END) s25, -sum(CASE WHEN reason='sale' AND day BETWEEN 2017 AND 2268 THEN qty_delta ELSE 0 END) s24,
 sum(CASE WHEN reason='receipt' AND day>=2269 THEN qty_delta ELSE 0 END) r25, -sum(CASE WHEN reason='transfer out' AND day>=2269 THEN qty_delta ELSE 0 END) xo25
 FROM wms_inventory_transactions GROUP BY sku, branch),
p AS (SELECT o.*, pr.category, coalesce(pr.refrigerant,'none') refr, pr.discontinued_on IS NULL active, pr.unit_cost c FROM oh o JOIN erp_products pr USING(sku) WHERE onhand>0.01 AND onhand>2*s25)
SELECT category='equipment' AND refr<>'none' cooling_refr_equip, refr, active, count(*) n, round(sum(onhand*c),0) val, round(sum(GREATEST(onhand-2*s25,0)*c),0) surplus, round(sum(eoy24*c),0) val_end24, round(sum(r25*c),0) recv25_val, count(*) FILTER (WHERE r25>0) n_recv25, round(sum(s25*c),0) sold25_val, round(sum(s24*c),0) sold24_val, round(sum(xo25*c),0) xfer_out25_val
FROM p GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY val DESC

WITH p AS (SELECT sku, unit_cost FROM erp_products WHERE category='equipment' AND refrigerant='R-410A'),
oh AS (SELECT branch, sum(qty_delta) q, sum(qty_delta*p.unit_cost) val FROM wms_inventory_transactions JOIN p USING(sku) GROUP BY 1),

WITH p AS (SELECT sku FROM erp_products WHERE category='equipment' AND refrigerant='R-410A')
SELECT d.year, d.quarter, po.purpose, count(DISTINCT po.po_id) pos, sum(pl.qty) units, round(sum(pl.qty*pl.unit_cost),2) value

SELECT d.year, coalesce(nullif(p.discontinued_on,''),'not discontinued') cohort, count(*) lines, sum(CASE WHEN l.markdown_pct>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) md_lines, round(sum(l.qty_shipped*l.unit_price*l.markdown_pct/(1-l.markdown_pct)),0) md_dollars, round(sum(l.qty_shipped*(l.unit_price-l.unit_cost)),0) gross_margin, round(sum(l.qty_shipped*l.unit_price),0) revenue

WHERE p.category='equipment' AND d.year IN (2016,2022,2023,2024,2025) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH pl AS (SELECT po_id, sku, sum(qty) qty, max(unit_cost) uc FROM erp_purchase_order_lines GROUP BY 1,2),
bl AS (SELECT b.bill_id, b.vendor_id, b.po_id, b.day, b.amount, b.freight, b.vendor_invoice_no,

x AS (SELECT bl.*, vp.amount paid, vp.day pday, d.year, po.purpose, po.branch FROM bl JOIN finance_vendor_payments vp USING(bill_id) JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=bl.day JOIN erp_purchase_orders po ON po.po_id=bl.po_id
  WHERE vendor_invoice_no NOT LIKE '%-R' AND (bill_lines>po_val+0.005 OR freight>0))

UNION ALL SELECT 'type', CASE WHEN has_q AND has_c THEN 'both' WHEN has_q THEN 'qty' ELSE 'cost' END, count(*), round(avg((abs(paid-amount)<0.01)::int),3) FROM x WHERE bill_lines>po_val+0.005 GROUP BY 1,2
UNION ALL SELECT 'purpose', purpose, count(*), round(avg((abs(paid-amount)<0.01)::int),3) FROM x WHERE bill_lines>po_val+0.005 GROUP BY 1,2
UNION ALL SELECT 'excess_pct_bucket', CASE WHEN (bill_lines-po_val)/po_val<0.02 THEN 'a<2%' WHEN (bill_lines-po_val)/po_val<0.05 THEN 'b2-5%' WHEN (bill_lines-po_val)/po_val<0.2 THEN 'c5-20%' ELSE 'd>=20%' END, count(*), round(avg((abs(paid-amount)<0.01)::int),3) FROM x WHERE bill_lines>po_val+0.005 GROUP BY 1,2
UNION ALL SELECT 'freight_on_over', (freight>0)::varchar, count(*), round(avg((abs(paid-amount)<0.01)::int),3) FROM x WHERE bill_lines>po_val+0.005 GROUP BY 1,2
UNION ALL SELECT 'freight_only_bills', 'all', count(*), round(avg((abs(paid-amount)<0.01)::int),3) FROM x WHERE bill_lines<=po_val+0.005 GROUP BY 1,2
UNION ALL SELECT 'pay_lag_over', (pday-day)::varchar, count(*), round(avg((abs(paid-amount)<0.01)::int),3) FROM x WHERE bill_lines>po_val+0.005 GROUP BY 1,2
ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT d.year, count(*) lines, sum(l.qty_shipped) units, round(sum(l.qty_shipped*l.unit_price),2) rev, round(sum(l.qty_shipped*l.unit_cost),2) cost, round(sum(l.qty_shipped*(l.unit_price-l.unit_cost)),2) gm, round(sum(l.qty_shipped*l.unit_price)/sum(l.qty_shipped*l.unit_cost),4) price_to_cost

 FROM wms_inventory_transactions t JOIN erp_products p USING(sku) LEFT JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=t.day WHERE p.category='equipment' AND p.refrigerant IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ALL),

WITH pl AS (SELECT po_id, sku, sum(qty) qty, max(unit_cost) uc FROM erp_purchase_order_lines GROUP BY 1,2),

  sum(l.qty*l.unit_cost) bill_lines, sum(p.qty*p.uc) po_val,

  WHERE vendor_invoice_no NOT LIKE '%-R' AND abs(vp.amount-bl.amount)<0.01)

 round(sum(CASE WHEN bill_lines>po_val+0.005 THEN bill_lines-po_val END)/count(DISTINCT year),2) full_paid_line_ex_yr,

s AS (SELECT l.sku, avg(CASE WHEN o.day BETWEEN 2017 AND 2268 THEN l.unit_price END) p24, avg(CASE WHEN o.day>=2269 THEN l.unit_price END) p25

SELECT count(*) skus_both, round(median(p25/p24),4) med_ratio, round(quantile_cont(p25/p24,0.1),4) p10, round(quantile_cont(p25/p24,0.9),4) p90, sum(CASE WHEN p25<p24 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) skus_lower

FROM erp_purchase_orders po JOIN erp_purchase_order_lines pl USING(po_id) JOIN p USING(sku) JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=po.day
WHERE po.purpose='stock' AND d.year>=2022 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT d.year, p.refrigerant, l.fulfilment, count(*) lines, sum(l.qty_ordered) qty_ordered FROM erp_sales_order_lines l JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=o.day JOIN erp_products p USING(sku) WHERE p.category='equipment' AND p.refrigerant IS NOT NULL AND d.year>=2023 GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3

SELECT d.year, d.month, count(*) FILTER (WHERE fulfilment='short') short_lines, count(*) FILTER (WHERE fulfilment IN ('stock','transfer')) from_stock_lines, count(*) FILTER (WHERE fulfilment='special') special_lines, sum(l.qty_ordered) qty_ordered FROM erp_sales_order_lines l JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=o.day JOIN erp_products p USING(sku) WHERE p.category='equipment' AND p.refrigerant='R-454B' AND d.year=2025 GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT d.year, sum(l.qty_ordered) qty_ordered_refr_equip, sum(l.qty_ordered) FILTER (WHERE fulfilment='short') qty_short, round(sum(l.qty_ordered*p.unit_cost),0) ordered_val_at_cost, round(sum(l.qty_ordered*p.unit_cost) FILTER (WHERE fulfilment IN ('stock','transfer','short')),0) stock_route_demand_val FROM erp_sales_order_lines l JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=o.day JOIN erp_products p USING(sku) WHERE p.category='equipment' AND p.refrigerant IS NOT NULL AND d.year>=2021 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH b AS (SELECT d.year, p.discontinued_on coh, coalesce(p.refrigerant,'none') refr, l.qty_shipped*l.unit_price*l.markdown_pct/(1-l.markdown_pct) md
FROM erp_sales_order_lines l JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=o.day JOIN erp_products p USING(sku)
WHERE l.markdown_pct>0 AND l.fulfilment='stock' AND d.year IN (2022,2025))
SELECT
 round(sum(CASE WHEN year=2025 THEN md END)-sum(CASE WHEN year=2022 THEN md END),0) real_increase_2022_2025,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN year=2025 AND coh IN ('2015-01-01','2023-01-01') THEN md END),0) md2025_restocked_cohorts,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN year=2025 AND coh='2023-01-01' AND refr='R-410A' THEN md END),0) c2023_r410a,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN year=2025 AND coh='2023-01-01' AND refr='R-454B' THEN md END),0) c2023_r454b,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN year=2025 AND coh='2023-01-01' AND refr='none' THEN md END),0) c2023_none,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN year=2022 AND refr='R-410A' THEN md END)/sum(CASE WHEN year=2022 THEN md END),4) r410a_share_2022,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN year=2025 AND refr='R-410A' THEN md END)/sum(CASE WHEN year=2025 THEN md END),4) r410a_share_2025,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN year=2025 AND refr='R-410A' THEN md END),0) r410a_md_2025,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN year=2025 THEN md END),0) total_2025
FROM b

SELECT 2569+2016 short_lines_jun_jul_2025, 2192+5174+2155+1043 r454b_units_recv_jul_oct_2025, 1104.1+1034.4 sold_jun_jul, round((2192+5174+2155+1043)/(4571.6),3) recv_jul_oct_to_full_year_sales, 4852+4353+7693+232 r454b_lines_2025, 25448-24725 demand_units_change
SELECT round(21230810 - 0.713*22707355,0) stock_above_hist_max_cover, round((21230810 - 0.713*22707355)*0.20,0) carry_20pct

SELECT (vendor_invoice_no LIKE '%-R') is_r, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT po_id) pos, round(sum(amount),2) amt, round(sum(freight),2) frt,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT bill_id FROM finance_vendor_payments GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)) bills_multi_pay,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM finance_vendor_payments WHERE bill_id IS NULL) pay_no_bill
FROM finance_vendor_bills GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH b AS (SELECT po_id, count(*) n, count(*) FILTER (vendor_invoice_no LIKE '%-R') nr FROM finance_vendor_bills GROUP BY 1)
SELECT n, nr, count(*) pos FROM b GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT bill_id, day, vendor_id, vendor_invoice_no, po_id, amount, freight FROM finance_vendor_bills WHERE po_id IN (SELECT po_id FROM finance_vendor_bills WHERE vendor_invoice_no LIKE '%-R' ORDER BY po_id LIMIT 4) ORDER BY po_id, bill_id

WITH l AS (SELECT bill_id, sum(qty*unit_cost) lv, count(*) nl, count(DISTINCT sku) ns FROM finance_vendor_bill_lines GROUP BY 1)
SELECT count(*) bills, count(*) FILTER (abs(b.amount-(l.lv+b.freight))<0.01) amt_eq_lines_plus_frt,
 count(*) FILTER (nl<>ns) bills_dup_sku,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT po_id, sku FROM erp_purchase_order_lines GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)) po_dup_sku,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT po_id, sku FROM erp_purchase_order_lines GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(DISTINCT unit_cost)>1)) po_dup_sku_diffcost,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM finance_vendor_bills b2 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM finance_vendor_bill_lines x WHERE x.bill_id=b2.bill_id)) bills_no_lines
FROM finance_vendor_bills b JOIN l USING(bill_id)

-- bill lines whose sku isn't on the PO (dropped by the inner join), and PO skus not billed
WITH pl AS (SELECT po_id, sku FROM erp_purchase_order_lines GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT count(*) bill_lines, count(*) FILTER (p.sku IS NULL) lines_not_on_po,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN p.sku IS NULL THEN l.qty*l.unit_cost END),2) val_not_on_po
FROM finance_vendor_bills b JOIN finance_vendor_bill_lines l USING(bill_id) LEFT JOIN pl p ON p.po_id=b.po_id AND p.sku=l.sku
WHERE b.vendor_invoice_no NOT LIKE '%-R'

-- PO skus with no bill line (short-billing): would offset over-billing per bill
WITH bl AS (SELECT b.po_id, l.sku FROM finance_vendor_bills b JOIN finance_vendor_bill_lines l USING(bill_id) WHERE b.vendor_invoice_no NOT LIKE '%-R' GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT count(*) po_lines, count(*) FILTER (bl.sku IS NULL AND b.po_id IS NOT NULL) unbilled_lines_on_billed_po, count(*) FILTER (b.po_id IS NULL) lines_on_unbilled_po
FROM erp_purchase_order_lines p LEFT JOIN bl ON bl.po_id=p.po_id AND bl.sku=p.sku
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT po_id FROM finance_vendor_bills) b ON b.po_id=p.po_id
SELECT round(59048.91+14509.94,2) parts_supplies_flagged

WITH pl AS (SELECT po_id, sku, sum(qty) qty, max(unit_cost) uc FROM erp_purchase_order_lines GROUP BY 1,2),
ol AS (SELECT b.bill_id, b.day, b.vendor_id, l.sku, l.qty-p.qty xq, (l.qty-p.qty)*l.unit_cost xv, vp.amount paid, b.amount
 FROM finance_vendor_bills b JOIN finance_vendor_bill_lines l USING(bill_id) JOIN pl p ON p.po_id=b.po_id AND p.sku=l.sku
 LEFT JOIN finance_vendor_payments vp USING(bill_id) WHERE b.vendor_invoice_no NOT LIKE '%-R' AND l.qty>p.qty+1e-9),
m AS (SELECT ol.*, c.vendor_credit_id, c.day cday, c.qty cqty, c.amount camt FROM ol JOIN finance_vendor_credits c ON c.vendor_id=ol.vendor_id AND c.sku=ol.sku AND c.day BETWEEN ol.day AND ol.day+252)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM finance_vendor_credits) credits, (SELECT round(sum(amount),2) FROM finance_vendor_credits) credit_amt,
 (SELECT round(min(amount),2) FROM finance_vendor_credits) cmin,
 count(DISTINCT bill_id) overqty_bills_with_same_vendor_sku_credit_within_252d, count(DISTINCT vendor_credit_id) credits_matched,
 count(*) FILTER (abs(cqty-xq)<1e-6) qty_equal, count(*) FILTER (abs(abs(camt)-xv)<0.01) amt_equal
FROM m
SELECT reason, count(*) n, round(sum(qty_delta),0) q, count(DISTINCT ref_id) refs FROM wms_inventory_transactions GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT * FROM finance_vendor_credits ORDER BY vendor_credit_id LIMIT 5

WITH pl AS (SELECT p.po_id, p.sku, sum(p.qty) qty FROM erp_purchase_order_lines p JOIN erp_purchase_orders o USING(po_id) WHERE o.purpose='stock' GROUP BY 1,2),
rc AS (SELECT ref_id po_id, sku, sum(qty_delta) rqty, count(*) nrows FROM wms_inventory_transactions WHERE reason='receipt' GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT count(*) stock_po_lines, count(rc.po_id) received, count(*) FILTER (abs(rqty-qty)<1e-6) rcv_eq_po, count(*) FILTER (rqty<qty-1e-6) short_rcv, count(*) FILTER (rqty>qty+1e-6) over_rcv,
 count(*) FILTER (nrows>1) split_receipts,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM rc WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pl WHERE pl.po_id=rc.po_id AND pl.sku=rc.sku)) rcv_without_stock_po_line
FROM pl LEFT JOIN rc USING(po_id, sku)

-- does receipt timing differ for over-qty stock POs vs matched? and wms_receipts lines count vs PO lines
WITH pl AS (SELECT po_id, count(*) npl FROM erp_purchase_order_lines GROUP BY 1)
SELECT o.purpose, count(*) pos, count(r.po_id) with_receipt_row, count(*) FILTER (r.lines=pl.npl) lines_eq, round(avg(r.day-o.day),2) avg_lag
FROM erp_purchase_orders o JOIN pl USING(po_id) LEFT JOIN wms_receipts r USING(po_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH pl AS (SELECT po_id, sku, sum(qty) qty, max(unit_cost) uc FROM erp_purchase_order_lines GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT count(*) lines, count(*) FILTER (l.qty<p.qty-1e-9) qty_under, count(*) FILTER (l.unit_cost<p.uc-1e-9) cost_under,
 count(*) FILTER (l.qty>p.qty+1e-9) qty_over, count(*) FILTER (l.unit_cost>p.uc+1e-9) cost_over
FROM finance_vendor_bills b JOIN finance_vendor_bill_lines l USING(bill_id) JOIN pl p ON p.po_id=b.po_id AND p.sku=l.sku WHERE b.vendor_invoice_no NOT LIKE '%-R'

WITH p AS (SELECT sku, unit_cost mc FROM erp_products WHERE category='equipment' AND refrigerant='R-410A')
SELECT d.year, l.fulfilment, count(*) lines,
 round(sum(l.qty_shipped*l.unit_cost)/sum(l.qty_shipped*p.mc),4) line_cost_to_master,
 sum(CASE WHEN abs(l.unit_cost-p.mc)>0.005 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) lines_cost_ne_master,
 round(sum(l.qty_shipped*l.unit_price)/sum(l.qty_shipped*p.mc),4) price_to_master
FROM erp_sales_order_lines l JOIN p USING(sku) JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=o.day
WHERE l.qty_shipped>0 AND d.year>=2022 GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

-- stock POs that were billed but never received in WMS, and their payment status
WITH rcv AS (SELECT DISTINCT po_id FROM wms_receipts)
SELECT o.purpose, (r.po_id IS NOT NULL) received, count(*) bills, count(vp.bill_id) paid, round(sum(b.amount),2) amt, round(sum(vp.amount),2) paid_amt, min(d.year) y0, max(d.year) y1
FROM finance_vendor_bills b JOIN erp_purchase_orders o USING(po_id) LEFT JOIN rcv r ON r.po_id=b.po_id LEFT JOIN finance_vendor_payments vp USING(bill_id) JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=b.day
WHERE b.vendor_invoice_no NOT LIKE '%-R' AND o.purpose='stock' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH p AS (SELECT sku, unit_cost mc FROM erp_products WHERE category='equipment' AND refrigerant='R-410A')
SELECT d.year, count(*) po_lines, round(sum(pl.qty*pl.unit_cost)/sum(pl.qty*p.mc),4) po_cost_to_master,
 round(median(pl.unit_cost/p.mc),4) med_ratio, round(min(pl.unit_cost/p.mc),4) mn, round(max(pl.unit_cost/p.mc),4) mx
FROM erp_purchase_orders po JOIN erp_purchase_order_lines pl USING(po_id) JOIN p USING(sku) JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=po.day
WHERE d.year>=2020 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT refrigerant, category, count(*) skus, min(discontinued_on) min_disc, max(discontinued_on) max_disc, count(discontinued_on) n_disc, min(available_from) min_avail, max(available_from) max_avail
FROM erp_products WHERE category='equipment' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH pl AS (SELECT po_id, sku, sum(qty) qty, max(unit_cost) uc FROM erp_purchase_order_lines GROUP BY 1,2),
bl AS (SELECT b.bill_id, b.vendor_id, b.po_id, b.day, b.amount, b.freight, sum(l.qty*l.unit_cost) bill_lines, sum(p.qty*p.uc) po_val
  FROM finance_vendor_bills b JOIN finance_vendor_bill_lines l USING(bill_id) JOIN pl p ON p.po_id=b.po_id AND p.sku=l.sku WHERE b.vendor_invoice_no NOT LIKE '%-R' GROUP BY ALL),
x AS (SELECT bl.*, vp.amount paid, vp.day pday, d.month, po.branch, e.kind FROM bl JOIN finance_vendor_payments vp USING(bill_id) JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=bl.day JOIN erp_purchase_orders po ON po.po_id=bl.po_id JOIN erp_vendors e ON e.vendor_id=bl.vendor_id
  WHERE bill_lines>po_val+0.005)
SELECT 'branch' dim, branch k, count(*) n, round(avg((abs(paid-amount)<0.01)::int),3) full_rate FROM x GROUP BY 1,2
UNION ALL SELECT 'month', lpad(month::varchar,2,'0'), count(*), round(avg((abs(paid-amount)<0.01)::int),3) FROM x GROUP BY 1,2
UNION ALL SELECT 'kind', kind, count(*), round(avg((abs(paid-amount)<0.01)::int),3) FROM x GROUP BY 1,2
UNION ALL SELECT 'abs_excess', CASE WHEN bill_lines-po_val<50 THEN 'a<50' WHEN bill_lines-po_val<250 THEN 'b50-250' WHEN bill_lines-po_val<1000 THEN 'c250-1000' ELSE 'd>=1000' END, count(*), round(avg((abs(paid-amount)<0.01)::int),3) FROM x GROUP BY 1,2
UNION ALL SELECT 'bill_amount', CASE WHEN amount<1000 THEN 'a<1k' WHEN amount<5000 THEN 'b1-5k' WHEN amount<25000 THEN 'c5-25k' ELSE 'd>=25k' END, count(*), round(avg((abs(paid-amount)<0.01)::int),3) FROM x GROUP BY 1,2
ORDER BY 1,2

WITH p AS (SELECT sku, unit_cost mc, list_price lp FROM erp_products WHERE category='equipment' AND refrigerant='R-410A')
SELECT d.year, l.fulfilment, count(*) lines, count(DISTINCT l.sku) skus,
 round(avg(l.unit_price/p.lp),4) avg_price_to_list, round(avg(1-l.markdown_pct),4) avg_1_minus_md,
 round(avg(l.unit_price/(p.lp*(1-l.markdown_pct))),4) avg_price_to_list_net_md,
 round(avg(p.lp/p.mc),4) avg_list_to_cost
FROM erp_sales_order_lines l JOIN p USING(sku) JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=o.day
WHERE l.qty_shipped>0 AND d.year>=2024 GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2
SELECT discontinued_on, count(*) skus FROM erp_products WHERE category='equipment' AND refrigerant='R-410A' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH x AS (SELECT l.fulfilment, p.discontinued_on coh, date_diff('month', CAST(p.discontinued_on AS DATE), dd.date) m, round(l.markdown_pct,3) md FROM erp_sales_order_lines l JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) JOIN dim_date dd ON dd.day=o.day JOIN erp_products p USING(sku) WHERE p.category='equipment' AND coalesce(p.discontinued_on,'')<>'')
SELECT coh, CASE WHEN m<0 THEN 'pre' WHEN m=0 THEN '0' WHEN m BETWEEN 1 AND 19 THEN '1-19' ELSE '20+' END band, fulfilment, count(*) n, min(md) mn, max(md) mx, sum(CASE WHEN md=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) zero_md, sum(CASE WHEN m BETWEEN 1 AND 19 AND md<>round(0.021*m,3) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) off_rule
FROM x GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2,3

SELECT d.year, l.fulfilment, CASE WHEN l.markdown_pct>0 THEN 'md' ELSE 'no_md' END k, count(*) n, round(avg(l.unit_price/l.unit_cost),4) price_to_linecost, round(avg(l.unit_cost/p.unit_cost),4) linecost_to_prodcost, round(min(l.unit_cost/p.unit_cost),4) mn, round(max(l.unit_cost/p.unit_cost),4) mx, round(avg(c.discount_pct),4) cust_disc
FROM erp_sales_order_lines l JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=o.day JOIN erp_products p USING(sku) JOIN erp_customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id
WHERE p.category='equipment' AND l.fulfilment<>'short' AND d.year IN (2016,2022,2025) AND l.qty_shipped>0 GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2,3
SELECT year, min(day) first_day, max(day) last_day, min(date) d0, max(date) d1, count(*) n FROM dim_date WHERE year>=2024 GROUP BY year ORDER BY year

SELECT o.purpose, d.month, count(DISTINCT o.po_id) pos, sum(l.qty) qty, round(sum(l.qty*l.unit_cost),0) val FROM erp_purchase_orders o JOIN erp_purchase_order_lines l USING(po_id) JOIN erp_products p USING(sku) JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=o.day WHERE p.category='equipment' AND p.refrigerant='R-454B' AND d.year=2025 GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

WITH p AS (SELECT sku, unit_cost mc FROM erp_products WHERE category='equipment' AND refrigerant='R-410A'),
s AS (SELECT l.sku, d.quarter,
 avg(CASE WHEN l.fulfilment='stock' THEN l.unit_price END) ps, avg(CASE WHEN l.fulfilment='special' THEN l.unit_price END) pp
 FROM erp_sales_order_lines l JOIN p USING(sku) JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=o.day
 WHERE l.qty_shipped>0 AND d.year=2025 GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT quarter, count(*) sku_quarters, round(median(ps/pp),4) med_stock_to_special, round(quantile_cont(ps/pp,0.1),4) p10, round(quantile_cont(ps/pp,0.9),4) p90
FROM s WHERE ps IS NOT NULL AND pp IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH pl AS (SELECT po_id, sku, sum(qty) qty, max(unit_cost) uc FROM erp_purchase_order_lines GROUP BY 1,2),
bl AS (SELECT b.bill_id, b.vendor_id, b.po_id, b.day, b.amount, b.freight, sum(l.qty*l.unit_cost) bill_lines, sum(p.qty*p.uc) po_val,
  sum(CASE WHEN l.qty>p.qty+1e-9 THEN (l.qty-p.qty)*l.unit_cost ELSE 0 END) qx
  FROM finance_vendor_bills b JOIN finance_vendor_bill_lines l USING(bill_id) JOIN pl p ON p.po_id=b.po_id AND p.sku=l.sku WHERE b.vendor_invoice_no NOT LIKE '%-R' GROUP BY ALL),
x AS (SELECT bl.*, vp.amount paid, d.year, po.purpose FROM bl JOIN finance_vendor_payments vp USING(bill_id) JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=bl.day JOIN erp_purchase_orders po ON po.po_id=bl.po_id)
SELECT year, count(*) FILTER (bill_lines>po_val+0.005) over_n,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN bill_lines>po_val+0.005 AND abs(paid-amount)<0.01 THEN bill_lines-po_val END),2) full_ex,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN purpose='stock' AND abs(paid-amount)<0.01 THEN qx END),2) stock_qty_full_ex,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN abs(paid-amount)<0.01 THEN freight END),2) frt_full,
 round(sum(po_val),0) po_val
FROM x GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT d.year, CASE WHEN coalesce(p.discontinued_on,'')='' THEN 'active' ELSE p.discontinued_on END coh, count(*) n, round(avg(pl.unit_cost/p.unit_cost),4) po_to_prod, round(min(pl.unit_cost/p.unit_cost),4) mn, round(max(pl.unit_cost/p.unit_cost),4) mx
FROM erp_purchase_order_lines pl JOIN erp_purchase_orders po USING(po_id) JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=po.day JOIN erp_products p ON p.sku=pl.sku
WHERE p.category='equipment' AND d.year IN (2016,2019,2022,2025) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT l.fulfilment, count(*) lines, sum(l.qty_ordered) qo, sum(l.qty_shipped) qs, count(*) FILTER (WHERE l.ship_day IS NOT NULL) n_shipday, round(avg(l.ship_day-o.day),1) avg_lag FROM erp_sales_order_lines l JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=o.day JOIN erp_products p USING(sku) WHERE p.category='equipment' AND p.refrigerant='R-454B' AND d.year=2025 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT d.year, l.fulfilment, CASE WHEN l.markdown_pct>0 THEN 'md' ELSE 'no_md' END k, count(*) n, round(avg(il.unit_price/l.unit_price),4) inv_to_order_price, sum(CASE WHEN abs(il.unit_price-l.unit_price)>0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) differs
FROM erp_sales_order_lines l JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=o.day JOIN erp_products p USING(sku) JOIN finance_invoice_lines il ON il.line_id=l.line_id
WHERE p.category='equipment' AND d.year IN (2022,2025) AND l.unit_price>0 GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2,3

-- memorylessness: does the previous over-PO bill's outcome (same vendor) predict this one's?
WITH pl AS (SELECT po_id, sku, sum(qty) qty, max(unit_cost) uc FROM erp_purchase_order_lines GROUP BY 1,2),
bl AS (SELECT b.bill_id, b.vendor_id, b.day, b.amount, sum(l.qty*l.unit_cost) bill_lines, sum(p.qty*p.uc) po_val
  FROM finance_vendor_bills b JOIN finance_vendor_bill_lines l USING(bill_id) JOIN pl p ON p.po_id=b.po_id AND p.sku=l.sku WHERE b.vendor_invoice_no NOT LIKE '%-R' GROUP BY ALL),
x AS (SELECT bl.*, (abs(vp.amount-bl.amount)<0.01) full_pay, vp.day pday FROM bl JOIN finance_vendor_payments vp USING(bill_id) WHERE bill_lines>po_val+0.005),
s AS (SELECT *, lag(full_pay) OVER (PARTITION BY vendor_id ORDER BY day, bill_id) prev_v, lag(full_pay) OVER (ORDER BY pday, bill_id) prev_any FROM x)
SELECT 'prev_same_vendor' k, prev_v::varchar v, count(*) n, round(avg(full_pay::int),3) full_rate FROM s WHERE prev_v IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1,2
UNION ALL SELECT 'prev_any_by_payday', prev_any::varchar, count(*), round(avg(full_pay::int),3) FROM s WHERE prev_any IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH p AS (SELECT sku, unit_cost mc, discontinued_on disc FROM erp_products WHERE category='equipment' AND refrigerant='R-410A'),
oh AS (SELECT sku, sum(qty_delta) q FROM wms_inventory_transactions JOIN p USING(sku) GROUP BY 1),
s AS (SELECT l.sku, d.year, sum(l.qty_shipped) u, sum(l.qty_shipped*l.unit_price) rev, sum(l.qty_shipped*l.unit_cost) cost
 FROM erp_sales_order_lines l JOIN p USING(sku) JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=o.day
 WHERE l.fulfilment IN ('stock','transfer') AND l.qty_shipped>0 AND d.year IN (2022,2024,2025) GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT p.disc, count(DISTINCT p.sku) skus,
 (SELECT round(sum(q),1) FROM oh JOIN p p2 USING(sku) WHERE p2.disc=p.disc) units_oh,
 (SELECT round(sum(q*p2.mc),2) FROM oh JOIN p p2 USING(sku) WHERE p2.disc=p.disc) value_oh,
 sum(CASE WHEN s.year=2022 THEN s.u END) u22, sum(CASE WHEN s.year=2024 THEN s.u END) u24, sum(CASE WHEN s.year=2025 THEN s.u END) u25,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN s.year=2022 THEN s.rev END)/sum(CASE WHEN s.year=2022 THEN s.cost END),4) pc22,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN s.year=2024 THEN s.rev END)/sum(CASE WHEN s.year=2024 THEN s.cost END),4) pc24,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN s.year=2025 THEN s.rev END)/sum(CASE WHEN s.year=2025 THEN s.cost END),4) pc25,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN s.year=2025 THEN s.rev-s.cost END),2) gm25
FROM p LEFT JOIN s USING(sku) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT p.discontinued_on coh, d.year, t.reason, round(sum(t.qty_delta),0) qty

GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2,3

WITH r AS (SELECT t.*, d.month FROM wms_inventory_transactions t JOIN erp_products p USING(sku) JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=t.day WHERE t.reason='receipt' AND p.category='equipment' AND p.refrigerant='R-454B' AND d.year=2025)
SELECT coalesce(po.purpose, 'via receipt:'||coalesce(po2.purpose,'nomatch')) purpose, count(*) n, sum(r.qty_delta) qty FROM r LEFT JOIN erp_purchase_orders po ON po.po_id=r.ref_id LEFT JOIN wms_receipts wr ON wr.receipt_id=r.ref_id LEFT JOIN erp_purchase_orders po2 ON po2.po_id=wr.po_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT CASE WHEN coalesce(p.discontinued_on,'')='' THEN 'active' ELSE p.discontinued_on END coh, d.year, round(sum(CASE WHEN l.fulfilment='stock' THEN l.qty_shipped END),0) stock_units, round(sum(CASE WHEN l.fulfilment='special' THEN l.qty_shipped END),0) special_units, round(sum(l.qty_ordered),0) ordered_units, count(DISTINCT o.customer_id) customers
