SELECT reason, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT ref_id) refs, min(ref_id) mn, max(ref_id) mx FROM wms_inventory_transactions GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH p AS (SELECT sku, discontinued_on disc FROM erp_products WHERE category='equipment' AND refrigerant='R-410A')
SELECT d.year, p.disc, sum(l.qty_shipped) u, round(sum(l.qty_shipped*l.unit_price)/sum(l.qty_shipped*l.unit_cost),4) pc
FROM erp_sales_order_lines l JOIN p USING(sku) JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=o.day
WHERE l.fulfilment IN ('stock','transfer') AND l.qty_shipped>0 GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2,1

WITH p AS (SELECT sku, discontinued_on disc FROM erp_products WHERE category='equipment' AND refrigerant='R-410A')
SELECT p.disc, d.year, po.purpose, sum(pl.qty) units, count(DISTINCT po.po_id) pos
FROM erp_purchase_orders po JOIN erp_purchase_order_lines pl USING(po_id) JOIN p USING(sku) JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=po.day
WHERE d.year IN (2016,2022,2023,2024,2025) GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2,3

WITH pl AS (SELECT po_id, sku, sum(qty) qty, max(unit_cost) uc, count(*) n FROM erp_purchase_order_lines GROUP BY 1,2),
bl AS (SELECT b.bill_id, b.vendor_id, b.po_id, b.day, b.amount, b.freight, b.vendor_invoice_no,
  sum(l.qty*l.unit_cost) bill_lines, sum(p.qty*p.uc) po_val,
  sum(CASE WHEN l.qty>p.qty+1e-9 THEN (l.qty-p.qty)*p.uc ELSE 0 END) qty_ex,
  sum(CASE WHEN l.unit_cost>p.uc+1e-9 THEN (l.unit_cost-p.uc)*l.qty ELSE 0 END) cost_ex
  FROM finance_vendor_bills b JOIN finance_vendor_bill_lines l USING(bill_id) JOIN pl p ON p.po_id=b.po_id AND p.sku=l.sku
  GROUP BY ALL),
x AS (SELECT bl.*, vp.amount paid FROM bl LEFT JOIN finance_vendor_payments vp USING(bill_id) WHERE vendor_invoice_no NOT LIKE '%-R')
SELECT CASE WHEN paid IS NULL THEN 'unpaid' WHEN abs(paid-amount)<0.01 THEN 'full' WHEN abs(paid-po_val)<0.01 THEN 'to_po' ELSE 'other' END st,
 bill_lines>po_val+0.005 over_po, count(*) n, round(sum(bill_lines-po_val),2) ex, round(sum(freight),2) frt, round(sum(qty_ex),2) qex, round(sum(cost_ex),2) cex,
 count(*) FILTER (freight>0) n_frt
FROM x GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

WITH po AS (SELECT o.po_id, o.day, o.expected_day, d.month FROM erp_purchase_orders o JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=o.day WHERE o.purpose='stock' AND d.year IN (2024,2025) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM erp_purchase_order_lines l JOIN erp_products p USING(sku) WHERE l.po_id=o.po_id AND p.category='equipment' AND p.refrigerant='R-454B')),
r AS (SELECT po_id, min(day) rday FROM wms_receipts GROUP BY 1)
SELECT d.year, po.month, count(*) pos, round(avg(expected_day-po.day),1) quoted_lead, round(avg(rday-po.day),1) actual_lead, round(avg(rday-expected_day),1) late_by, count(*) FILTER (WHERE rday IS NULL) not_recv FROM po LEFT JOIN r USING(po_id) JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=po.day GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

WITH p AS (SELECT sku, unit_cost mc, list_price lp, discontinued_on disc FROM erp_products WHERE category='equipment' AND refrigerant='R-410A')
SELECT p.disc, l.fulfilment, count(*) lines, round(sum(l.qty_shipped*l.unit_price)/sum(l.qty_shipped*l.unit_cost),4) pc, round(avg(p.lp/p.mc),4) avg_list_to_cost
FROM erp_sales_order_lines l JOIN p USING(sku) JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=o.day
WHERE l.qty_shipped>0 AND d.year BETWEEN 2022 AND 2025 GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH s AS (SELECT o.customer_id, l.sku, o.day, l.line_id FROM erp_sales_order_lines l JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) JOIN erp_products p USING(sku) JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=o.day WHERE l.fulfilment='short' AND p.category='equipment' AND p.refrigerant='R-454B' AND d.year=2025),
a AS (SELECT o.customer_id, l.sku, o.day, l.fulfilment FROM erp_sales_order_lines l JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) JOIN erp_products p USING(sku) WHERE p.category='equipment' AND p.refrigerant='R-454B' AND o.day>=2269)
SELECT count(*) short_lines,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM a WHERE a.customer_id=s.customer_id AND a.sku=s.sku AND a.day>s.day AND a.day<=s.day+21)) reordered_same_sku_21d,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM a WHERE a.customer_id=s.customer_id AND a.sku=s.sku AND a.day>s.day AND a.day<=s.day+21 AND a.fulfilment<>'short')) refilled_same_sku_21d,
 count(DISTINCT customer_id) customers FROM s

SELECT CASE WHEN coalesce(p.discontinued_on,'')='' THEN 'active' ELSE p.discontinued_on END coh, d.year, count(*) n, round(sum(vc.qty),0) qty, round(sum(vc.amount),0) amount
FROM finance_vendor_credits vc JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=vc.day JOIN erp_products p USING(sku)
WHERE p.category='equipment' AND d.year>=2022 GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH p AS (SELECT sku, unit_cost mc, discontinued_on disc FROM erp_products WHERE category='equipment' AND refrigerant='R-410A')
SELECT p.disc, d.year, count(*) bill_lines, round(sum(bl.qty*bl.unit_cost)/sum(bl.qty*p.mc),4) billed_to_master, round(min(bl.unit_cost/p.mc),4) mn, round(max(bl.unit_cost/p.mc),4) mx
FROM finance_vendor_bill_lines bl JOIN p USING(sku) JOIN finance_vendor_bills b USING(bill_id) JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=b.day
WHERE d.year>=2022 GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT CASE WHEN coalesce(p.discontinued_on,'')='' THEN 'active' ELSE p.discontinued_on END coh, d.year, count(*) n, round(avg(bl.unit_cost/p.unit_cost),4) bill_to_prod, round(min(bl.unit_cost/p.unit_cost),4) mn, round(max(bl.unit_cost/p.unit_cost),4) mx
FROM finance_vendor_bill_lines bl JOIN finance_vendor_bills b USING(bill_id) JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=b.day JOIN erp_products p ON p.sku=bl.sku
WHERE p.category='equipment' AND d.year IN (2022,2025) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH oh AS (SELECT sku, branch, sum(qty_delta) onhand, sum(qty_delta*unit_cost) txn_val, -sum(CASE WHEN reason='sale' AND day>=2269 THEN qty_delta ELSE 0 END) s25 FROM wms_inventory_transactions GROUP BY sku, branch)
SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE onhand<-0.01) n_neg, round(sum(onhand*p.unit_cost) FILTER (WHERE onhand<-0.01),2) neg_val, round(sum(o.onhand*p.unit_cost) FILTER (WHERE onhand>0.01),2) pos_val_master, round(sum(o.txn_val) FILTER (WHERE onhand>0.01),2) pos_val_txncost, round(sum(o.onhand*p.unit_cost) FILTER (WHERE onhand>0.01 AND onhand>2*s25),2) flag_master, round(sum(o.txn_val) FILTER (WHERE onhand>0.01 AND onhand>2*s25),2) flag_txncost, count(*) FILTER (WHERE onhand<>round(onhand)) n_fractional FROM oh o JOIN erp_products p USING(sku)

WITH r AS (SELECT sku, branch, day, txn_id, sum(qty_delta) OVER (PARTITION BY sku, branch ORDER BY day, txn_id) bal FROM wms_inventory_transactions)
SELECT count(*) txns, count(*) FILTER (bal < -1e-6) neg_rows, count(DISTINCT sku||branch) FILTER (bal < -1e-6) neg_sku_branch, round(min(bal),2) min_bal,
 round((14170+875)*1.0/(14170+875+6115+345),3) freight_full_rate_check
FROM r

WITH p AS (SELECT sku, coalesce(nullif(refrigerant,''),'none') refr, discontinued_on disc FROM erp_products WHERE category='equipment'),
x AS (SELECT p.refr, coalesce(p.disc,'never') disc, d.year, CASE WHEN p.disc IS NOT NULL AND d.date>=CAST(p.disc AS DATE) THEN 'after_disc' ELSE 'before_disc' END phase,
 l.qty_shipped q, l.unit_price pr, l.unit_cost c
 FROM erp_sales_order_lines l JOIN p USING(sku) JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=o.day
 WHERE l.fulfilment IN ('stock','transfer') AND l.qty_shipped>0)
SELECT refr, disc, phase, sum(q) units, round(sum(q*pr)/sum(q*c),4) pc, round(sum(q*(pr-c)),2) gm
FROM x GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2,3

SELECT d.month, count(*) stock_lines, round(sum(l.qty_shipped),0) units, round(avg(l.markdown_pct),4) avg_md,
 round(sum(l.qty_shipped*l.unit_price*l.markdown_pct/(1-l.markdown_pct)),0) md_actual,
 round(sum(l.qty_shipped*l.unit_price/(1-l.markdown_pct)*0.42),0) md_if_42,
 round(sum(l.qty_shipped*(l.unit_price/(1-l.markdown_pct)*0.58 - l.unit_cost)),0) margin_if_42
FROM erp_sales_order_lines l JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=o.day JOIN erp_products p USING(sku)
WHERE p.discontinued_on='2025-01-01' AND l.fulfilment='stock' AND d.year=2025 GROUP BY ROLLUP(1) ORDER BY 1 NULLS LAST

SELECT coalesce(p.refrigerant,'none') refr, d.year, round(sum(l.qty_ordered),0) ordered, round(sum(CASE WHEN l.fulfilment='stock' THEN l.qty_shipped END),0) stock_units, round(avg(CASE WHEN l.fulfilment='stock' THEN l.markdown_pct END),4) avg_stock_md
FROM erp_sales_order_lines l JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=o.day JOIN erp_products p USING(sku)
WHERE p.discontinued_on='2023-01-01' AND d.year>=2021 GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH p AS (SELECT sku, discontinued_on disc FROM erp_products WHERE category='equipment' AND discontinued_on IS NOT NULL AND discontinued_on<>''),
s AS (SELECT d.year, sum(l.qty_shipped) u, round(sum(l.qty_shipped*(l.unit_price-l.unit_cost)),2) gm, round(sum(l.qty_shipped*l.unit_price)/sum(l.qty_shipped*l.unit_cost),4) pc
 FROM erp_sales_order_lines l JOIN p USING(sku) JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=o.day
 WHERE l.fulfilment IN ('stock','transfer') AND l.qty_shipped>0 AND d.date>=CAST(p.disc AS DATE) GROUP BY 1),
b AS (SELECT d.year, sum(pl.qty) po_u, round(sum(pl.qty*pl.unit_cost),2) po_val
 FROM erp_purchase_orders po JOIN erp_purchase_order_lines pl USING(po_id) JOIN p USING(sku) JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=po.day
 WHERE po.purpose='stock' AND d.date>=CAST(p.disc AS DATE) GROUP BY 1)
SELECT s.year, s.u post_disc_stock_units, s.gm post_disc_gm, s.pc, b.po_u post_disc_stock_po_units, b.po_val FROM s LEFT JOIN b USING(year) ORDER BY 1

WITH p AS (SELECT sku, discontinued_on disc FROM erp_products WHERE category='equipment' AND refrigerant='R-410A' AND discontinued_on='2025-01-01')
SELECT d.quarter, l.fulfilment, count(*) lines, round(sum(l.qty_shipped*l.unit_price)/sum(l.qty_shipped*l.unit_cost),4) pc, round(sum(l.qty_shipped*l.unit_cost),2) cost
FROM erp_sales_order_lines l JOIN p USING(sku) JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=o.day
WHERE l.qty_shipped>0 AND d.year=2025 GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH oh AS (SELECT sku, branch, sum(qty_delta) onhand, -sum(CASE WHEN reason='sale' AND day>=2269 THEN qty_delta ELSE 0 END) s25, -sum(CASE WHEN reason IN ('sale','transfer out') AND day>=2269 THEN qty_delta ELSE 0 END) out25 FROM wms_inventory_transactions GROUP BY sku, branch),
p AS (SELECT o.*, o.onhand*pr.unit_cost val, GREATEST(o.onhand-2*o.s25,0)*pr.unit_cost surplus_val FROM oh o JOIN erp_products pr USING(sku))

 count(*) FILTER (WHERE onhand>2*s25 AND onhand>0.01) n_over2, round(sum(val) FILTER (WHERE onhand>2*s25 AND onhand>0.01),2) val_over2,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE round(onhand,4)>round(2*s25,4) AND onhand>0.01) n_over2_rounded, round(sum(val) FILTER (WHERE round(onhand,4)>round(2*s25,4) AND onhand>0.01),2) val_over2_rounded,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE abs(onhand-2*s25)<0.001 AND onhand>0.01) n_borderline, round(sum(val) FILTER (WHERE abs(onhand-2*s25)<0.001 AND onhand>0.01),2) val_borderline
FROM p

WITH b AS (SELECT d.year, p.discontinued_on coh, coalesce(p.refrigerant,'none') refr, l.qty_shipped*l.unit_price*l.markdown_pct/(1-l.markdown_pct) md, l.qty_shipped*(l.unit_price-l.unit_cost) gm, l.qty_shipped q
FROM erp_sales_order_lines l JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=o.day JOIN erp_products p USING(sku)
WHERE l.markdown_pct>0 AND l.fulfilment='stock' AND d.year IN (2022,2025))
SELECT round(sum(CASE WHEN year=2022 THEN md END),0) md2022, round(sum(CASE WHEN year=2025 THEN md END),0) md2025,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN year=2025 THEN md END)-sum(CASE WHEN year=2022 THEN md END),0) incr,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN year=2025 AND coh IN ('2015-01-01','2023-01-01') THEN md END),0) md2025_restocked,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN year=2025 AND coh IN ('2015-01-01','2023-01-01') THEN gm END),0) gm2025_restocked,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN year=2025 AND coh IN ('2015-01-01','2023-01-01') THEN md+gm END),0) gm_if_no_md_same_volume,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN year=2025 AND refr='R-410A' THEN md END)/sum(CASE WHEN year=2025 THEN md END),4) r410_share_2025,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN year=2022 AND refr='R-410A' THEN md END)/sum(CASE WHEN year=2022 THEN md END),4) r410_share_2022,
 round((sum(CASE WHEN year=2025 AND refr='R-410A' THEN md END) - 644487 + 2397009)/(sum(CASE WHEN year=2025 THEN md END) - 644487 + 2397009),4) r410_share_2025_if_cohort25_at42
FROM b

SELECT p.discontinued_on coh, d.year, round(sum(sum(t.qty_delta)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.discontinued_on ORDER BY d.year),0) on_hand_end_of_year

WHERE p.category='equipment' AND coalesce(p.discontinued_on,'')<>'' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

dm AS (SELECT l.sku, o.branch, sum(l.qty_ordered) FILTER (WHERE fulfilment IN ('stock','transfer','short')) sr25, sum(l.qty_ordered) FILTER (WHERE fulfilment IN ('stock','transfer','short') AND d.month BETWEEN 5 AND 8) sr25_season, sum(l.qty_ordered) FILTER (WHERE fulfilment='short') short25 FROM erp_sales_order_lines l JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=o.day WHERE d.year=2025 GROUP BY 1,2),
x AS (SELECT oh.*, coalesce(sr25,0) sr25, coalesce(sr25_season,0) sr25_season, coalesce(short25,0) short25, p.unit_cost c, p.discontinued_on FROM oh JOIN erp_products p USING(sku) LEFT JOIN dm USING(sku,branch) WHERE p.category='equipment' AND p.refrigerant='R-454B' AND oh.onhand>0.01)
SELECT discontinued_on IS NULL active, count(*) n, round(sum(onhand),0) units, round(sum(sr25),0) sr_units, round(sum(sr25_season),0) season_units, round(sum(short25),0) short_units, round(sum(onhand*c),0) val,
 round(sum(onhand*c) FILTER (WHERE onhand>2*sr25),0) val_over2_on_stockroute, round(sum(GREATEST(onhand-2*sr25,0)*c),0) surplus_over2_stockroute,
 round(sum(GREATEST(onhand-sr25_season,0)*c),0) above_one_season, count(*) FILTER (WHERE sr25=0) n_no_demand, round(sum(onhand*c) FILTER (WHERE sr25=0),0) val_no_demand
FROM x GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC

WITH p AS (SELECT sku, coalesce(nullif(refrigerant,''),'none') refr, discontinued_on disc FROM erp_products WHERE category='equipment'),

 l.qty_shipped q, l.unit_price pr, l.unit_cost c

SELECT refr, phase, year, sum(q) units, round(sum(q*c),2) cost, round(sum(q*pr)/sum(q*c),4) pc FROM x GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2,3

WITH l AS (SELECT d.month, l.qty_shipped q, l.unit_price/(1-l.markdown_pct) list_net, l.unit_cost c, l.qty_shipped*l.unit_price*l.markdown_pct/(1-l.markdown_pct) md
FROM erp_sales_order_lines l JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=o.day JOIN erp_products p USING(sku)
WHERE p.discontinued_on='2025-01-01' AND l.fulfilment='stock' AND d.year=2025)
SELECT round(sum(q),0) units, round(sum(md),0) md_2025_actual,
 round(sum(q*list_net*least(0.42, 0.021*(month+11))),0) md_2026_schedule_same_volume,
 round(sum(q*(list_net*(1-least(0.42, 0.021*(month+11)))-c)),0) margin_2026_schedule_same_volume,
 round(sum(q*list_net*least(0.42, 0.021*(month+11)))/sum(q*list_net),4) avg_md_2026_schedule,
 round(sum(q*list_net)/sum(q),2) avg_list_net_per_unit,
 round(sum(q*c)/sum(q),2) avg_cost_per_unit,
 round(3442*sum(q*list_net)/sum(q)*0.42,0) md_on_3442_onhand_at_42,
 round(3442*(sum(q*list_net)/sum(q)*0.58 - sum(q*c)/sum(q)),0) margin_on_3442_onhand_at_42
FROM l

WITH b AS (SELECT d.year, p.discontinued_on coh, coalesce(p.refrigerant,'none') refr, l.qty_shipped*l.unit_price*l.markdown_pct/(1-l.markdown_pct) md, l.qty_shipped*(l.unit_price-l.unit_cost) gm
FROM erp_sales_order_lines l JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=o.day JOIN erp_products p USING(sku)
WHERE l.markdown_pct>0 AND l.fulfilment='stock' AND d.year IN (2022,2025))
SELECT round(sum(CASE WHEN year=2025 THEN md END),0) md2025,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN year=2025 AND refr='R-410A' THEN md END),0) md2025_r410,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN year=2025 AND coh IN ('2015-01-01','2023-01-01') THEN md END),0) md2025_restocked,
 round(-sum(CASE WHEN year=2025 AND coh IN ('2015-01-01','2023-01-01') THEN gm END),0) loss_avoided_if_not_stocked,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN year=2025 AND coh IN ('2015-01-01','2023-01-01') THEN md+gm END),0) gm_if_no_md_same_volume,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN year=2025 AND coh='2023-01-01' THEN md END)/(sum(CASE WHEN year=2025 THEN md END)-sum(CASE WHEN year=2022 THEN md END)),4) cohort2023_share_of_rise,
 round((sum(CASE WHEN year=2025 AND refr='R-410A' THEN md END) - 644487 + 2079237)/(sum(CASE WHEN year=2025 THEN md END) - 644487 + 2079237),4) r410_share_if_2026_schedule
FROM b

WITH cy AS (
  SELECT o.customer_id, d.year, count(*) n_orders
  FROM erp_sales_orders o JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=o.day GROUP BY 1,2),
act AS (
  SELECT a.customer_id, a.year, a.n_orders,
         (b.customer_id IS NULL) AS lapsed
  FROM cy a LEFT JOIN cy b ON b.customer_id=a.customer_id AND b.year=a.year+1
  WHERE a.year BETWEEN 2016 AND 2024)
SELECT c.branch, count(*) n_cust_years, sum(lapsed::int) lapsed, round(avg(lapsed::int),4) lapse_rate
FROM act JOIN erp_customers c USING(customer_id)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY lapse_rate DESC, branch

WITH cy AS (
  SELECT o.customer_id, d.year, count(*) n_orders
  FROM erp_sales_orders o JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=o.day GROUP BY 1,2),
act AS (
  SELECT a.customer_id, a.year, a.n_orders, (b.customer_id IS NULL)::int AS lapsed,
    CASE WHEN a.n_orders<=5 THEN '1:1-5' WHEN a.n_orders<=20 THEN '2:6-20' WHEN a.n_orders<=60 THEN '3:21-60' WHEN a.n_orders<=150 THEN '4:61-150' ELSE '5:151+' END band
  FROM cy a LEFT JOIN cy b ON b.customer_id=a.customer_id AND b.year=a.year+1
  WHERE a.year BETWEEN 2016 AND 2024)
SELECT band, count(*) n, sum(lapsed) lapsed, round(avg(lapsed),4) rate FROM act GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH p AS (SELECT sku, discontinued_on disc FROM erp_products WHERE category='equipment' AND discontinued_on IS NOT NULL AND discontinued_on<>'')
SELECT l.fulfilment, LEAST(floor(date_diff('month', CAST(p.disc AS DATE), d.date)/12),3) yrs_since_disc,
 count(*) lines, sum(l.qty_shipped) units, round(sum(l.qty_shipped*l.unit_price)/sum(l.qty_shipped*l.unit_cost),4) pc,
 round(sum(l.qty_shipped*(l.unit_price-l.unit_cost)),2) gm
FROM erp_sales_order_lines l JOIN p USING(sku) JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=o.day
WHERE l.qty_shipped>0 AND d.date>=CAST(p.disc AS DATE)
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH cy AS (
  SELECT o.customer_id, d.year, count(*) n_orders
  FROM erp_sales_orders o JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=o.day GROUP BY 1,2),
act AS (
  SELECT a.customer_id, a.year, (b.customer_id IS NULL)::int AS lapsed,
    CASE WHEN a.n_orders<=5 THEN 1 WHEN a.n_orders<=20 THEN 2 WHEN a.n_orders<=60 THEN 3 WHEN a.n_orders<=150 THEN 4 ELSE 5 END band
  FROM cy a LEFT JOIN cy b ON b.customer_id=a.customer_id AND b.year=a.year+1
  WHERE a.year BETWEEN 2016 AND 2024),
x AS (SELECT act.*, c.branch, c.trade, c.rep_id FROM act JOIN erp_customers c USING(customer_id)),
cell AS (SELECT band, trade, year, avg(lapsed) p FROM x GROUP BY 1,2,3),
e AS (SELECT x.*, cell.p FROM x JOIN cell USING(band,trade,year))
SELECT branch, count(*) n, sum(lapsed) obs, round(sum(p),1) expct, round(sum(lapsed)/sum(p),3) oe,
  round((sum(lapsed)-sum(p))/sqrt(sum(p*(1-p))),2) z
FROM e GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY z DESC, branch

WITH p AS (SELECT sku, coalesce(nullif(refrigerant,''),'none') refr, discontinued_on disc FROM erp_products WHERE category='equipment' AND discontinued_on IS NOT NULL AND discontinued_on<>''),
x AS (SELECT d.year, p.refr, l.fulfilment f, l.qty_shipped q, l.unit_price pr, l.unit_cost c
 FROM erp_sales_order_lines l JOIN p USING(sku) JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=o.day
 WHERE l.qty_shipped>0 AND d.date>=CAST(p.disc AS DATE) AND d.year BETWEEN 2023 AND 2025),
y AS (SELECT year,
 sum(CASE WHEN f='stock' THEN q END) stock_units,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN f='stock' THEN q*c END),2) stock_cost,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN f='stock' THEN q*(pr-c) END),2) stock_gm,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN f='stock' AND refr='R-410A' THEN q*(pr-c) END),2) stock_gm_r410a,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN f<>'stock' THEN q*pr END)/sum(CASE WHEN f<>'stock' THEN q*c END),4) nonstock_pc,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN f='stock' THEN q*pr END)/sum(CASE WHEN f='stock' THEN q*c END),4) stock_pc
 FROM x GROUP BY 1)
SELECT *, round(stock_cost*nonstock_pc - (stock_cost+stock_gm),2) gap_to_nonstock_price FROM y
UNION ALL
SELECT 9999, sum(stock_units), sum(stock_cost), sum(stock_gm), sum(stock_gm_r410a), NULL, NULL, round(sum(stock_cost*nonstock_pc-(stock_cost+stock_gm)),2) FROM y
UNION ALL
SELECT 9998, round(sum(stock_units)/3,1), round(sum(stock_cost)/3,2), round(-sum(stock_gm)/3,2), round(-sum(stock_gm_r410a)/3,2), NULL, NULL, round(sum(stock_cost*nonstock_pc-(stock_cost+stock_gm))/3,2) FROM y
ORDER BY 1

WITH cy AS (
  SELECT o.customer_id, d.year, count(*) n_orders
  FROM erp_sales_orders o JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=o.day GROUP BY 1,2),
act AS (
  SELECT a.customer_id, a.year, (b.customer_id IS NULL)::int AS lapsed,
    CASE WHEN a.n_orders<=5 THEN 1 WHEN a.n_orders<=20 THEN 2 WHEN a.n_orders<=60 THEN 3 WHEN a.n_orders<=150 THEN 4 ELSE 5 END band
  FROM cy a LEFT JOIN cy b ON b.customer_id=a.customer_id AND b.year=a.year+1
  WHERE a.year BETWEEN 2016 AND 2024),
x AS (SELECT act.*, c.branch, c.trade, c.rep_id FROM act JOIN erp_customers c USING(customer_id)),
cell AS (SELECT band, trade, year, avg(lapsed) p FROM x GROUP BY 1,2,3),
e AS (SELECT x.*, cell.p FROM x JOIN cell USING(band,trade,year)),
r AS (SELECT branch, rep_id, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT customer_id) ncust, sum(lapsed) obs, sum(p) ex, sum(p*(1-p)) v FROM e GROUP BY 1,2),
rb AS (SELECT branch, sum(n) n, sum(obs) obs, sum(ex) ex, sum(v) v FROM r GROUP BY 1)
SELECT 'rep' lvl, count(*) groups, round(sum((obs-ex)^2/v),2) chi2, min(n) min_n, max(n) max_n,
  round(min(obs/ex),3) min_oe, round(max(obs/ex),3) max_oe,
  sum(CASE WHEN abs(obs-ex)/sqrt(v)>1.96 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) n_abs_z_gt_196,
  sum(CASE WHEN abs(obs-ex)/sqrt(v)>3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) n_abs_z_gt_3
FROM r
UNION ALL
SELECT 'branch', count(*), round(sum((obs-ex)^2/v),2), min(n), max(n), round(min(obs/ex),3), round(max(obs/ex),3),
  sum(CASE WHEN abs(obs-ex)/sqrt(v)>1.96 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), sum(CASE WHEN abs(obs-ex)/sqrt(v)>3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
FROM rb ORDER BY lvl

WITH cy AS (
  SELECT o.customer_id, d.year, count(*) n_orders
  FROM erp_sales_orders o JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=o.day GROUP BY 1,2),
lap AS (
  SELECT a.customer_id, a.year
  FROM cy a LEFT JOIN cy b ON b.customer_id=a.customer_id AND b.year=a.year+1
  WHERE a.year BETWEEN 2016 AND 2024 AND b.customer_id IS NULL)
SELECT lap.year, count(*) lapsed,
  sum(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cy z WHERE z.customer_id=lap.customer_id AND z.year>lap.year+1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) came_back_later
FROM lap GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH cy AS (
  SELECT o.customer_id, d.year, count(*) n_orders
  FROM erp_sales_orders o JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=o.day GROUP BY 1,2),
act AS (
  SELECT a.customer_id, a.year, (b.customer_id IS NULL)::int AS lapsed,
    CASE WHEN a.n_orders<=5 THEN 1 WHEN a.n_orders<=20 THEN 2 WHEN a.n_orders<=60 THEN 3 WHEN a.n_orders<=150 THEN 4 ELSE 5 END band
  FROM cy a LEFT JOIN cy b ON b.customer_id=a.customer_id AND b.year=a.year+1
  WHERE a.year BETWEEN 2016 AND 2024),
x AS (SELECT act.*, c.branch, c.trade, c.rep_id FROM act JOIN erp_customers c USING(customer_id)),
cell AS (SELECT band, trade, year, avg(lapsed) p FROM x GROUP BY 1,2,3),
e AS (SELECT x.*, cell.p FROM x JOIN cell USING(band,trade,year)),
rb AS (SELECT branch, sum(lapsed)/sum(p) boe FROM e GROUP BY 1),
e2 AS (SELECT e.*, p*boe AS p2 FROM e JOIN rb USING(branch)),
r AS (SELECT branch, rep_id, sum(lapsed) obs, sum(p2) ex, sum(p2*(1-p2)) v FROM e2 GROUP BY 1,2),
s AS (SELECT sum((obs-ex)^2/v) chi2, count(*)-12 df FROM r)
SELECT round(chi2,2) chi2_rep_within_branch, df,
  round(((chi2/df)^(1.0/3) - (1-2.0/(9*df)))/sqrt(2.0/(9*df)),2) wh_z_rep,
  round(((32.85/11)^(1.0/3) - (1-2.0/(9*11)))/sqrt(2.0/(9*11)),2) wh_z_branch_q262
FROM s

WITH cy AS (
  SELECT o.customer_id, d.year, count(*) n_orders
  FROM erp_sales_orders o JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=o.day GROUP BY 1,2),
act AS (
  SELECT a.customer_id, a.year, (b.customer_id IS NULL)::int AS lapsed,
    CASE WHEN a.n_orders<=5 THEN 1 WHEN a.n_orders<=20 THEN 2 WHEN a.n_orders<=60 THEN 3 WHEN a.n_orders<=150 THEN 4 ELSE 5 END band
  FROM cy a LEFT JOIN cy b ON b.customer_id=a.customer_id AND b.year=a.year+1
  WHERE a.year BETWEEN 2016 AND 2024),
x AS (SELECT act.*, c.branch, c.trade FROM act JOIN erp_customers c USING(customer_id)),
cell AS (SELECT band, trade, year, avg(lapsed) p FROM x GROUP BY 1,2,3),
e AS (SELECT x.*, cell.p, CASE WHEN year<=2019 THEN 'a2016_19' ELSE 'b2020_24' END half FROM x JOIN cell USING(band,trade,year))
SELECT branch,
  sum(CASE WHEN half='a2016_19' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) n_a,
  round(sum(CASE WHEN half='a2016_19' THEN lapsed END)/sum(CASE WHEN half='a2016_19' THEN p END),3) oe_2016_19,
  sum(CASE WHEN half='b2020_24' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) n_b,
  round(sum(CASE WHEN half='b2020_24' THEN lapsed END)/sum(CASE WHEN half='b2020_24' THEN p END),3) oe_2020_24
FROM e GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY oe_2016_19 DESC, branch

SELECT d.year, o.purpose, sum(l.qty) qty, round(sum(l.qty*l.unit_cost),0) val, count(DISTINCT o.po_id) pos FROM erp_purchase_orders o JOIN erp_purchase_order_lines l USING(po_id) JOIN erp_products p USING(sku) JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=o.day WHERE p.category='equipment' AND p.refrigerant='R-410A' AND d.year BETWEEN 2022 AND 2025 GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT d.year, p.refrigerant, sum(l.qty_ordered) FILTER (WHERE fulfilment IN ('stock','transfer','short')) stockroute_units, sum(l.qty_ordered) units_all, sum(l.qty_ordered) FILTER (WHERE fulfilment='short') short_units FROM erp_sales_order_lines l JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=o.day JOIN erp_products p USING(sku) WHERE p.category='equipment' AND p.refrigerant IS NOT NULL AND d.year BETWEEN 2022 AND 2025 GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

WITH r AS (SELECT * FROM finance_vendor_bills WHERE vendor_invoice_no LIKE '%-R'),
o AS (SELECT * FROM finance_vendor_bills WHERE vendor_invoice_no NOT LIKE '%-R'),
pr AS (SELECT r.bill_id rid, r.amount ra, r.day rday, o.bill_id oid, o.amount oa, o.day oday, o.vendor_invoice_no ono, r.vendor_invoice_no rno
 FROM r LEFT JOIN o ON o.po_id=r.po_id)
SELECT count(*) pairs, count(DISTINCT rid) r_bills, count(oid) with_orig, count(DISTINCT oid) orig_bills,
 sum(CASE WHEN abs(ra-oa)<0.005 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) same_amt,
 sum(CASE WHEN oday<rday THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) orig_earlier,
 sum(CASE WHEN rno = ono||'-R' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) same_no,
 min(rday-oday) min_gap, median(rday-oday) med_gap, max(rday-oday) max_gap
FROM pr

WITH cy AS (
  SELECT o.customer_id, d.year, count(*) n_orders
  FROM erp_sales_orders o JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=o.day GROUP BY 1,2),
act AS (
  SELECT a.customer_id, a.year, (b.customer_id IS NULL)::int AS lapsed,
    CASE WHEN a.n_orders<=5 THEN 1 WHEN a.n_orders<=20 THEN 2 WHEN a.n_orders<=60 THEN 3 WHEN a.n_orders<=150 THEN 4 ELSE 5 END band
  FROM cy a LEFT JOIN cy b ON b.customer_id=a.customer_id AND b.year=a.year+1
  WHERE a.year BETWEEN 2016 AND 2024),
x AS (SELECT act.*, c.branch, c.trade,
   CASE WHEN c.onboarded_day<=0 THEN 'pre-2016' WHEN od.year=act.year THEN 'onboarded same year' ELSE 'onboarded earlier in records' END tenure
  FROM act JOIN erp_customers c USING(customer_id) LEFT JOIN dim_date od ON od.day=c.onboarded_day)
SELECT tenure, band, count(*) n, sum(lapsed) lapsed, round(avg(lapsed),4) rate FROM x GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH r AS (SELECT * FROM finance_vendor_bills WHERE vendor_invoice_no LIKE '%-R'),
pr AS (SELECT r.bill_id rid, r.amount ra, o.bill_id oid, r.po_id, r.day rday FROM r JOIN finance_vendor_bills o ON o.po_id=r.po_id AND o.vendor_invoice_no NOT LIKE '%-R'),
p AS (SELECT bill_id, count(*) n, sum(amount) amt FROM finance_vendor_payments GROUP BY bill_id),
rc AS (SELECT po_id, count(*) nrec FROM wms_receipts GROUP BY po_id)
SELECT (pr.rid IN (SELECT bill_id FROM p)) r_paid, (pr.oid IN (SELECT bill_id FROM p)) o_paid,
 coalesce(rc.nrec,0) nrec, count(*) n, round(sum(ra),2) r_amt,
 round(sum(pp.amt),2) r_paid_amt, round(sum(po.amt),2) o_paid_amt
FROM pr LEFT JOIN rc USING(po_id) LEFT JOIN p pp ON pp.bill_id=pr.rid LEFT JOIN p po ON po.bill_id=pr.oid
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3

WITH cy AS (
  SELECT o.customer_id, d.year, count(*) n_orders
  FROM erp_sales_orders o JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=o.day GROUP BY 1,2),
act AS (
  SELECT a.customer_id, a.year, (b.customer_id IS NULL)::int AS lapsed,
    CASE WHEN a.n_orders<=5 THEN 1 WHEN a.n_orders<=20 THEN 2 WHEN a.n_orders<=60 THEN 3 WHEN a.n_orders<=150 THEN 4 ELSE 5 END band
  FROM cy a LEFT JOIN cy b ON b.customer_id=a.customer_id AND b.year=a.year+1
  WHERE a.year BETWEEN 2016 AND 2024),
x AS (SELECT act.*, c.branch, c.trade, c.rep_id,
   CASE WHEN c.onboarded_day<=0 THEN 0 WHEN od.year=act.year THEN 2 ELSE 1 END ten
  FROM act JOIN erp_customers c USING(customer_id) LEFT JOIN dim_date od ON od.day=c.onboarded_day),
cell AS (SELECT band, trade, year, ten, avg(lapsed) p FROM x GROUP BY ALL),
e AS (SELECT x.*, cell.p FROM x JOIN cell USING(band,trade,year,ten)),
b AS (SELECT branch, count(*) n, sum(x_pre) pre, sum(lapsed) obs, sum(p) ex, sum(p*(1-p)) v FROM (SELECT *, (ten=0)::int x_pre FROM e) GROUP BY 1),
s AS (SELECT sum((obs-ex)^2/v) chi2 FROM b)
SELECT branch, n, round(pre/n,3) share_pre2016, obs, round(ex,1) ex, round(obs/ex,3) oe, round((obs-ex)/sqrt(v),2) z,
  (SELECT round(chi2,2) FROM s) chi2_all,
  (SELECT round((((chi2/11)^(1.0/3)) - (1-2.0/99))/sqrt(2.0/99),2) FROM s) wh_z

  FROM cy a LEFT JOIN cy b ON b.customer_id=a.customer_id AND b.year=a.year+1
  WHERE a.year BETWEEN 2016 AND 2024),
x AS (SELECT act.*, c.branch, c.trade, c.rep_id,
   CASE WHEN c.onboarded_day<=0 THEN 0 WHEN od.year=act.year THEN 2 ELSE 1 END ten
  FROM act JOIN erp_customers c USING(customer_id) LEFT JOIN dim_date od ON od.day=c.onboarded_day),
cell AS (SELECT band, trade, year, ten, avg(lapsed) p FROM x GROUP BY ALL),
e AS (SELECT x.*, cell.p FROM x JOIN cell USING(band,trade,year,ten)),
rb AS (SELECT branch, sum(lapsed)/sum(p) boe FROM e GROUP BY 1),
e2 AS (SELECT e.*, least(p*boe,0.999) p2 FROM e JOIN rb USING(branch)),
r AS (SELECT branch, rep_id, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT customer_id) ncust, sum(lapsed) obs, sum(p2) ex, sum(p2*(1-p2)) v FROM e2 GROUP BY 1,2),
s AS (SELECT sum((obs-ex)^2/v) chi2, count(*)-12 df FROM r)
SELECT branch, rep_id, n, ncust, obs, round(ex,1) ex_given_branch, round(obs/ex,3) oe_within_branch, round((obs-ex)/sqrt(v),2) z,
  (SELECT round(chi2,2) FROM s) chi2, (SELECT df FROM s) df,
  (SELECT round((((chi2/df)^(1.0/3)) - (1-2.0/(9*df)))/sqrt(2.0/(9*df)),2) FROM s) wh_z
FROM r ORDER BY abs((obs-ex)/sqrt(v)) DESC, rep_id LIMIT 8

WITH c AS (SELECT customer_id, count(*) n, avg((status='won')::int) p FROM crm_quotes GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>=50)
SELECT count(*) custs, round(corr(c.p, e.discount_pct),4) corr_disc, round(corr(c.p, e.credit_limit),4) corr_credit, round(corr(c.p, e.terms_days),4) corr_terms, round(corr(c.p, e.onboarded_day),4) corr_onboard, round(corr(c.p, ln(c.n)),4) corr_lnquotes FROM c JOIN erp_customers e USING(customer_id)
SELECT e.trade, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT q.customer_id) custs, round(avg((q.status='won')::int),4) win FROM crm_quotes q JOIN erp_customers e USING(customer_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT q.branch, count(*) n, round(avg((q.status='won')::int),4) win, round(avg(e.discount_pct),4) avg_disc, round(avg((e.discount_pct=0)::int),4) share_zero_disc FROM crm_quotes q JOIN erp_customers e USING(customer_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY win

WITH il AS (SELECT DISTINCT line_id FROM finance_invoice_lines),
l AS (SELECT l.*, il.line_id IS NULL AND l.qty_shipped>0 AND l.ship_day<=2520 uninv FROM erp_sales_order_lines l LEFT JOIN il USING(line_id) WHERE l.qty_shipped>0 AND l.ship_day<=2520)
SELECT fulfilment, count(*) shipped_lines, count(*) FILTER (WHERE uninv) uninv, round(100.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE uninv)/count(*),4) pct,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE uninv AND qty_shipped<>floor(qty_shipped)) uninv_fractional,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE uninv AND qty_shipped<qty_ordered) uninv_partial_ship
FROM l GROUP BY ROLLUP(fulfilment) ORDER BY fulfilment NULLS LAST

WITH il AS (SELECT DISTINCT line_id FROM finance_invoice_lines),
l AS (SELECT l.*, o.branch, o.channel, il.line_id IS NULL uninv FROM erp_sales_order_lines l JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) LEFT JOIN il USING(line_id) WHERE l.qty_shipped>0 AND l.ship_day<=2520)
SELECT 'branch' dim, branch k, count(*) n, count(*) FILTER (WHERE uninv) u, round(100.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE uninv)/count(*),4) pct FROM l GROUP BY branch
UNION ALL
SELECT 'channel', channel, count(*), count(*) FILTER (WHERE uninv), round(100.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE uninv)/count(*),4) FROM l GROUP BY channel
ORDER BY 1,2

WITH rv AS (
  SELECT o.customer_id, d.year, count(DISTINCT o.order_id) n_orders,
    sum(l.qty_shipped*l.unit_price) rev, sum(l.qty_shipped*(l.unit_price-l.unit_cost)) gm
  FROM erp_sales_orders o JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=o.day JOIN erp_sales_order_lines l USING(order_id) GROUP BY 1,2),
act AS (
  SELECT a.customer_id, a.year, a.rev, a.gm, (b.customer_id IS NULL)::int AS lapsed,
    CASE WHEN a.n_orders<=5 THEN 1 WHEN a.n_orders<=20 THEN 2 WHEN a.n_orders<=60 THEN 3 WHEN a.n_orders<=150 THEN 4 ELSE 5 END band
  FROM rv a LEFT JOIN rv b ON b.customer_id=a.customer_id AND b.year=a.year+1
  WHERE a.year BETWEEN 2016 AND 2024),
x AS (SELECT act.*, c.branch, c.trade,
   CASE WHEN c.onboarded_day<=0 THEN 0 WHEN od.year=act.year THEN 2 ELSE 1 END ten
  FROM act JOIN erp_customers c USING(customer_id) LEFT JOIN dim_date od ON od.day=c.onboarded_day),
cell AS (SELECT band, trade, year, ten, avg(lapsed) p FROM x GROUP BY ALL),
e AS (SELECT x.*, cell.p FROM x JOIN cell USING(band,trade,year,ten)),
b AS (SELECT branch, sum(lapsed) obs, sum(p) ex, sum(rev*lapsed) rev_lapsed, sum(rev*p) rev_exp, sum(gm*lapsed) gm_lapsed, sum(gm*p) gm_exp FROM e GROUP BY 1)
SELECT round(sum(rev_lapsed)/9,2) lapsed_rev_per_year,
  round(sum(gm_lapsed)/9,2) lapsed_gm_per_year,
  round(sum(CASE WHEN obs>ex THEN obs-ex END),1) excess_lapses_9y,
  round(sum(CASE WHEN obs>ex THEN obs-ex END)/9,1) excess_lapses_per_year,
  round(sum(CASE WHEN rev_lapsed>rev_exp THEN rev_lapsed-rev_exp END)/9,2) excess_rev_per_year,
  round(sum(CASE WHEN gm_lapsed>gm_exp THEN gm_lapsed-gm_exp END)/9,2) excess_gm_per_year,
  string_agg(CASE WHEN rev_lapsed>rev_exp THEN branch END, ',' ORDER BY branch) over_branches
FROM b

WITH q AS (SELECT q.*, e.trade, CASE WHEN e.discount_pct=0 THEN 0 WHEN e.discount_pct<0.03 THEN 1 WHEN e.discount_pct<0.06 THEN 2 WHEN e.discount_pct<0.09 THEN 3 WHEN e.discount_pct<0.12 THEN 4 WHEN e.discount_pct<0.15 THEN 5 ELSE 6 END db, ntile(5) OVER (ORDER BY q.total, q.quote_id) sb, (q.status='won')::int w FROM crm_quotes q JOIN erp_customers e USING(customer_id)),
e AS (SELECT *, avg(w) OVER () e0, avg(w) OVER (PARTITION BY trade) et, avg(w) OVER (PARTITION BY trade,branch) etb, avg(w) OVER (PARTITION BY trade,branch,sb) etbs, avg(w) OVER (PARTITION BY trade,branch,sb,db) eall FROM q),
r AS (SELECT rep_id, count(*) n, avg(w-e0) r0, avg(w-et) rt, avg(w-etb) rtb, avg(w-etbs) rtbs, avg(w-eall) rall, avg((trade='commercial')::int) comm FROM e GROUP BY rep_id)
SELECT round(sqrt(sum(n*r0*r0)/sum(n)),4) sd_raw, round(sqrt(sum(n*rt*rt)/sum(n)),4) sd_trade, round(sqrt(sum(n*rtb*rtb)/sum(n)),4) sd_trade_branch, round(sqrt(sum(n*rtbs*rtbs)/sum(n)),4) sd_tbs, round(sqrt(sum(n*rall*rall)/sum(n)),4) sd_tbs_disc, round(max(rall)-min(rall),4) range_all, round(corr(r0, comm),4) corr_rawwin_commshare, round(min(comm),4) min_comm, round(max(comm),4) max_comm FROM r

SELECT (q.branch='Troy') troy, (e.discount_pct=0) zero_disc, e.trade, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT q.customer_id) custs, round(avg((q.status='won')::int),4) win FROM crm_quotes q JOIN erp_customers e USING(customer_id) GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3

WITH il AS (SELECT DISTINCT line_id FROM finance_invoice_lines),
u AS (SELECT l.order_id, count(*) ul FROM erp_sales_order_lines l LEFT JOIN il USING(line_id) WHERE l.qty_shipped>0 AND l.ship_day<=2520 AND il.line_id IS NULL GROUP BY 1),
o AS (SELECT u.order_id, u.ul, (SELECT count(*) FROM erp_sales_order_lines x WHERE x.order_id=u.order_id AND x.qty_shipped>0) shipped_lines,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM finance_invoices i WHERE i.order_id=u.order_id) n_inv FROM u)
SELECT CASE WHEN ul=shipped_lines THEN 'all shipped lines uninvoiced' ELSE 'some lines invoiced' END pattern,
 CASE WHEN n_inv=0 THEN '0 inv' WHEN n_inv=1 THEN '1 inv' ELSE '2+ inv' END invs, count(*) orders, sum(ul) lines
FROM o GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH il AS (SELECT DISTINCT line_id FROM finance_invoice_lines),
u AS (SELECT l.*, o.branch FROM erp_sales_order_lines l JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) LEFT JOIN il USING(line_id) WHERE l.qty_shipped>0 AND l.ship_day<=2520 AND il.line_id IS NULL),
w AS (SELECT ref_id, sku, branch, -sum(qty_delta) q FROM wms_inventory_transactions WHERE reason='sale' GROUP BY 1,2,3)
SELECT fulfilment, count(*) lines, count(w.ref_id) with_wms_sale, count(*) FILTER (WHERE abs(w.q-u.qty_shipped)<0.001) wms_qty_equal
FROM u LEFT JOIN w ON w.ref_id=u.order_id AND w.sku=u.sku AND w.branch=u.branch GROUP BY ROLLUP(fulfilment) ORDER BY fulfilment NULLS LAST

WITH ql AS (SELECT quote_id, count(*) lines, max(markdown_pct) mx, sum(qty*list_price*markdown_pct) md_dollars, sum(qty*list_price) list_val FROM crm_quote_lines GROUP BY 1)
SELECT CASE WHEN mx=0 THEN 'none' WHEN mx<=0.05 THEN '<=5%' WHEN mx<=0.10 THEN '5-10%' ELSE '>10%' END mdb, count(*) n, round(avg((q.status='won')::int),4) win, round(avg((q.status='lost' AND q.loss_reason='price')::int),4) lost_price, round(avg(lines),3) avg_lines, round(avg(q.total),2) avg_total, round(sum(md_dollars),2) md_dollars, min(mx) mn, max(mx) mxx FROM crm_quotes q JOIN ql USING(quote_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY mn

WITH il AS (SELECT DISTINCT line_id FROM finance_invoice_lines),
l AS (SELECT o.taken_by, o.branch, o.channel, il.line_id IS NULL uninv FROM erp_sales_order_lines l JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) LEFT JOIN il USING(line_id) WHERE l.qty_shipped>0 AND l.ship_day<=2520 AND o.taken_by IS NOT NULL)
SELECT taken_by, branch, count(*) n, count(*) FILTER (WHERE uninv) u, round(100.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE uninv)/count(*),4) pct,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE uninv AND channel='counter') u_counter, count(*) FILTER (WHERE channel='counter') n_counter
FROM l GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY pct DESC, taken_by

SELECT (l.markdown_pct>0) has_md, count(*) lines, round(avg(abs(l.markdown_pct - e.discount_pct)),4) avg_absdiff_vs_custdisc, sum((abs(l.markdown_pct - e.discount_pct)<0.0001)::int) eq_custdisc, round(avg(l.quoted_price/nullif(l.list_price,0)),4) avg_price_to_list, round(avg(abs(l.quoted_price - round(l.list_price*(1-l.markdown_pct),2))),4) avg_dev_list_x_md, round(avg(abs(l.quoted_price - round(l.list_price*(1-e.discount_pct),2))),4) avg_dev_list_x_disc, round(avg(e.discount_pct),4) avg_cdisc FROM crm_quote_lines l JOIN crm_quotes q USING(quote_id) JOIN erp_customers e ON e.customer_id=q.customer_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH il AS (SELECT DISTINCT line_id FROM finance_invoice_lines),
l AS (SELECT d.year, o.channel, il.line_id IS NULL uninv FROM erp_sales_order_lines l JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=o.day LEFT JOIN il USING(line_id) WHERE l.qty_shipped>0 AND l.ship_day<=2520 AND o.channel IN ('counter','email','phone'))
SELECT year, round(100.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE uninv AND channel='counter')/count(*) FILTER (WHERE channel='counter'),3) counter_pct,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE channel='counter') counter_n,
 round(100.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE uninv AND channel='email')/count(*) FILTER (WHERE channel='email'),3) email_pct,
 round(100.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE uninv AND channel='phone')/count(*) FILTER (WHERE channel='phone'),3) phone_pct
FROM l GROUP BY year ORDER BY year

SELECT (l.markdown_pct>0) has_md, count(*) lines, round(avg(l.markdown_pct),4) avg_md, round(quantile_cont(l.quoted_price/nullif(l.list_price*(1-e.discount_pct)*(1-l.markdown_pct),0),0.5),4) med_ratio_mult, round(quantile_cont(l.quoted_price/nullif(l.list_price*(1-e.discount_pct)*(1-l.markdown_pct),0),0.05),4) p05, round(quantile_cont(l.quoted_price/nullif(l.list_price*(1-e.discount_pct)*(1-l.markdown_pct),0),0.95),4) p95 FROM crm_quote_lines l JOIN crm_quotes q USING(quote_id) JOIN erp_customers e ON e.customer_id=q.customer_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH il AS (SELECT DISTINCT line_id FROM finance_invoice_lines),
u AS (SELECT l.* FROM erp_sales_order_lines l LEFT JOIN il USING(line_id) WHERE l.qty_shipped>0 AND l.ship_day<=2520 AND il.line_id IS NULL),
pos AS (SELECT line_id, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY line_id) rn, count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id) nl FROM erp_sales_order_lines)
SELECT count(*) lines,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM finance_invoices i JOIN finance_invoice_lines x USING(invoice_id) WHERE i.order_id=u.order_id AND x.sku=u.sku)) same_sku_billed_on_order,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM erp_returns r WHERE r.line_id=u.line_id)) returned,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.rn=p.nl AND p.nl>1) last_line_multi, count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.nl>1) multi_line_orders,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.rn=1 AND p.nl>1) first_line_multi
FROM u JOIN pos p USING(line_id)

SELECT p.category, coalesce(p.refrigerant,'-') refr, (try_cast(p.discontinued_on AS DATE) <= d.date) past_disc, count(*) lines, round(avg((l.markdown_pct>0)::int),4) share_md, round(avg(l.markdown_pct) FILTER (WHERE l.markdown_pct>0),4) avg_md FROM crm_quote_lines l JOIN crm_quotes q USING(quote_id) JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=q.day JOIN erp_products p ON p.sku=l.sku GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY share_md DESC, lines DESC

SELECT d.year, count(*) lines, round(avg((l.markdown_pct>0)::int),4) share_md, round(avg(l.markdown_pct) FILTER (WHERE l.markdown_pct>0),4) avg_md FROM crm_quote_lines l JOIN crm_quotes q USING(quote_id) JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=q.day GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH il AS (SELECT DISTINCT line_id FROM finance_invoice_lines),
u AS (SELECT o.customer_id, l.qty_shipped*l.unit_price usd FROM erp_sales_order_lines l JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) LEFT JOIN il USING(line_id) WHERE l.qty_shipped>0 AND l.ship_day<=2520 AND il.line_id IS NULL),
c AS (SELECT customer_id, count(*) n, sum(usd) usd FROM u GROUP BY 1),
r AS (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY usd DESC, customer_id) rk FROM c)
SELECT count(*) customers, max(n) max_lines_one_customer, round(sum(usd) FILTER (WHERE rk<=10)/sum(usd),4) top10_usd_share, round(sum(usd) FILTER (WHERE rk<=100)/sum(usd),4) top100_usd_share, round(sum(usd),2) total_usd
FROM r

WITH il AS (SELECT DISTINCT line_id FROM finance_invoice_lines),
l AS (SELECT o.customer_id, il.line_id IS NULL uninv, l.qty_shipped*l.unit_price usd FROM erp_sales_order_lines l JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) LEFT JOIN il USING(line_id) WHERE l.qty_shipped>0 AND l.ship_day<=2520),
c AS (SELECT customer_id, sum(usd) tot FROM l GROUP BY 1),
r AS (SELECT customer_id, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY tot DESC, customer_id) rk FROM c)
SELECT count(DISTINCT customer_id) shipped_customers, round(sum(usd) FILTER (WHERE rk<=10)/sum(usd),4) top10_share_all_shipped, round(sum(usd) FILTER (WHERE rk<=100)/sum(usd),4) top100_share_all_shipped FROM l JOIN r USING(customer_id)

WITH p AS (SELECT bill_id, count(*) n, sum(amount) amt, min(day) pday FROM finance_vendor_payments GROUP BY bill_id),
b AS (SELECT b.*, b.vendor_invoice_no LIKE '%-R' is_r, p.n, p.amt pamt, p.pday FROM finance_vendor_bills b LEFT JOIN p USING(bill_id))
SELECT is_r, count(*) n_bills, count(pamt) n_paid, sum(CASE WHEN n>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) multi_pay,
 sum(CASE WHEN pamt IS NOT NULL AND abs(pamt-amount)<0.005 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) paid_exact,
 sum(CASE WHEN pamt IS NOT NULL AND pamt<amount-0.005 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) paid_short,
 sum(CASE WHEN pamt IS NOT NULL AND pamt>amount+0.005 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) paid_over,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN pamt IS NOT NULL THEN amount-pamt END),2) short_total
FROM b GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH ql AS (SELECT l.quote_id, max(l.markdown_pct) mx, max((try_cast(p.discontinued_on AS DATE) <= d.date)::int) has_pd, count(*) lines FROM crm_quote_lines l JOIN crm_quotes q USING(quote_id) JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=q.day JOIN erp_products p ON p.sku=l.sku GROUP BY 1),
x AS (SELECT q.*, (mx>0) md, has_pd, lines, (q.status='won')::int w FROM crm_quotes q JOIN ql USING(quote_id))
SELECT coalesce(has_pd,0) has_pd, md, count(*) n, round(avg(w),4) win, round(avg((status='lost' AND loss_reason='price')::int),4) lost_price, round(avg((status='expired')::int),4) expired, round(avg(lines),3) avg_lines FROM x GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

WITH bc AS (SELECT po_id, count(*) nb, sum(CASE WHEN vendor_invoice_no LIKE '%-R' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nr FROM finance_vendor_bills GROUP BY po_id)
SELECT nb, nr, count(*) n_pos FROM bc GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

WITH il AS (SELECT DISTINCT line_id FROM finance_invoice_lines),
u AS (SELECT d.year, o.channel, l.qty_shipped*l.unit_price usd, l.qty_shipped*(l.unit_price-l.unit_cost) gm FROM erp_sales_order_lines l JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=l.ship_day LEFT JOIN il USING(line_id) WHERE l.qty_shipped>0 AND l.ship_day<=2520 AND il.line_id IS NULL),
y AS (SELECT year, count(*) n, sum(usd) usd, sum(usd) FILTER (WHERE channel='counter') counter_usd, sum(gm) gm FROM u GROUP BY year)
SELECT year::varchar yr, n, round(usd,2) usd, round(counter_usd,2) counter_usd, round(gm,2) margin_static_cost FROM y
UNION ALL SELECT 'avg_2016_2024', round(avg(n),1), round(avg(usd),2), round(avg(counter_usd),2), round(avg(gm),2) FROM y WHERE year<=2024
UNION ALL SELECT 'total_2016_2025', sum(n), round(sum(usd),2), round(sum(counter_usd),2), round(sum(gm),2) FROM y
ORDER BY 1

WITH p AS (SELECT bill_id, sum(amount) amt, min(day) pday FROM finance_vendor_payments GROUP BY bill_id),
s AS (SELECT b.bill_id, b.vendor_id, b.amount, p.amt, b.amount-p.amt short, round((b.amount-p.amt)/b.amount,3) ratio, p.pday-b.day lag FROM finance_vendor_bills b JOIN p USING(bill_id) WHERE p.amt < b.amount-0.005)
SELECT ratio, count(*) n, round(sum(short),2) short_amt, min(lag) min_lag, median(lag) med_lag, max(lag) max_lag FROM s GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY n DESC, ratio LIMIT 20

WITH ql AS (SELECT l.quote_id, max(l.markdown_pct) mx, max((try_cast(p.discontinued_on AS DATE) <= d.date)::int) has_pd FROM crm_quote_lines l JOIN crm_quotes q USING(quote_id) JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=q.day JOIN erp_products p ON p.sku=l.sku GROUP BY 1),
x AS (SELECT q.customer_id, (mx>0) md, (q.status='won')::int w FROM crm_quotes q JOIN ql USING(quote_id) WHERE has_pd=1),
c AS (SELECT customer_id, avg(w) FILTER (WHERE md) wm, avg(w) FILTER (WHERE NOT md) wn, count(*) FILTER (WHERE md) nm, count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT md) nn FROM x GROUP BY 1 HAVING nm>0 AND nn>0)
SELECT count(*) custs, sum(nm) n_md, sum(nn) n_nomd, round(sum((wm-wn)*(nm*nn/(nm+nn)))/sum(nm*nn/(nm+nn)),4) within_cust_diff, round(avg(wm-wn),4) unweighted_diff FROM c

WITH one AS (SELECT quote_id FROM crm_quote_lines GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)=1),
x AS (SELECT l.sku, q.customer_id, (l.markdown_pct>0) md, (q.status='won')::int w FROM crm_quote_lines l JOIN one USING(quote_id) JOIN crm_quotes q USING(quote_id) JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=q.day JOIN erp_products p ON p.sku=l.sku WHERE try_cast(p.discontinued_on AS DATE) <= d.date),
s AS (SELECT sku, avg(w) FILTER (WHERE md) wm, avg(w) FILTER (WHERE NOT md) wn, count(*) FILTER (WHERE md) nm, count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT md) nn FROM x GROUP BY 1 HAVING nm>0 AND nn>0)
SELECT count(*) skus, sum(nm) n_md, sum(nn) n_nomd, round(sum((wm-wn)*(nm*nn/(nm+nn)))/sum(nm*nn/(nm+nn)),4) within_sku_diff, round(sum(nm*wm)/sum(nm),4) win_md, round(sum(nn*wn)/sum(nn),4) win_nomd FROM s

WITH il AS (SELECT DISTINCT line_id FROM finance_invoice_lines),
u AS (SELECT l.* FROM erp_sales_order_lines l LEFT JOIN il USING(line_id) WHERE l.qty_shipped>0 AND l.ship_day<=2520 AND il.line_id IS NULL)
SELECT round(2500.0/4985,4) counter_share_of_uninv, round(222392.0/2563485,4) counter_share_of_shipped, round(1.1241/((1850+635)/(1195113.0+429969)*100),2) counter_vs_email_phone_rate_ratio,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM erp_returns r JOIN u USING(line_id)) returned_lines,
 (SELECT round(sum(c.amount),2) FROM finance_credit_memos c WHERE (c.order_id,c.day) IN (SELECT r.order_id, r.day FROM erp_returns r JOIN u USING(line_id))) credit_on_those_order_days,
 2840528.65-271314.82 usd_2016_2024

WITH p AS (SELECT bill_id, sum(amount) amt, min(day) pday FROM finance_vendor_payments GROUP BY bill_id),
s AS (SELECT b.bill_id, b.vendor_id, b.day, b.amount-p.amt short, p.pday FROM finance_vendor_bills b JOIN p USING(bill_id) WHERE p.amt < b.amount-0.005),
r AS (SELECT b.bill_id, b.vendor_id, b.amount, p.pday FROM finance_vendor_bills b JOIN p USING(bill_id) WHERE vendor_invoice_no LIKE '%-R')
SELECT
 (SELECT count(*) FROM r JOIN s ON s.vendor_id=r.vendor_id AND abs(s.short-r.amount)<0.01) exact_short_match_any_time,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT r.bill_id) FROM r JOIN s ON s.vendor_id=r.vendor_id AND abs(s.short-r.amount)<0.01 AND s.pday>=r.pday) exact_short_match_after,
 (SELECT round(sum(short),2) FROM s) all_short,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM s) n_short,

u AS (SELECT l.order_id, sum(l.qty_shipped*l.unit_price) uusd FROM erp_sales_order_lines l LEFT JOIN il USING(line_id) WHERE l.qty_shipped>0 AND l.ship_day<=2520 AND il.line_id IS NULL GROUP BY 1),
s AS (SELECT invoice_id, sum(amount) la FROM finance_invoice_lines GROUP BY 1),
h AS (SELECT i.order_id, sum(i.amount) ha, sum(s.la) la FROM finance_invoices i JOIN s USING(invoice_id) GROUP BY 1)
SELECT count(*) orders_with_inv, count(*) FILTER (WHERE abs(h.ha-h.la)>1) hdr_differs_gt1, count(*) FILTER (WHERE abs(h.ha-h.la-u.uusd)<1) hdr_includes_missing,
 round(max(abs(h.ha-h.la)),2) max_diff
FROM u JOIN h USING(order_id)

SELECT round(quantile_cont(abs(i.amount-s.la),0.5),4) med, round(max(abs(i.amount-s.la)),2) mx, count(*) FILTER (WHERE abs(i.amount-s.la)>1) gt1
FROM finance_invoices i JOIN (SELECT invoice_id, sum(amount) la FROM finance_invoice_lines GROUP BY 1) s USING(invoice_id) WHERE abs(i.amount-s.la)>0.01

WITH ql AS (SELECT l.quote_id, max(l.markdown_pct) mx, max((try_cast(p.discontinued_on AS DATE) <= d.date)::int) has_pd, count(*) lines FROM crm_quote_lines l JOIN crm_quotes q USING(quote_id) JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=q.day JOIN erp_products p ON p.sku=l.sku GROUP BY 1),
x AS (SELECT q.*, (mx>0) md, has_pd, lines, (q.status='won')::int w FROM crm_quotes q JOIN ql USING(quote_id))
SELECT coalesce(has_pd,0) has_pd, md, count(*) n, round(avg(w),4) win, round(avg((status='lost' AND loss_reason='price')::int),4) lost_price, round(avg((status='lost')::int),4) lost, round(avg((status='lost' AND loss_reason IS NULL)::int),4) lost_noreason FROM x GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

WITH cy AS (
  SELECT o.customer_id, d.year, count(*) n_orders
  FROM erp_sales_orders o JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=o.day GROUP BY 1,2),
act AS (
  SELECT a.customer_id, a.year, (b.customer_id IS NULL)::int AS lapsed,
    CASE WHEN a.n_orders<=5 THEN 1 WHEN a.n_orders<=20 THEN 2 WHEN a.n_orders<=60 THEN 3 WHEN a.n_orders<=150 THEN 4 ELSE 5 END band
  FROM cy a LEFT JOIN cy b ON b.customer_id=a.customer_id AND b.year=a.year+1
  WHERE a.year BETWEEN 2016 AND 2024),
x AS (SELECT act.*, c.branch, c.trade,
   CASE WHEN c.onboarded_day<=0 THEN 0 WHEN od.year=act.year THEN 2 ELSE 1 END ten
  FROM act JOIN erp_customers c USING(customer_id) LEFT JOIN dim_date od ON od.day=c.onboarded_day),
cell AS (SELECT band, trade, year, ten, avg(lapsed) p FROM x GROUP BY ALL),
e AS (SELECT x.*, cell.p, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY hash(customer_id*31+year), year) rn FROM x JOIN cell USING(band,trade,year,ten)),
one AS (SELECT * FROM e WHERE rn=1),
b AS (SELECT branch, count(*) n, sum(lapsed) obs, sum(p) ex, sum(p*(1-p)) v FROM one GROUP BY 1),
s AS (SELECT sum((obs-ex)^2/v) chi2 FROM b)
SELECT branch, n, obs, round(ex,1) ex, round(obs/ex,3) oe, round((obs-ex)/sqrt(v),2) z, (SELECT round(chi2,2) FROM s) chi2_11df,
 (SELECT round((((chi2/11)^(1.0/3)) - (1-2.0/99))/sqrt(2.0/99),2) FROM s) wh_z
FROM b ORDER BY z DESC, branch

SELECT (q.rep_id = c.rep_id) same_rep, (q.branch = c.branch) same_branch, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT q.customer_id) custs FROM crm_quotes q JOIN erp_customers c USING(customer_id) GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

SELECT o.channel, p.method, count(*) n, round(sum(p.amount),2) usd
FROM finance_customer_payments p JOIN finance_invoices i USING(invoice_id) JOIN erp_sales_orders o ON o.order_id=i.order_id
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT d.year, count(*) so_lines_md, round(sum(s.qty_ordered*s.unit_price*s.markdown_pct/(1-s.markdown_pct)),2) md_usd_implied, round(sum(s.qty_ordered*s.unit_price),2) rev_md_lines, round(sum(s.qty_ordered*s.unit_cost),2) cost_md_lines, round(avg((s.unit_price<s.unit_cost)::int),4) share_below_cost FROM erp_sales_order_lines s JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=o.day WHERE s.markdown_pct>0 GROUP BY ROLLUP(d.year) ORDER BY d.year NULLS LAST

WITH il AS (SELECT DISTINCT line_id FROM finance_invoice_lines),
u AS (SELECT l.order_id, sum(l.qty_shipped*l.unit_price) uusd FROM erp_sales_order_lines l LEFT JOIN il USING(line_id) WHERE l.qty_shipped>0 AND l.ship_day<=2520 AND il.line_id IS NULL GROUP BY 1),
inv AS (SELECT order_id, sum(amount) ia FROM finance_invoices GROUP BY 1),
pay AS (SELECT i.order_id, sum(p.amount) pa FROM finance_customer_payments p JOIN finance_invoices i USING(invoice_id) GROUP BY 1),
x AS (SELECT u.order_id, u.uusd, coalesce(inv.ia,0) ia, coalesce(pay.pa,0) pa FROM u LEFT JOIN inv USING(order_id) LEFT JOIN pay USING(order_id))
SELECT count(*) orders, count(*) FILTER (WHERE pa>ia+1) overpaid, count(*) FILTER (WHERE abs(pa-ia-uusd)<1) paid_incl_missing, count(*) FILTER (WHERE abs(pa-ia)<=1) paid_exact, count(*) FILTER (WHERE pa<ia-1) underpaid,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM finance_customer_payments WHERE invoice_id IS NULL) pay_no_invoice,
 (SELECT round(sum(amount),2) FROM finance_customer_payments WHERE invoice_id IS NULL) pay_no_invoice_usd
FROM x

WITH cy AS (
  SELECT o.customer_id, d.year, count(*) n_orders
  FROM erp_sales_orders o JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=o.day GROUP BY 1,2),
act AS (
  SELECT a.customer_id, a.year, (b.customer_id IS NULL)::int AS lapsed,
    CASE WHEN a.n_orders<=5 THEN 1 WHEN a.n_orders<=20 THEN 2 WHEN a.n_orders<=60 THEN 3 WHEN a.n_orders<=150 THEN 4 ELSE 5 END band
  FROM cy a LEFT JOIN cy b ON b.customer_id=a.customer_id AND b.year=a.year+1
  WHERE a.year BETWEEN 2016 AND 2024),
x AS (SELECT act.*, c.branch, c.trade,
   CASE WHEN c.onboarded_day<=0 THEN 0 WHEN od.year=act.year THEN 2 ELSE 1 END ten,
   row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY act.customer_id ORDER BY hash(act.customer_id*31+act.year), act.year) rn
  FROM act JOIN erp_customers c USING(customer_id) LEFT JOIN dim_date od ON od.day=c.onboarded_day),
one AS (SELECT * FROM x WHERE rn=1),
cell AS (SELECT band, trade, year, ten, avg(lapsed) p FROM one GROUP BY ALL),
e AS (SELECT one.*, cell.p FROM one JOIN cell USING(band,trade,year,ten)),
b AS (SELECT branch, count(*) n, sum(lapsed) obs, sum(p) ex, sum(p*(1-p)) v FROM e GROUP BY 1),
s AS (SELECT sum((obs-ex)^2/v) chi2 FROM b)
SELECT branch, n, obs, round(ex,1) ex, round(obs/ex,3) oe, round((obs-ex)/sqrt(v),2) z, (SELECT round(chi2,2) FROM s) chi2_11df,
 (SELECT round((((chi2/11)^(1.0/3)) - (1-2.0/99))/sqrt(2.0/99),2) FROM s) wh_z
FROM b ORDER BY z DESC, branch

SELECT o.channel, count(*) n, round(quantile_cont(i.day-l.ship_day,0.5),1) p50, round(quantile_cont(i.day-l.ship_day,0.99),1) p99, max(i.day-l.ship_day) mx, min(i.day-l.ship_day) mn
FROM finance_invoice_lines x JOIN finance_invoices i USING(invoice_id) JOIN erp_sales_order_lines l USING(line_id) JOIN erp_sales_orders o ON o.order_id=l.order_id
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH x AS (SELECT l.*, q.branch, q.rep_id, q.status, d.date, try_cast(p.discontinued_on AS DATE) disc, p.unit_cost, p.refrigerant FROM crm_quote_lines l JOIN crm_quotes q USING(quote_id) JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=q.day JOIN erp_products p ON p.sku=l.sku WHERE try_cast(p.discontinued_on AS DATE) <= d.date)
SELECT CASE WHEN date_diff('month', disc, date) < 3 THEN 'a <3m' WHEN date_diff('month', disc, date) < 6 THEN 'b 3-6m' WHEN date_diff('month', disc, date) < 12 THEN 'c 6-12m' WHEN date_diff('month', disc, date) < 24 THEN 'd 12-24m' ELSE 'e 24m+' END age, count(*) lines, round(avg((markdown_pct>0)::int),4) share_md, round(avg(markdown_pct) FILTER (WHERE markdown_pct>0),4) avg_md, round(avg((status='won')::int) FILTER (WHERE markdown_pct>0),4) win_md, round(avg((status='won')::int) FILTER (WHERE markdown_pct=0),4) win_nomd FROM x GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH il AS (SELECT DISTINCT line_id FROM finance_invoice_lines),
l AS (SELECT o.channel, l.ship_day, il.line_id IS NULL uninv FROM erp_sales_order_lines l JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) LEFT JOIN il USING(line_id) WHERE l.qty_shipped>0 AND l.ship_day<=2520)
SELECT CASE WHEN ship_day<=2500 THEN '<=2500' ELSE '2501-2520' END b, channel, count(*) n, count(*) FILTER (WHERE uninv) u, round(100.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE uninv)/count(*),4) pct FROM l GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH x AS (SELECT l.*, q.branch, q.status FROM crm_quote_lines l JOIN crm_quotes q USING(quote_id) JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=q.day JOIN erp_products p ON p.sku=l.sku WHERE try_cast(p.discontinued_on AS DATE) <= d.date)
SELECT branch, count(*) lines, round(avg((markdown_pct>0)::int),4) share_md, round(avg(markdown_pct) FILTER (WHERE markdown_pct>0),4) avg_md, round(avg((status='won')::int) FILTER (WHERE markdown_pct>0),4) win_md, round(avg((status='won')::int) FILTER (WHERE markdown_pct=0),4) win_nomd FROM x GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT round(quantile_cont(s.unit_price/s.unit_cost,0.05),4) p05, round(quantile_cont(s.unit_price/s.unit_cost,0.25),4) p25, round(quantile_cont(s.unit_price/s.unit_cost,0.5),4) p50, round(quantile_cont(s.unit_price/s.unit_cost,0.75),4) p75, round(quantile_cont(s.unit_price/s.unit_cost,0.95),4) p95, count(*) n FROM erp_sales_order_lines s WHERE s.markdown_pct>0

WITH cy AS (
  SELECT o.customer_id, d.year, count(*) n_orders
  FROM erp_sales_orders o JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=o.day GROUP BY 1,2),
act AS (
  SELECT a.customer_id, a.year, (b.customer_id IS NULL)::int AS lapsed,
    CASE WHEN a.n_orders<=5 THEN 1 WHEN a.n_orders<=20 THEN 2 WHEN a.n_orders<=60 THEN 3 WHEN a.n_orders<=150 THEN 4 ELSE 5 END band
  FROM cy a LEFT JOIN cy b ON b.customer_id=a.customer_id AND b.year=a.year+1
  WHERE a.year BETWEEN 2016 AND 2024),
x AS (SELECT act.*, c.branch, c.trade,
   CASE WHEN c.onboarded_day<=0 THEN 0 WHEN od.year=act.year THEN 2 ELSE 1 END ten
  FROM act JOIN erp_customers c USING(customer_id) LEFT JOIN dim_date od ON od.day=c.onboarded_day),
cell AS (SELECT band, trade, year, ten, avg(lapsed) p FROM x GROUP BY ALL),
e AS (SELECT x.*, cell.p FROM x JOIN cell USING(band,trade,year,ten)),
cu AS (SELECT branch, customer_id, sum(lapsed) o, sum(p) ex, sum(p*(1-p)) v FROM e GROUP BY 1,2),
b AS (SELECT branch, count(*) ncust, sum(o) obs, sum(ex) ex, sum(v) v_binom, sum((o-ex)^2) v_cluster FROM cu GROUP BY 1),
s AS (SELECT sum((obs-ex)^2/v_binom) chi_b, sum((obs-ex)^2/v_cluster) chi_c FROM b)
SELECT branch, ncust, obs, round(ex,1) ex, round((obs-ex)/sqrt(v_binom),2) z_binomial, round((obs-ex)/sqrt(v_cluster),2) z_cluster_robust,
 round(v_cluster/v_binom,3) var_ratio, (SELECT round(chi_b,2) FROM s) chi2_binom, (SELECT round(chi_c,2) FROM s) chi2_cluster,
 (SELECT round((((chi_c/11)^(1.0/3)) - (1-2.0/99))/sqrt(2.0/99),2) FROM s) wh_z_cluster
FROM b ORDER BY z_binomial DESC, branch

WITH il AS (SELECT DISTINCT line_id FROM finance_invoice_lines),
l AS (SELECT l.*, o.channel, il.line_id IS NULL uninv FROM erp_sales_order_lines l JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) LEFT JOIN il USING(line_id) WHERE l.qty_shipped>0 AND l.ship_day<=2520)
SELECT uninv, count(*) n, count(*) FILTER (WHERE unit_price<=0) zero_price, round(avg(unit_price),2) avg_price, round(median(unit_price),2) med_price, round(avg(markdown_pct),4) avg_md,
 round(avg(qty_shipped),2) avg_qty, round(avg(qty_shipped*unit_price),2) avg_usd, round(median(qty_shipped*unit_price),2) med_usd,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE unit_price<unit_cost) below_cost
FROM l GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH il AS (SELECT DISTINCT line_id FROM finance_invoice_lines),
l AS (SELECT l.*, o.channel, il.line_id IS NULL uninv FROM erp_sales_order_lines l JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) LEFT JOIN il USING(line_id) WHERE l.qty_shipped>0 AND l.ship_day<=2520),
d AS (SELECT a.line_id, max(CASE WHEN b.line_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) dup FROM l a LEFT JOIN erp_sales_order_lines b ON b.order_id=a.order_id AND b.sku=a.sku AND b.line_id<>a.line_id GROUP BY 1)
SELECT channel, uninv, count(*) n, sum(dup) has_same_sku_line, round(100.0*sum(dup)/count(*),3) pct FROM l JOIN d USING(line_id) GROUP BY ROLLUP(uninv), channel HAVING uninv IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1,2

WITH pd AS (SELECT sku FROM erp_products WHERE discontinued_on IS NOT NULL),
dd AS (SELECT t.sku, t.branch, t.day, sum(t.qty_delta) dq FROM wms_inventory_transactions t JOIN pd USING(sku) GROUP BY ALL),
oh AS (SELECT sku, branch, day, sum(dq) OVER (PARTITION BY sku, branch ORDER BY day) onhand FROM dd),
x AS (SELECT l.quote_line_id, l.sku, l.qty, l.markdown_pct, q.branch, q.day, q.status FROM crm_quote_lines l JOIN crm_quotes q USING(quote_id) JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=q.day JOIN erp_products p ON p.sku=l.sku WHERE try_cast(p.discontinued_on AS DATE) <= d.date),
j AS (SELECT x.*, coalesce(oh.onhand,0) onhand FROM x ASOF LEFT JOIN oh ON x.sku=oh.sku AND x.branch=oh.branch AND x.day > oh.day)
SELECT CASE WHEN onhand<=0 THEN 'a none' WHEN onhand<qty THEN 'b short' WHEN onhand<10*qty THEN 'c 1-10x' ELSE 'd 10x+' END stock, count(*) lines, round(avg((markdown_pct>0)::int),4) share_md, round(avg(markdown_pct) FILTER (WHERE markdown_pct>0),4) avg_md, round(avg((status='won')::int) FILTER (WHERE markdown_pct>0),4) win_md, round(avg((status='won')::int) FILTER (WHERE markdown_pct=0),4) win_nomd, count(*) FILTER (WHERE markdown_pct>0) n_md FROM j GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH rv AS (
  SELECT o.customer_id, d.year, count(DISTINCT o.order_id) n_orders,
    sum(l.qty_shipped*l.unit_price) rev, sum(l.qty_shipped*(l.unit_price-l.unit_cost)) gm
  FROM erp_sales_orders o JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=o.day JOIN erp_sales_order_lines l USING(order_id) GROUP BY 1,2),
act AS (
  SELECT a.customer_id, a.year, a.rev, a.gm, (b.customer_id IS NULL)::int AS lapsed,
    CASE WHEN a.n_orders<=5 THEN 1 WHEN a.n_orders<=20 THEN 2 WHEN a.n_orders<=60 THEN 3 WHEN a.n_orders<=150 THEN 4 ELSE 5 END band
  FROM rv a LEFT JOIN rv b ON b.customer_id=a.customer_id AND b.year=a.year+1
  WHERE a.year BETWEEN 2016 AND 2024),
x AS (SELECT act.*, c.branch, c.trade,
   CASE WHEN c.onboarded_day<=0 THEN 0 WHEN od.year=act.year THEN 2 ELSE 1 END ten
  FROM act JOIN erp_customers c USING(customer_id) LEFT JOIN dim_date od ON od.day=c.onboarded_day),
cell AS (SELECT band, trade, year, ten, avg(lapsed) p FROM x GROUP BY ALL),
e AS (SELECT x.*, cell.p FROM x JOIN cell USING(band,trade,year,ten)),
b AS (SELECT branch, sum(rev*lapsed) rl, sum(rev*p) re, sum(rev*rev*p*(1-p)) rv_var, sum(gm*lapsed) gl, sum(gm*p) ge, sum(gm*gm*p*(1-p)) gv FROM e GROUP BY 1)
SELECT branch, round((rl-re)/9,2) net_excess_rev_per_yr, round((rl-re)/sqrt(rv_var),2) z_rev,
  round((gl-ge)/9,2) net_excess_gm_per_yr, round((gl-ge)/sqrt(gv),2) z_gm,
  round(sum(greatest(rl-re,0)) OVER ()/9,2) sum_pos_rev_per_yr,
  round(sum(sqrt(rv_var)*0.39894) OVER ()/9,2) null_expected_sum_pos_rev_per_yr,
  round(sum(greatest(gl-ge,0)) OVER ()/9,2) sum_pos_gm_per_yr,
  round(sum(sqrt(gv)*0.39894) OVER ()/9,2) null_expected_sum_pos_gm_per_yr
FROM b ORDER BY z_rev DESC, branch

WITH p AS (SELECT bill_id, sum(amount) amt, min(day) pday FROM finance_vendor_payments GROUP BY bill_id),
x AS (SELECT r.bill_id, po.purpose, d.year, pr.amt rpaid, o.amount - coalesce(pp.amt,0) oshort
 FROM finance_vendor_bills r JOIN finance_vendor_bills o ON o.po_id=r.po_id AND o.vendor_invoice_no NOT LIKE '%-R'
 JOIN p pr ON pr.bill_id=r.bill_id JOIN p pp ON pp.bill_id=o.bill_id
 JOIN erp_purchase_orders po ON po.po_id=r.po_id JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=pr.pday
 WHERE r.vendor_invoice_no LIKE '%-R')
SELECT purpose, CASE WHEN year>=2024 THEN 'a 2024-2025' WHEN year>=2022 THEN 'b 2022-2023' ELSE 'c 2016-2021' END pay_period,
 count(*) n, round(sum(rpaid),2) r_paid, round(sum(oshort),2) orig_short, round(sum(rpaid-oshort),2) net_excess
FROM x GROUP BY ALL
UNION ALL
SELECT purpose, 'z all', count(*), round(sum(rpaid),2), round(sum(oshort),2), round(sum(rpaid-oshort),2) FROM x GROUP BY ALL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'all', 'z all', count(*), round(sum(rpaid),2), round(sum(oshort),2), round(sum(rpaid-oshort),2) FROM x
ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT round(2727183.80/10,2) net_per_year_all, round(2321702.09/10,2) stock_net_per_year, round(412334.21/2,2) stock_net_per_year_2024_25, round((412334.21+93020.54)/2,2) all_net_per_year_2024_25, round(2321702.09/2727183.80,4) stock_share_net

WITH il AS (SELECT DISTINCT line_id FROM finance_invoice_lines),
l AS (SELECT o.order_id, o.channel, o.taken_by, il.line_id IS NULL uninv FROM erp_sales_order_lines l JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) LEFT JOIN il USING(line_id) WHERE l.qty_shipped>0 AND l.ship_day<=2520),
o AS (SELECT order_id, channel, count(*) nl, sum(uninv::int) ul FROM l GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT channel, count(*) orders, round(avg(nl),3) lines_per_order, count(*) FILTER (WHERE ul>0) orders_hit, round(100.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE ul>0)/count(*),4) order_pct,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE ul>0 AND ul=nl) whole_order, count(*) FILTER (WHERE ul>0 AND ul<nl) partial_order,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE nl=1) single_line_orders, count(*) FILTER (WHERE nl=1 AND ul=1) single_hit,
 round(100.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE nl=1 AND ul=1)/nullif(count(*) FILTER (WHERE nl=1),0),4) single_pct,
 round(100.0*sum(ul) FILTER (WHERE nl>1)/nullif(sum(nl) FILTER (WHERE nl>1),0),4) multi_line_rate
FROM o GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT channel, count(*) orders, count(taken_by) with_keyer, count(DISTINCT taken_by) keyers FROM erp_sales_orders GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH l AS (
  SELECT c.branch, d.year, d.month, (l.fulfilment='short')::int s
  FROM erp_sales_order_lines l JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) JOIN erp_customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=o.day WHERE d.year BETWEEN 2016 AND 2024),
ym AS (SELECT year, month, avg(s) r FROM l GROUP BY 1,2),
b AS (SELECT branch, count(*) n, avg(s) obs_share, avg(ym.r) exp_share_from_month_mix,
  avg(CASE WHEN month IN (1,6,7,11,12) THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) peak_month_line_share
  FROM l JOIN ym USING(year,month) GROUP BY 1)
SELECT branch, n, round(obs_share,4) obs_short, round(exp_share_from_month_mix,4) exp_short_month_mix, round(obs_share/exp_share_from_month_mix,3) ratio, round(peak_month_line_share,4) peak_month_line_share
FROM b ORDER BY ratio DESC, branch

WITH cy AS (
  SELECT o.customer_id, d.year FROM erp_sales_orders o JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=o.day GROUP BY 1,2),
lap AS (
  SELECT a.customer_id, a.year FROM cy a LEFT JOIN cy b ON b.customer_id=a.customer_id AND b.year=a.year+1
  WHERE a.year BETWEEN 2016 AND 2022 AND b.customer_id IS NULL)
SELECT c.branch, count(*) lapses_2016_22, sum((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cy z WHERE z.customer_id=lap.customer_id AND z.year>lap.year+1))::int) came_back,
 round(avg((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cy z WHERE z.customer_id=lap.customer_id AND z.year>lap.year+1))::int),4) came_back_rate
FROM lap JOIN erp_customers c USING(customer_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY came_back_rate DESC, branch

WITH il AS (SELECT DISTINCT line_id FROM finance_invoice_lines),
l AS (SELECT o.order_id, il.line_id IS NULL uninv FROM erp_sales_order_lines l JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) LEFT JOIN il USING(line_id) WHERE l.qty_shipped>0 AND l.ship_day<=2520),
o AS (SELECT order_id, count(*) nl, sum(uninv::int) ul FROM l GROUP BY 1)
SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE ul>0 AND ul=nl) whole_orders_missed, count(*) FILTER (WHERE ul>0 AND ul=nl AND nl=1) of_which_single_line, count(*) FILTER (WHERE ul>0 AND ul=nl AND nl>1) multi_line_fully_missed, count(*) FILTER (WHERE ul>=2) orders_with_2plus_missing
FROM o

WITH pd AS (SELECT sku FROM erp_products WHERE discontinued_on IS NOT NULL),
dd AS (SELECT t.sku, t.branch, t.day, sum(t.qty_delta) dq FROM wms_inventory_transactions t JOIN pd USING(sku) GROUP BY ALL),
oh AS (SELECT sku, branch, day, sum(dq) OVER (PARTITION BY sku, branch ORDER BY day) onhand FROM dd),
one AS (SELECT quote_id FROM crm_quote_lines GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)=1),
x AS (SELECT l.sku, l.qty, l.markdown_pct, q.branch, q.day, (q.status='won')::int w FROM crm_quote_lines l JOIN one USING(quote_id) JOIN crm_quotes q USING(quote_id) JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=q.day JOIN erp_products p ON p.sku=l.sku WHERE try_cast(p.discontinued_on AS DATE) <= d.date),
j AS (SELECT x.*, (coalesce(oh.onhand,0)>=x.qty) instock FROM x ASOF LEFT JOIN oh ON x.sku=oh.sku AND x.branch=oh.branch AND x.day > oh.day),
s AS (SELECT instock, sku, avg(w) FILTER (WHERE markdown_pct>0) wm, avg(w) FILTER (WHERE markdown_pct=0) wn, count(*) FILTER (WHERE markdown_pct>0) nm, count(*) FILTER (WHERE markdown_pct=0) nn FROM j GROUP BY ALL HAVING nm>0 AND nn>0)

  FROM erp_sales_orders o JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=o.day JOIN erp_sales_order_lines l USING(order_id) GROUP BY 1,2),
act AS (
  SELECT a.customer_id, a.year, a.rev, a.gm, (b.customer_id IS NULL)::int AS lapsed,
    CASE WHEN a.n_orders<=5 THEN 1 WHEN a.n_orders<=20 THEN 2 WHEN a.n_orders<=60 THEN 3 WHEN a.n_orders<=150 THEN 4 ELSE 5 END band
  FROM rv a LEFT JOIN rv b ON b.customer_id=a.customer_id AND b.year=a.year+1
  WHERE a.year BETWEEN 2016 AND 2024),
x AS (SELECT act.*, c.branch, c.trade,
   CASE WHEN c.onboarded_day<=0 THEN 0 WHEN od.year=act.year THEN 2 ELSE 1 END ten
  FROM act JOIN erp_customers c USING(customer_id) LEFT JOIN dim_date od ON od.day=c.onboarded_day),
cell AS (SELECT band, trade, year, ten, avg(lapsed) p FROM x GROUP BY ALL),
e AS (SELECT x.*, cell.p FROM x JOIN cell USING(band,trade,year,ten)),
b AS (SELECT branch, count(*) n, sum(rev*lapsed) rl, sum(rev*p) re, sum(rev*rev*p*(1-p)) rvv, sum(gm*lapsed) gl, sum(gm*p) ge, sum(gm*gm*p*(1-p)) gv FROM e GROUP BY 1)
SELECT branch, n,
 round(rl/9,2) lapsed_rev_per_yr,
 round((rl-re)/9,2) net_excess_rev_per_yr,
 round((rl-re-1.96*sqrt(rvv))/9,2) rev_ci95_low, round((rl-re+1.96*sqrt(rvv))/9,2) rev_ci95_high,
 round(greatest((rl-re-1.96*sqrt(rvv))/9,0),2) supported_floor_rev_per_yr,
 round((gl-ge)/9,2) net_excess_gm_per_yr,
 round((gl-ge-1.96*sqrt(gv))/9,2) gm_ci95_low, round((gl-ge+1.96*sqrt(gv))/9,2) gm_ci95_high,
 round(sum(rl) OVER ()/9,2) all_lapsed_rev_per_yr
FROM b WHERE branch IN ('Pittsburgh','Toledo') ORDER BY branch

WITH a AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT o.customer_id, d.year FROM erp_sales_orders o JOIN dim_date d USING(day) WHERE d.year IN (2016,2025)),
c AS (SELECT customer_id, CASE WHEN discount_pct<0.10 THEN 'a <10%' WHEN discount_pct<0.15 THEN 'b 10-15%' WHEN discount_pct<0.20 THEN 'c 15-20%' ELSE 'd >=20%' END tier FROM erp_customers)
SELECT tier, count(DISTINCT a16.customer_id) active_2016, count(DISTINCT a25.customer_id) still_active_2025, round(count(DISTINCT a25.customer_id)/count(DISTINCT a16.customer_id),4) retained_share
FROM c JOIN a a16 ON a16.customer_id=c.customer_id AND a16.year=2016
LEFT JOIN a a25 ON a25.customer_id=c.customer_id AND a25.year=2025
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH c AS (SELECT customer_id, discount_pct, CASE WHEN discount_pct<0.10 THEN 'a <10%' WHEN discount_pct<0.15 THEN 'b 10-15%' WHEN discount_pct<0.20 THEN 'c 15-20%' ELSE 'd >=20%' END tier FROM erp_customers)
SELECT tier, count(*) n_cust, round(avg(credit_limit),0) avg_credit, round(avg(terms_days),1) avg_terms, round(avg(discount_pct),4) avg_disc

WITH x AS (
 SELECT d.year, l.markdown_pct md, l.unit_price*l.qty_shipped rev, p.list_price*l.qty_shipped lst,
  l.unit_cost*l.qty_shipped cst
 FROM erp_sales_order_lines l JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=o.day JOIN erp_products p USING(sku)
 WHERE l.qty_shipped>0 AND d.year IN (2016,2025)),
r AS (SELECT
 sum(case when year=2016 and md=0 then rev end)/sum(case when year=2016 and md=0 then lst end) ptl16_nomd,
 sum(case when year=2025 and md=0 then rev end)/sum(case when year=2025 and md=0 then lst end) ptl25_nomd,
 sum(case when year=2025 and md=0 then lst end) lst25_nomd,
 sum(case when year=2025 and md>0 then rev/(1-md) - rev end) md_dollars_2025,
 sum(case when year=2025 then rev end) rev25 FROM x)
SELECT round(ptl16_nomd,4) ptl16_nomd, round(ptl25_nomd,4) ptl25_nomd, round(lst25_nomd,2) list25_nomd,
 round(lst25_nomd*(ptl16_nomd-ptl25_nomd),2) nomd_shortfall_2025,
 round(md_dollars_2025,2) markdown_dollars_2025, round(rev25,2) rev25 FROM r

WITH x AS (
 SELECT d.year, l.unit_price*l.qty_shipped rev, p.list_price*l.qty_shipped lst, (1-c.discount_pct) keep
 FROM erp_sales_order_lines l JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=o.day JOIN erp_products p USING(sku) JOIN erp_customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id
 WHERE l.qty_shipped>0 AND l.markdown_pct=0 AND d.year IN (2016,2025)),
y AS (SELECT year, sum(rev) rev, sum(lst) lst, sum(lst*keep)/sum(lst) keep_w, sum(rev)/sum(lst*keep) resid FROM x GROUP BY 1)
SELECT a.keep_w keep16, b.keep_w keep25, a.resid resid16, b.resid resid25,
 round(b.lst*(a.keep_w-b.keep_w)*a.resid,2) customer_mix_dollars_2025,
 round(b.lst*b.keep_w*(a.resid-b.resid),2) residual_rate_dollars_2025,
 round(b.lst*(a.rev/a.lst - b.rev/b.lst),2) total_shortfall_2025
FROM y a, y b WHERE a.year=2016 AND b.year=2025

SELECT CASE WHEN discount_pct<0.10 THEN 'a <10%' WHEN discount_pct<0.15 THEN 'b 10-15%' WHEN discount_pct<0.20 THEN 'c 15-20%' ELSE 'd >=20%' END tier, count(*) n_cust, round(avg(credit_limit),0) avg_credit, round(avg(terms_days),1) avg_terms, round(avg(onboarded_day),0) avg_onboarded_day
FROM erp_customers GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT o.branch,
 round(avg(case when d.year=2016 then c.discount_pct end),4) disc16,
 round(avg(case when d.year=2025 then c.discount_pct end),4) disc25,
 count(case when d.year=2016 then 1 end) lines16, count(case when d.year=2025 then 1 end) lines25
FROM erp_sales_order_lines l JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=o.day JOIN erp_customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id
WHERE d.year IN (2016,2025) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT 519+344+252+236 AS won_instock_nomd_lines, round(236.0/(519+344+252+236),4) AS share_filled_from_stock, 31985+14+6+4 AS won_instock_md_lines, round(31985.0/(31985+14+6+4),4) AS md_share_from_stock

WITH x AS (SELECT i.customer_id, i.amount, GREATEST(p.day - i.due_day,0) AS dl, p.day - i.day AS dtp FROM finance_invoices i JOIN finance_customer_payments p USING(invoice_id)),
c AS (SELECT customer_id, sum(amount) billed, sum(amount*dl) ldd, count(*) n, sum(amount*dtp) dd FROM x GROUP BY 1),
r AS (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY ldd DESC, customer_id) rl, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY billed DESC, customer_id) rb, count(*) OVER () nc FROM c)
SELECT nc, count(*) customers, sum(n) invoices,
 round(sum(ldd) FILTER (WHERE rl<=nc*0.1)/sum(ldd),4) top10_share_latedd,
 round(sum(billed) FILTER (WHERE rb<=nc*0.1)/sum(billed),4) top10_share_billed,
 round(sum(ldd) FILTER (WHERE rl<=nc*0.2)/sum(ldd),4) top20_share_latedd,
 round(sum(billed) FILTER (WHERE rb<=nc*0.2)/sum(billed),4) top20_share_billed,
 round(sum(ldd),0) total_latedd, round(sum(billed),2) total_billed
FROM r GROUP BY nc

WITH x AS (SELECT i.customer_id, i.amount, GREATEST(p.day - i.due_day,0) AS dl, (p.day>i.due_day)::int late FROM finance_invoices i JOIN finance_customer_payments p USING(invoice_id)),
c AS (SELECT customer_id, sum(amount) billed, sum(amount*dl)/sum(amount) wdl, count(*) n, avg(late) late_rate FROM x GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>=50),
d AS (SELECT *, ntile(10) OVER (ORDER BY wdl, customer_id) dec FROM c)
SELECT dec, count(*) cust, sum(n) inv, round(min(wdl),2) mn, round(max(wdl),2) mx, round(sum(billed),0) billed, round(avg(late_rate),3) late_rate FROM d GROUP BY dec ORDER BY dec

WITH x AS (SELECT i.customer_id, i.amount, GREATEST(p.day - i.due_day,0) AS dl, (p.day>i.due_day)::int late, p.day-i.day dtp FROM finance_invoices i JOIN finance_customer_payments p USING(invoice_id))
SELECT c.terms_days, count(DISTINCT c.customer_id) cust, count(*) inv, round(sum(amount),0) billed, round(sum(amount*dl)/sum(amount),2) wdl, round(avg(late),3) late_rate, round(avg(dtp),2) avg_dtp, round(sum(amount*dl),0) ldd
FROM x JOIN erp_customers c USING(customer_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH x AS (SELECT i.customer_id, i.amount, GREATEST(p.day - i.due_day,0) AS dl FROM finance_invoices i JOIN finance_customer_payments p USING(invoice_id))
SELECT c.trade, c.branch IS NOT NULL b, count(DISTINCT c.customer_id) cust, count(*) inv, round(sum(amount*dl)/sum(amount),2) wdl

c AS (SELECT customer_id, sum(amount*dl) FILTER (WHERE h=1)/sum(amount) FILTER (WHERE h=1) w1, sum(amount*dl) FILTER (WHERE h=2)/sum(amount) FILTER (WHERE h=2) w2, count(*) FILTER (WHERE h=1) n1, count(*) FILTER (WHERE h=2) n2 FROM x GROUP BY 1)

FROM c WHERE n1>=30 AND n2>=30 GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2
