FROM c WHERE n1>=30 AND n2>=30 GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH x AS (SELECT i.customer_id, i.amount, GREATEST(p.day - i.due_day,0) AS dl, CASE WHEN i.day<1260 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END h FROM finance_invoices i JOIN finance_customer_payments p ON p.invoice_id=i.invoice_id JOIN erp_customers c ON c.customer_id=i.customer_id WHERE c.terms_days>0),
c AS (SELECT customer_id, sum(amount*dl) FILTER (WHERE h=1)/sum(amount) FILTER (WHERE h=1) w1, sum(amount*dl) FILTER (WHERE h=2)/sum(amount) FILTER (WHERE h=2) w2, count(*) FILTER (WHERE h=1) n1, count(*) FILTER (WHERE h=2) n2 FROM x GROUP BY 1)
SELECT count(*) cust, round(corr(w1,w2),3) corr_halves FROM c WHERE n1>=30 AND n2>=30

WITH x AS (SELECT i.customer_id, i.amount, GREATEST(p.day - i.due_day,0) AS dl FROM finance_invoices i JOIN finance_customer_payments p ON p.invoice_id=i.invoice_id JOIN erp_customers c ON c.customer_id=i.customer_id WHERE c.terms_days>0),
c AS (SELECT customer_id, sum(amount) billed, sum(amount*dl) ldd, count(*) n FROM x GROUP BY 1),
g AS (SELECT CASE WHEN ldd/billed>=6 THEN 'slow' ELSE 'normal' END grp, * FROM c)
SELECT grp, count(*) cust, sum(n) inv, round(sum(billed),0) billed, round(sum(ldd),0) ldd, round(sum(ldd)/sum(billed),3) wdl,
 round(count(*)/sum(count(*)) OVER (),4) cust_share, round(sum(billed)/sum(sum(billed)) OVER (),4) billed_share, round(sum(ldd)/sum(sum(ldd)) OVER (),4) ldd_share,
 round(sum(ldd)/2520,0) avg_late_balance, round(sum(ldd)/2520*0.08,0) cost_8pct_yr
FROM g GROUP BY grp ORDER BY grp

WITH x AS (SELECT i.customer_id, i.amount, GREATEST(p.day - i.due_day,0) AS dl FROM finance_invoices i JOIN finance_customer_payments p ON p.invoice_id=i.invoice_id JOIN erp_customers c ON c.customer_id=i.customer_id WHERE c.terms_days>0),
c AS (SELECT customer_id, sum(amount) billed, sum(amount*dl) ldd, count(*) n FROM x GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>=30)
SELECT CASE WHEN ldd/billed<1 THEN 'a <1' WHEN ldd/billed<4 THEN 'b 1-4' WHEN ldd/billed<6 THEN 'c 4-6' WHEN ldd/billed<11 THEN 'd 6-11' WHEN ldd/billed<16 THEN 'e 11-16' WHEN ldd/billed<25 THEN 'f 16-25' ELSE 'g 25+' END bucket, count(*) cust, sum(n) inv, round(sum(billed),0) billed, round(sum(ldd),0) ldd, round(sum(ldd)/sum(billed),2) wdl
FROM c GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH x AS (SELECT i.customer_id, i.amount, GREATEST(p.day - i.due_day,0) AS dl, i.day FROM finance_invoices i JOIN finance_customer_payments p ON p.invoice_id=i.invoice_id JOIN erp_customers c ON c.customer_id=i.customer_id WHERE c.terms_days>0),
c AS (SELECT customer_id, CASE WHEN sum(amount*dl)/sum(amount)>=6 THEN 'slow' ELSE 'normal' END grp FROM x GROUP BY 1)
SELECT d.year, grp, count(*) inv, round(sum(amount),0) billed, round(sum(amount*dl)/sum(amount),2) wdl
FROM x JOIN c USING(customer_id) JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=x.day GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH x AS (
 SELECT d.year, o.customer_id, p.list_price*l.qty_shipped lst, l.unit_price*l.qty_shipped rev, (1-c.discount_pct) keep
 FROM erp_sales_order_lines l JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=o.day JOIN erp_products p USING(sku) JOIN erp_customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id
 WHERE l.qty_shipped>0 AND l.markdown_pct=0 AND d.year IN (2016,2025)),
cy AS (SELECT customer_id, year, sum(lst) lst, sum(rev) rev, max(keep) keep FROM x GROUP BY 1,2),
g AS (SELECT a.customer_id, a.year, a.lst, a.rev, a.keep,
  CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cy b WHERE b.customer_id=a.customer_id AND b.year<>a.year) THEN 'both' WHEN a.year=2016 THEN 'exited' ELSE 'entered' END grp FROM cy a)
SELECT year, grp, count(*) n_cust, round(sum(lst),2) list_value, round(sum(lst*keep)/sum(lst),4) keep_w, round(sum(rev)/sum(lst),4) ptl, round(sum(lst)/count(*),0) list_per_cust
FROM g GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH x AS (SELECT i.customer_id, i.amount, GREATEST(p.day - i.due_day,0) AS dl FROM finance_invoices i JOIN finance_customer_payments p ON p.invoice_id=i.invoice_id JOIN erp_customers c ON c.customer_id=i.customer_id WHERE c.terms_days>0),
c AS (SELECT customer_id, sum(amount) billed, sum(amount*dl) ldd, count(*) n FROM x GROUP BY 1),
g AS (SELECT CASE WHEN ldd/billed>=20 THEN 'c_very_slow' WHEN ldd/billed>=6 THEN 'b_slow' ELSE 'a_normal' END grp, c.*, e.credit_limit, e.terms_days, e.branch FROM c JOIN erp_customers e USING(customer_id))
SELECT grp, count(*) cust, round(count(*)/sum(count(*)) OVER (),4) cust_share, round(sum(billed)/sum(sum(billed)) OVER (),4) billed_share, round(sum(ldd)/sum(sum(ldd)) OVER (),4) ldd_share, round(sum(ldd)/sum(billed),2) wdl,
 round(sum(ldd)/2520,0) avg_late_bal, round(median(credit_limit),0) med_credit_limit, round(avg(billed/n),0) avg_inv, round(avg(terms_days),1) avg_terms, count(DISTINCT branch) branches
FROM g GROUP BY grp ORDER BY grp

WITH x AS (SELECT i.customer_id, i.amount, p.day - i.due_day AS dd FROM finance_invoices i JOIN finance_customer_payments p ON p.invoice_id=i.invoice_id JOIN erp_customers c ON c.customer_id=i.customer_id WHERE c.terms_days>0),
c AS (SELECT customer_id, CASE WHEN sum(amount*GREATEST(dd,0))/sum(amount)>=20 THEN 'c_very_slow' WHEN sum(amount*GREATEST(dd,0))/sum(amount)>=6 THEN 'b_slow' ELSE 'a_normal' END grp FROM x GROUP BY 1)
SELECT grp, count(*) inv, round(avg((dd>0)::int),3) late_rate, min(dd) mn, quantile_cont(dd,0.1) p10, median(dd) p50, quantile_cont(dd,0.9) p90, max(dd) mx, round(avg(dd),2) avg_dd
FROM x JOIN c USING(customer_id) GROUP BY grp ORDER BY grp

WITH x AS (SELECT i.customer_id, i.amount, GREATEST(p.day - i.due_day,0) AS dl FROM finance_invoices i JOIN finance_customer_payments p ON p.invoice_id=i.invoice_id JOIN erp_customers c ON c.customer_id=i.customer_id WHERE c.terms_days>0),
c AS (SELECT customer_id, sum(amount*dl)/sum(amount) w FROM x GROUP BY 1)
SELECT e.branch, count(*) cust, sum((w>=20)::int) very_slow, sum((w>=6 AND w<20)::int) slow, round(avg((w>=20)::int),3) vs_share, round(avg((w>=6)::int),3) slow_or_worse_share
FROM c JOIN erp_customers e USING(customer_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH s AS (
 SELECT o.customer_id, sum(p.list_price*l.qty_shipped) lst16
 FROM erp_sales_order_lines l JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=o.day JOIN erp_products p USING(sku)
 WHERE d.year=2016 AND l.qty_shipped>0 GROUP BY 1),
a25 AS (SELECT DISTINCT o.customer_id FROM erp_sales_orders o JOIN dim_date d USING(day) WHERE d.year=2025),
c AS (SELECT s.customer_id, s.lst16, ntile(4) OVER (ORDER BY s.lst16, s.customer_id) size_q,
  CASE WHEN discount_pct<0.10 THEN 'a <10%' WHEN discount_pct<0.15 THEN 'b 10-15%' WHEN discount_pct<0.20 THEN 'c 15-20%' ELSE 'd >=20%' END tier,
  (a25.customer_id IS NOT NULL)::INT ret
  FROM s JOIN erp_customers cu USING(customer_id) LEFT JOIN a25 USING(customer_id))
SELECT size_q, tier, count(*) n, sum(ret) retained, round(avg(ret),4) ret_share, round(avg(lst16),0) avg_list16
FROM c GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH a16 AS (SELECT DISTINCT o.customer_id FROM erp_sales_orders o JOIN dim_date d USING(day) WHERE d.year=2016),
a25 AS (SELECT DISTINCT o.customer_id FROM erp_sales_orders o JOIN dim_date d USING(day) WHERE d.year=2025),
c AS (SELECT cu.trade, CASE WHEN discount_pct<0.10 THEN 'lo <10%' ELSE 'hi >=10%' END tier, (a25.customer_id IS NOT NULL)::INT ret
 FROM a16 JOIN erp_customers cu USING(customer_id) LEFT JOIN a25 USING(customer_id))
SELECT trade, tier, count(*) n, sum(ret) retained, round(avg(ret),4) ret_share FROM c GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH x AS (SELECT i.customer_id, i.amount, GREATEST(p.day - i.due_day,0) AS dl, p.day - i.day dtp, i.day iday, p.day pday FROM finance_invoices i JOIN finance_customer_payments p ON p.invoice_id=i.invoice_id JOIN erp_customers c ON c.customer_id=i.customer_id WHERE c.terms_days>0),
c AS (SELECT customer_id, sum(amount*dl)/sum(amount) w, sum(amount*dtp)/(max(pday)-min(iday)+1) avg_open, sum(amount*dl)/(max(pday)-min(iday)+1) avg_late FROM x GROUP BY 1),
g AS (SELECT CASE WHEN w>=20 THEN 'c_very_slow' WHEN w>=6 THEN 'b_slow' ELSE 'a_normal' END grp, c.*, e.credit_limit FROM c JOIN erp_customers e USING(customer_id))
SELECT grp, count(*) cust, round(median(avg_open),0) med_avg_open_ar, round(median(avg_late),0) med_avg_late_bal, round(median(credit_limit),0) med_limit, round(median(avg_open/credit_limit),3) med_open_to_limit, round(median(avg_late/credit_limit),3) med_late_to_limit, sum((avg_open>credit_limit)::int) cust_avg_open_over_limit
FROM g GROUP BY grp ORDER BY grp

WITH a16 AS (SELECT DISTINCT o.customer_id FROM erp_sales_orders o JOIN dim_date d USING(day) WHERE d.year=2016),
a25 AS (SELECT DISTINCT o.customer_id FROM erp_sales_orders o JOIN dim_date d USING(day) WHERE d.year=2025),
c AS (SELECT cu.branch, CASE WHEN discount_pct<0.10 THEN 'lo' ELSE 'hi' END tier, (a25.customer_id IS NOT NULL)::INT ret
 FROM a16 JOIN erp_customers cu USING(customer_id) LEFT JOIN a25 USING(customer_id))
SELECT branch, count(*) FILTER (WHERE tier='lo') n_lo, round(avg(ret) FILTER (WHERE tier='lo'),4) ret_lo,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE tier='hi') n_hi, round(avg(ret) FILTER (WHERE tier='hi'),4) ret_hi
FROM c GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH x AS (SELECT i.customer_id, i.amount, GREATEST(p.day - i.due_day,0) AS dl FROM finance_invoices i JOIN finance_customer_payments p ON p.invoice_id=i.invoice_id JOIN erp_customers c ON c.customer_id=i.customer_id WHERE c.terms_days>0),
c AS (SELECT customer_id, sum(amount*dl)/sum(amount) w FROM x GROUP BY 1),
r AS (SELECT e.rep_id, count(*) cust, avg((w>=20)::int) vs FROM c JOIN erp_customers e USING(customer_id) GROUP BY 1)
SELECT count(*) reps, min(cust) min_cust, max(cust) max_cust, round(min(vs),3) min_vs_share, round(median(vs),3) med_vs_share, round(max(vs),3) max_vs_share FROM r

c AS (SELECT CASE WHEN discount_pct<0.10 THEN 'a <10%' WHEN discount_pct<0.15 THEN 'b 10-15%' WHEN discount_pct<0.20 THEN 'c 15-20%' ELSE 'd >=20%' END tier, last_year
 FROM a16 JOIN erp_customers cu USING(customer_id) JOIN last USING(customer_id))

SELECT d.year, count(*) n_matched,
 sum(CASE WHEN abs(f.unit_price-l.unit_price)>0.005 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) n_price_diff,

c AS (SELECT customer_id, sum(amount*dl)/sum(amount) w FROM x GROUP BY 1)
SELECT e.rep_id, count(*) cust, sum((w>=20)::int) very_slow, round(avg((w>=20)::int),3) vs_share, round(count(*)*0.0601,1) expected_at_6pct FROM c JOIN erp_customers e USING(customer_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY vs_share DESC, rep_id LIMIT 5

WITH x AS (SELECT i.customer_id, i.amount, GREATEST(p.day - i.due_day,0) AS dl FROM finance_invoices i JOIN finance_customer_payments p ON p.invoice_id=i.invoice_id JOIN erp_customers c ON c.customer_id=i.customer_id WHERE c.terms_days>0),
c AS (SELECT customer_id, sum(amount) billed, sum(amount*dl) ldd FROM x GROUP BY 1),
g AS (SELECT CASE WHEN ldd/billed>=20 THEN 'c_very_slow' WHEN ldd/billed>=6 THEN 'b_slow' ELSE 'a_normal' END grp, * FROM c),
s AS (SELECT grp, sum(billed) b, sum(ldd) l FROM g GROUP BY grp),
n AS (SELECT l/b base FROM s WHERE grp='a_normal')

 round(sum((l - b*n.base)/2520*0.08) OVER (),0) total_excess_cost_yr, round(sum(l) OVER ()/2520*0.08,0) total_late_cost_yr

WITH x AS (
 SELECT d.year, o.customer_id, p.list_price*l.qty_shipped lst, (1-c.discount_pct) keep
 FROM erp_sales_order_lines l JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=o.day JOIN erp_products p USING(sku) JOIN erp_customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id
 WHERE l.qty_shipped>0 AND l.markdown_pct=0 AND d.year IN (2016,2025)),
cy AS (SELECT customer_id, year, sum(lst) lst, max(keep) keep FROM x GROUP BY 1,2),
g AS (SELECT a.*, CASE WHEN count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id)=2 THEN 'both' WHEN year=2016 THEN 'exited' ELSE 'entered' END grp FROM cy a),
s AS (SELECT year, grp, sum(lst) lst, sum(lst*keep)/sum(lst) k FROM g GROUP BY 1,2),
t AS (SELECT
 (SELECT sum(lst*k)/sum(lst) FROM s WHERE year=2016) k16,
 (SELECT sum(lst*k)/sum(lst) FROM s WHERE year=2025) k25,
 (SELECT k FROM s WHERE year=2016 AND grp='both') kb16,
 (SELECT k FROM s WHERE year=2025 AND grp='both') kb25,
 (SELECT k FROM s WHERE year=2016 AND grp='exited') kx,
 (SELECT k FROM s WHERE year=2025 AND grp='entered') kn,
 (SELECT lst FROM s WHERE year=2016 AND grp='both')/(SELECT sum(lst) FROM s WHERE year=2016) wb16,
 (SELECT lst FROM s WHERE year=2025 AND grp='both')/(SELECT sum(lst) FROM s WHERE year=2025) wb25,
 (SELECT sum(lst) FROM s WHERE year=2025) lst25)
SELECT round(k16,4) k16, round(k25,4) k25, round(k25-k16,4) total_change,
 round(wb25*(kb25-kb16),4) continuer_change,
 round((1-wb25)*(kn-kx),4) entrant_vs_exiter_gap,
 round((wb25-wb16)*(kb16-kx),4) weight_shift,
 round(wb16,4) wb16, round(wb25,4) wb25,
 round(lst25*wb25*(kb16-kb25)*0.98362255,2) continuer_dollars,
 round(lst25*(1-wb25)*(kx-kn)*0.98362255,2) replacement_dollars,
 round(lst25*(wb25-wb16)*(kx-kb16)*0.98362255,2) weight_dollars
FROM t

u AS (SELECT i.* FROM finance_invoices i LEFT JOIN finance_customer_payments p USING(invoice_id) WHERE p.invoice_id IS NULL)
SELECT coalesce(c.grp, CASE WHEN e.terms_days=0 THEN 'zero_terms' ELSE 'no_paid_invoices' END) grp, count(*) unpaid_inv, count(DISTINCT u.customer_id) cust, round(sum(u.amount),0) amt, round(avg(2520-u.due_day),1) avg_days_past_due_at_end, sum((u.due_day<2520-20)::int) past_due_over20_at_end
FROM u JOIN erp_customers e USING(customer_id) LEFT JOIN c USING(customer_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH x AS (SELECT i.customer_id, i.amount, GREATEST(p.day - i.due_day,0) dl, GREATEST(dp.date - dd.date,0) dl_cal FROM finance_invoices i JOIN finance_customer_payments p USING(invoice_id) JOIN dim_date dd ON dd.day=i.due_day JOIN dim_date dp ON dp.day=p.day JOIN erp_customers c ON c.customer_id=i.customer_id WHERE c.terms_days>0),
c AS (SELECT customer_id, sum(amount) b, sum(amount*dl) l, sum(amount*dl_cal) lc FROM x GROUP BY 1),
g AS (SELECT CASE WHEN l/b>=20 THEN 'c_very_slow' WHEN l/b>=6 THEN 'b_slow' ELSE 'a_normal' END grp, * FROM c),
s AS (SELECT grp, sum(b) b, sum(lc) lc FROM g GROUP BY 1),
n AS (SELECT lc/b base FROM s WHERE grp='a_normal')
SELECT grp, round(n.base,3) normal_cal_rate, round((lc-b*n.base)/3651*0.08,0) excess_cost_yr_cal, round(sum((lc-b*n.base)/3651*0.08) OVER (),0) total_excess, round(sum(lc) OVER ()/3651*0.08,0) total_late_cost

WITH x AS (SELECT i.customer_id, i.amount, i.day, GREATEST(p.day - i.due_day,0) dl FROM finance_invoices i JOIN finance_customer_payments p USING(invoice_id) JOIN erp_customers c ON c.customer_id=i.customer_id WHERE c.terms_days>0),
c AS (SELECT customer_id, CASE WHEN sum(amount*dl)/sum(amount)>=20 THEN 'c_very_slow' WHEN sum(amount*dl)/sum(amount)>=6 THEN 'b_slow' ELSE 'a_normal' END grp FROM x GROUP BY 1)
SELECT d.month, round(sum(amount*dl) FILTER (WHERE grp='a_normal')/sum(amount) FILTER (WHERE grp='a_normal'),2) normal, round(sum(amount*dl) FILTER (WHERE grp='b_slow')/sum(amount) FILTER (WHERE grp='b_slow'),2) slow, round(sum(amount*dl) FILTER (WHERE grp='c_very_slow')/sum(amount) FILTER (WHERE grp='c_very_slow'),2) very_slow, round(sum(amount) FILTER (WHERE grp='c_very_slow')/sum(amount),4) vs_billing_share, count(*) inv
FROM x JOIN c USING(customer_id) JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=x.day GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH x AS (SELECT i.customer_id, i.amount, GREATEST(p.day - i.due_day,0) dl FROM finance_invoices i JOIN finance_customer_payments p USING(invoice_id) JOIN erp_customers c ON c.customer_id=i.customer_id WHERE c.terms_days>0),
c AS (SELECT customer_id, sum(amount) b, sum(amount*dl)/sum(amount) w, count(*) n FROM x GROUP BY 1)
SELECT e.trade, count(*) cust, round(avg((w>=20)::int),3) vs_share, round(avg((w>=6)::int),3) slow_plus_share, round(sum(w*b)/sum(b),2) wdl, round(avg(e.discount_pct),4) avg_disc
FROM c JOIN erp_customers e USING(customer_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH x AS (SELECT i.customer_id, i.amount, p.method, GREATEST(p.day - i.due_day,0) dl FROM finance_invoices i JOIN finance_customer_payments p USING(invoice_id) JOIN erp_customers c ON c.customer_id=i.customer_id WHERE c.terms_days>0),
c AS (SELECT customer_id, CASE WHEN sum(amount*dl)/sum(amount)>=20 THEN 'c_very_slow' WHEN sum(amount*dl)/sum(amount)>=6 THEN 'b_slow' ELSE 'a_normal' END grp FROM x GROUP BY 1)
SELECT method, count(*) inv, round(sum(amount*dl)/sum(amount),2) wdl_all,
 round(sum(amount*dl) FILTER (WHERE grp='a_normal')/sum(amount) FILTER (WHERE grp='a_normal'),2) normal,
 round(sum(amount*dl) FILTER (WHERE grp='b_slow')/sum(amount) FILTER (WHERE grp='b_slow'),2) slow,
 round(sum(amount*dl) FILTER (WHERE grp='c_very_slow')/sum(amount) FILTER (WHERE grp='c_very_slow'),2) very_slow,
 round(count(*) FILTER (WHERE grp='c_very_slow')/count(*),4) vs_inv_share
FROM x JOIN c USING(customer_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH x AS (SELECT i.customer_id, i.amount, i.day, GREATEST(p.day - i.due_day,0) dl FROM finance_invoices i JOIN finance_customer_payments p USING(invoice_id) JOIN erp_customers c ON c.customer_id=i.customer_id WHERE c.terms_days>0),
c AS (SELECT customer_id, CASE WHEN sum(amount*dl)/sum(amount)>=20 THEN 'c_very_slow' WHEN sum(amount*dl)/sum(amount)>=6 THEN 'b_slow' ELSE 'a_normal' END grp FROM x GROUP BY 1)
SELECT d.year, count(DISTINCT customer_id) active_cust, count(DISTINCT customer_id) FILTER (WHERE grp='c_very_slow') vs_active, round(sum(amount) FILTER (WHERE grp='c_very_slow')/sum(amount),4) vs_bill_share, round(sum(amount*dl) FILTER (WHERE grp='c_very_slow')/sum(amount*dl),4) vs_ldd_share, round(sum(amount*dl)/sum(amount),2) wdl_all,
 round(sum(amount*dl) FILTER (WHERE grp='c_very_slow')/sum(amount) FILTER (WHERE grp='c_very_slow'),2) vs_wdl
FROM x JOIN c USING(customer_id) JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=x.day GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH x AS (SELECT i.customer_id, i.amount, i.day, GREATEST(p.day - i.due_day,0) dl, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY i.customer_id ORDER BY i.day, i.invoice_id) k FROM finance_invoices i JOIN finance_customer_payments p USING(invoice_id) JOIN erp_customers c ON c.customer_id=i.customer_id WHERE c.terms_days>0),
c AS (SELECT customer_id, CASE WHEN sum(amount*dl)/sum(amount)>=20 THEN 'c_very_slow' WHEN sum(amount*dl)/sum(amount)>=6 THEN 'b_slow' ELSE 'a_normal' END grp, count(*) n FROM x GROUP BY 1)
SELECT grp, CASE WHEN k<=5 THEN 'a first 5' WHEN k<=20 THEN 'b 6-20' ELSE 'c 21+' END seq, count(*) inv, round(sum(amount*dl)/sum(amount),2) wdl
FROM x JOIN c USING(customer_id) WHERE c.n>=40 GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH x AS (SELECT i.customer_id, i.amount, GREATEST(p.day - i.due_day,0) dl FROM finance_invoices i JOIN finance_customer_payments p USING(invoice_id) JOIN erp_customers c ON c.customer_id=i.customer_id WHERE c.terms_days>0),
c AS (SELECT customer_id, CASE WHEN sum(amount*dl)/sum(amount)>=20 THEN 'c_very_slow' WHEN sum(amount*dl)/sum(amount)>=6 THEN 'b_slow' ELSE 'a_normal' END grp FROM x GROUP BY 1),
m AS (SELECT o.customer_id, sum(l.qty_shipped*l.unit_price) rev, sum(l.qty_shipped*(l.unit_price-l.unit_cost)) gm, avg(l.markdown_pct) md FROM erp_sales_orders o JOIN erp_sales_order_lines l USING(order_id) GROUP BY 1)
SELECT grp, count(*) cust, round(sum(rev)/10,0) rev_yr, round(sum(gm)/10,0) gm_yr, round(sum(gm)/sum(rev),4) gm_pct, round(avg(md),4) avg_markdown
FROM c JOIN m USING(customer_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH x AS (SELECT i.customer_id, i.amount, GREATEST(p.day - i.due_day,0) dl FROM finance_invoices i JOIN finance_customer_payments p USING(invoice_id) JOIN erp_customers c ON c.customer_id=i.customer_id WHERE c.terms_days>0),
c AS (SELECT customer_id, CASE WHEN sum(amount*dl)/sum(amount)>=20 THEN 'c_very_slow' WHEN sum(amount*dl)/sum(amount)>=6 THEN 'b_slow' ELSE 'a_normal' END grp, sum(amount) b FROM x GROUP BY 1),
s AS (SELECT customer_id, count(*) contacts, count(*) FILTER (WHERE lower(subject) LIKE '%bill%' OR lower(subject) LIKE '%invoice%' OR lower(subject) LIKE '%pay%' OR lower(subject) LIKE '%credit%' OR lower(subject) LIKE '%statement%') billing_contacts FROM crm_service_contacts GROUP BY 1),
cm AS (SELECT customer_id, count(*) memos, sum(amount) cm_amt FROM finance_credit_memos GROUP BY 1)

FROM c LEFT JOIN s USING(customer_id) LEFT JOIN cm USING(customer_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

c AS (SELECT customer_id, sum(amount*dl) FILTER (WHERE h=1)/sum(amount) FILTER (WHERE h=1) w1, sum(amount*dl) FILTER (WHERE h=2)/sum(amount) FILTER (WHERE h=2) w2, count(*) FILTER (WHERE h=1) n1, count(*) FILTER (WHERE h=2) n2 FROM x GROUP BY 1)

c AS (SELECT customer_id, sum(amount) billed, sum(amount*dl) ldd FROM x GROUP BY 1),
r AS (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY ldd DESC, customer_id) rl, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY billed DESC, customer_id) rb, count(*) OVER () nc FROM c)
